Job Title: Quality Engineer                
Location:  Monroe, LA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring.  Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions. 
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.

Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.
  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.
  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.

Core Competencies 
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement. 
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions. 
  • Customer Focus – Evaluates quality through the customer’s perspective and takes action to improve product performance, reliability, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes personal accountability for commitments, respects deadlines, drives actions to completion, and operates effectively without constant direction.
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds productive relationships across Engineering, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, and other functions to resolve issues and advance quality initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance Excellence – Maintains high standards for quality, process discipline, documentation, and compliance while supporting effective quality management systems.

Preferences: 
  • Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar quality certification.
  • Experience with PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 certified manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T, blueprint reading, and metrology systems.
  • Experience in machining, assembly, pump manufacturing, or other industrial manufacturing environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer audits, supplier visits, training, or other business needs.

Job Overview:

Technical Support Senior Engineer – Compression Technologies and Services is responsible for providing post sales technical support on air product lines for the authorized local service providers. Reporting to the regional Technical Support manager of a designated product range, this position is responsible for understand and driving key product quality and reliability issues, handing escalated customer issues, mentoring of the team, supporting Technical Training as a subject matter expert and leveraging technology, to maximize customer satisfaction, loyalty and retention to assure company business goals are achieved.  This role collaborates with other regional Technical Support teams and enables capability between regions. 

 

Responsibilities:

• Provide a high level of problem solving in a technical support role.  Frequently takes lead on quality / reliability issues and projects

• Communication skills necessary to effectively lead teams dealing with resolution of complex technical issues with peers, Engineers, Operations and Management

• Provide Top Tier technical support for the field support organizations (IRCC's and Distribution) and directly to customers as required via phone, emails and customer site visits

• Mentor Tech Support team members to enhance the professional and technical skills

• Compile technical bulletins fault trees and troubleshooting guides to ensure field personnel have access to latest updates / reference data. This includes contributing to the Knowledge Base to improve field connectivity and effective troubleshooting, through all mode of multimedia.

• Support the development and implementation of “state-of-the –art” practices and technology and solutions to achieve operational excellence and customer support 24/7

• Engaged in New Product Development / IRPDP activities such as design and reliability, field trial testing / feedback, field upgrades training / technical support capability of new technology. 

• Support contact management capability for high cadence interaction with channel field technicians in support of resolving complex product and system issues impacting our customers.

• Actively involved in weekly global QRMSa issued escalated as a result of know field issues related to negative repetitive quality and reliability trends.

• Subject master / expert (SME) / Champion for a designated line of complex air products.

• Coordinates / participates in the activities of global expertise network leaders to drive Tech Direct knowledge management execution; improve technician effectiveness with faster access to solutions and knowledge base.

• Instruct Technical classes on multiple air product lines

• Global multi-media technical solution authoring, proof reading and deployment.

• Scope & Dimensions: Fiscally responsible for equipment valued around $2,500,000+ USD.  40% Reliability / Projects / content creation, 30% Training, 20% Phone (Phone Calls 5-10, Escalated Issues 5-10 Per day) & Travel 10% 

• Leads calls for Master Techs on field experience and feedback.

 

Requirements: 

• Bachelor’s degree or global/regional technical equivalent experience. (e.g. N3)

• 10+ years’ experience in a technical work environment.  Experience and ability to work effectively acting on own initiative with minimal supervision required.    •

• MS Office skills - proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word essential. 

 

Core Competencies:

  • Work does involve confidentiality to prevent potential exposure to claims against the company either legally or financially
  • Solid Leadership skills, communication & motivation skills, able to build strong internal & external relationships the development of team capabilities. Experience of supporting teams, complex customer issues and projects.
  • Strong Interpersonal Skills, with ability to influence others at different levels.
  • Self-motivation and ability to make and defend complex decisions.
  • Planning and organizational skills with effective follow up and follow through.
  • English language, additional languages are an advantage.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Presentation skills – customers, channel partners, internal senior management and peers.
  • Influencing skills - customers, internal management and peers
  • Problems faced will usually be difficult and often complex, ability to deal effectively in potentially volatile and highly charged / emotional situations.
  • Required to make technical assessments in complicated product issues, potentially incurring high-cost liability, write and edit detailed technical report. 
  • Work will involve confidentiality to prevent potential exposure to claims against the company either legally or financially.
  • Requires direct customer contact, needs to be confident, courteous and professional in all situations.
  • Pro-active approach to resolving customer issues, taking responsibility to form and lead teams as required to drive corrective actions and follow through to conclusion.
  • Mastery (Skill) and Expertise (Knowledge) – Master / Expert in two of the eight competencies, working to become Master / Expert in one other, with a good understanding of the remaining: 
  • Small Air reciprocating compressors
  • Rotary Air Compressors
  • Air dryers (Desiccant/Refrigerated)
  • Variable Frequency Drives, Electric Motors
  • Industrial Controls and Communications

  • Industrial Gas Centrifugal compressors

  • The position requires travel both domestically and internationally including weekends as required, approx. 15% of time.

The Engineering Program Manager leads a portfolio of new product development and product optimization projects that drive revenue growth, margin expansion, customer value, and operational performance. This role manages multiple cross-functional projects from concept through implementation and is accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk management, and overall project delivery. The successful candidate will align stakeholders, secure resources, resolve barriers, and provide clear, data-driven communication to project teams and leadership.

Responsibilities
• Lead projects through the gated project management process, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, success criteria, schedules, budgets, and governance requirements.
• Lead cross-functional teams comprised of engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, quality, product management, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
• Establish project operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and accountability mechanisms; provide project management direction and support to teams and stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain integrated project plans, including milestones, dependencies and critical-path activities.
• Maintain the accuracy of project financials and the forecasted business case; monitor spending, benefits, and variances.
• Identify, assess, and manage project risks, and assumptions; develop mitigation and recovery plans and escalate decisions when needed.
• Provide concise, fact-based reporting on project status, financial performance, risks, decisions, and next steps to project teams, and leadership.
• Improve project execution by developing standard work, applying lessons learned, and advancing project management tools, methods, and best practices.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field
• 7+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated leadership of cross-functional projects.
• 3+ years of experience delivering multiple projects in a product development or manufacturing environment and coordinating cross functional resources.
• 2+ years of experience with project planning, scheduling, risk management, and status-reporting tools.

Core Competencies
• Applies financial acumen to evaluate project investments, manage budgets and forecasts, assess business-case performance, and make informed tradeoff decisions that maximize business value.
• Leads multiple project teams simultaneously through direct leadership, collaboration, and influence.
• Demonstrates ownership, urgency, and persistence in meeting or exceeding project objectives.
• Communicates complex information clearly and influences decisions at all levels of the organization.
• Uses critical thinking and data to resolve conflict, solve problems, make timely decisions, and escalate risks appropriately.
• Is analytical, adaptable, collaborative, and highly organized, with strong interpersonal skills and disciplined follow-through.

About ILC Dover
ILC Dover is a global leader in engineered products that protect people, products, and brands. From space exploration and defense systems to pharmaceutical and industrial applications, ILC Dover delivers mission?critical solutions where performance, reliability, and safety matter most. ILC Dover offers competitive compensation and benefits within a collaborative, engineering?driven culture that values innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence.

Job Overview: 
The Project Engineer supports the successful execution of engineering and production programs related to Extravehicular Activity (EVA) spacesuit systems by coordinating cross-functional teams, tracking progress, and ensuring timely achievement of key program milestones. This role assists in planning, organizing, and managing projects across spacesuit hardware development, integration, and production activities, working closely with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams to deliver flight-critical hardware on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
This position is based at the Frederica, Delaware manufacturing facility and directly supports the development, assembly, integration, testing, and sustainment of EVA spacesuit systems, with a primary focus on the Space Suit Assembly (SSA) in support of NASA programs. The Project Engineer plays a key role in managing the full hardware lifecycle—from design release through fabrication, production, verification, and delivery—ensuring alignment with NASA requirements and strict adherence to human spaceflight safety and quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and monitor EVA spacesuit hardware projects from design release through production, integration, and delivery
  • Serve as a liaison between engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams to ensure alignment on production priorities, requirements, and schedules
  • Support execution of spacesuit assembly and integration activities at the Frederica site, ensuring readiness for build, test, and delivery
  • Ensure hardware fabrication and production efforts are completed on schedule and within budget constraints
  • Gather and manage technical, manufacturing, and program data to support requirements definition, build readiness, and production execution
  • Lead hardware failure investigations for spacesuit components and assemblies; facilitate root cause analysis (RCA) and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across engineering and factory operations
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication with program managers and stakeholders regarding risks, issues, and impacts to cost, schedule, or technical performance
  • Interface with NASA customers to communicate project status, technical progress, risks, and key milestones through formal reviews, reports, and coordination meetings
  • Support integration, test, and verification activities for EVA hardware, ensuring compliance with NASA program requirements and certification standards
  • Assist with transition of hardware from development into production, including coordination of build plans, work instructions, and configuration control
  • Support project planning activities across proposal, contract execution, and program lifecycle phases for EVA spacesuit programs
  • Conduct routine tasks as directed in support of EVA program execution


*This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:
  • Must be able to access shared government program databases (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field

Core Competencies: 
  • Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or product development environment preferred
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and interface control documents (ICDs)
  • Interest in project management and product development (PMP or CAPM a plus)
  • Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project)
  • Strong collaboration, problem-solving skills, and ability to work effectively in team environments (including navigating constructive conflict)
  • Experience with hardware development lifecycle including design, build, test, and qualification phases
  • Experience supporting or participating in hardware failure investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation preferred

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements: 
  • Fully Site Based in Frederica, DE
  • Availability to travel up to 25 % of the time (e.g., customer visits, training at our technical centers, trade shows, etc.).
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to wet or humid conditions (non-weather); fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals.  The employee is frequently exposed to work near moving mechanical parts.  The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Job Title: Senior Applications Engineer

Location: Ocala FL

Job Overview:

The Senior Application Engineer is the technical authority responsible for supporting customers, sales teams, and channel partners with engineering expertise in compressed air purification and gas generation systems. This role provides advanced product selection, system design support, sizing calculations, and technical proposals for air treatment equipment such as desiccant dryers, refrigerated dryers, filtration systems, condensate management, and onsite gas generation. This position also plays a key role in driving solution accuracy, improving engineering tools, and mentoring junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application & Technical Support

  • Provide expert-level application guidance on compressed air and gas treatment solutions.
  • Select and size air dryers, filtration, and gas generation equipment based on customer operating conditions, ISO 8573.1 requirements, dew point specifications, and environmental factors.
  • Evaluate customer data on pressure, flow, inlet temperature, ambient conditions, and contamination levels to recommend optimal solutions.
  • Review engineering drawings, P&IDs, and customer specifications to ensure compliance and identify risks or deviations.

2. Proposal & Solution Development

  • Prepare detailed technical proposals, system schematics, tender responses, and custom configuration documents.
  • Develop system layouts including dryers, filters, aftercoolers, condensate drains, receivers, controls, and interconnecting piping.
  • Perform dew point calculations, purge air calculations, and pressure drop estimations.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to ensure feasibility of custom configurations.

3. Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, and Quality to support winning project bids.
  • Provide technical input for New Product Introduction (NPI) and voice-of-customer data.
  • Assist Field Service with complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Support Operations with technical clarification needed for build to order systems.

4. Customer Interaction & Training

  • Participate in customer meetings, technical workshops, on site assessments, and presentations.
  • Deliver training to distributors, internal teams, and customers on air treatment technologies, system balancing, and proper installation.

5. Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and improve sizing tools, configurators, technical databases, and engineering templates.
  • Develop standard work, application guides, and best practice documents for internal and external use.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related technical field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in application engineering or technical support within industrial air treatment, compressed air systems, or related process equipment.

Preferred
  • Strong experience with desiccant dryers, refrigerated dryers, filtration, gas generation, or HVAC/process air handling preferred.
  • Experience with ISO 8573.1, NFPA, OSHA, and industry air quality standards is advantageous.
  • Deep understanding of adsorption/absorption principles, heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and pneumatic systems.
  • Ability to perform dew point, heat load, pressure drop, purge loss, and filtration efficiency calculations.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools (AutoCAD, Inventor) for system layout support.
  • Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, technical specifications, and electrical schematics.
  • Proficiency with MS Office, CRM/ERP systems, and engineering sizing software.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex engineering concepts.
  • Highly analytical with strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong project management and multitasking ability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-first mindset with a collaborative working style.
  • Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead by example.
  • Technical Mastery in Air Treatment
  • Application & System Design
  • Customer Engagement
  • Cross Functional Collaboration
  • Analytical Decision Making
  • Engineering Documentation
  • Project Coordination
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Coaching & Mentoring

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Onsite in Ocala FL
  • Mix of office, manufacturing, and occasional customer site environments.
  • Travel requirement: typically, 10–20%, including customer visits and field troubleshooting.

Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Location: Buffalo, NY

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview

Ingersoll Rand is seeking an experienced NPD Engineer who can thrive inside an interactive and dynamic team where safety, quality, creativity, and continuous improvement are paramount. This role is for a seasoned engineer capable of independently owning complex design deliverables from concept through launch with minimal supervision. The experienced NPD Engineer leads detailed mechanical design, design verification, launch support, and continuous improvement of centrifugal compressor products. Principal responsibilities include translating customer, market, and product requirements into robust mechanical designs, driving engineering definition through CAD/PLM systems, and resolving complex technical problems while collaborating across Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, Tendering, and Service teams to deliver reliable, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Design ownership: Independently develop and release mechanical designs for centrifugal compressor systems and components, including 3D models, drawings, bills of material, and design documentation.
  • Product development leadership: Own the translation of product requirements into practical, validated design solutions, working directly with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Service teams and driving decisions to closure.
  • Technical accountability: Take responsibility for mechanical design definition, tolerance analysis, manufacturability, serviceability, and design documentation for new or improved products, applying engineering judgment to trade-offs.
  • Customer interaction: Serve as a technical point of contact for internal and external customers, effectively communicating design intent, technical constraints, trade-offs, and project status to audiences with varying technical backgrounds.
  • Product validation: Build centrifugal compressor prototypes to be used for pre-production testing and verification, implementing any lessons learned during the build into the design.
  • Travel: Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 5%.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering
  • 5+ years of related design or product development experience with a strong foundation in mechanical design, machine design, mechanics of materials, manufacturing processes, and/or engineering fundamentals, with a proven track record of delivering released designs.
Preferences:
  • Demonstrated experience with centrifugal compressor components, pressure-containing equipment, rotating equipment, or packaged equipment design is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency with finite element analysis, tolerance analysis, design automation, and/or computer programming is a plus.
  • Hands-on proficiency with CAD and PLM systems (NX and Teamcenter) is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong working knowledge of computer systems and basic Microsoft Office.
  • Strong command of the English language and the ability to clearly communicate in writing and speech with peers, leadership, and internal/external customers.
  • Ability to quickly understand, condense, and organize complex information to make sound, independent engineering decisions.
  • Self-motivated, responsible, detail-oriented, and personable, with the confidence to own outcomes.
  • Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning significant deliverables and reliably managing stress, change, and pressure with professionalism.
  • Ability to perform critical mental tasks such as decision-making, prioritizing, organizing, and exercising sound judgment to align work with business objectives.

Travel & Work Arrangements / Requirements

  • The location for this position is Buffalo, NY. 4 days onsite, 1 day remote.

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $85,000-$95,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title: Field Service Manager, Industrial Compressors & Controls              
Location: Ponoma, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

Pay Range: Total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $125,000 - $160000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation. 

What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. 
 

Job Title: Area Sales Manager 

Location: Remote – Must reside in West Coast Territory of the following states: CO, AZ, NV, UT 

 

 

About US:
Welch Vacuum, a subsidiary of Ingersoll Rand since 1996, is a global leader with over a century of history in high-performance vacuum technologies. We specialize in vacuum pumps, systems, and components for laboratories, life sciences, and industrial manufacturing. Operating within Ingersoll Rand's medical and laboratory division, we combine the engineering strengths of US-based Welch Vacuum Technology and Germany's Ilmvac GmbH.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic Area Sales Manager to lead our Sales Engineering function across the US West Coast, Mexico, and potentially South America. Requiring up to 75% travel, this role drives the promotion and sale of diverse vacuum technologies and OEM components. You will champion solution-based selling to distributors, manufacturers, system integrators, and end-users across vital sectors—including Life Sciences, Medical, Chemical, and General Manufacturing.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Business Growth: Expand market share using modern prospecting methods, structured toll-gate sales processes, and solution-selling best practices.
  • Manage & Acquire Accounts: Nurture the existing distributor base and partner with dealer reps while aggressively pursuing new distribution, reseller, and OEM/system integrator opportunities.
  • Provide Technical Support: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to OEMs, large end-users, and academic research institutions to guide the pump specification and selection process directly in customer labs.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Field Sales Support, Application Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Demand Generation to secure new business and drive profitable growth.
  • Lead Commercial Negotiations: Manage major pricing negotiations, define technical specifications, and ensure alignment across complex commercial agreements.
  • Build Multi-Level Relationships: Interface confidently with diverse customer departments on a technical and commercial level, including Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, and decision makers and leadership.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Manage accurate sales forecasts and maintain up-to-date internal CRM reporting to support strategic growth objectives.
  • Apply Subject Matter Expertise: Leverage technical sales experience and vacuum pump technology knowledge to develop business and promote the Welch brand to new customers.
  • Execute Strategic Agility: Perform other responsibilities as assigned or required to support evolving business needs.

 

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of customer-facing vacuum sales experience, with a proven track record of growth.
 

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Selling: Ability to execute sophisticated sales strategies and drive new business development.
  • Problem Solving: Creative problem-solver skilled at resolving technical challenges and open issues.
  • Collaboration: Strong relationship builder with both external clients and internal support teams.
  • Organization: Exceptional multi-tasking abilities with sharp attention to detail, organization, and analysis.
  • Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English is required; Spanish proficiency is a strong plus.

Preferences:  
 
  • Industry Expertise: Experience in the Laboratory, Analytical, and Life Sciences markets.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proven sales or application experience with vacuum pump technologies (or closely related industrial systems).
  • Account Management: Demonstrated success in prospecting, securing, and managing enterprise-level accounts.
  • Drive: High-energy self-starter with a goal-oriented mindset.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Accessibility: Must reside within 50 miles of a major airport to accommodate regional travel.

Job Title: Engineer- ETO (Engineered-To-Order)

Location: Buffalo NY

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.

Job Overview

Ingersoll Rand is seeking a highly motivated, Engineer to Order(ETO) Engineer to join an interactive and dynamic team where safety, quality, creativity, and continuous improvement are paramount. This is a role designed for a recent graduate or engineer with limited industry experience who is eager to learn centrifugal compressor design fundamentals specific to our customer orders. Working under the guidance and mentorship of your peers and manager, the ETO Engineer will detail mechanical design and design verification while building the technical foundation needed to grow into an independent contributor. Assignments are typically well-defined in scope and reviewed regularly to support learning and skill development.

Responsibilities

  • Design support: Assist in developing and releasing mechanical designs for centrifugal compressor components under the direction of your functional engineering manager, including 3D models, drawings, and bills of material.
  • Team collaboration: Participate in cross-functional discussions with our Tendering and Commercial teams, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Service teams to understand how product and customer specific requirements translate into design solutions.
  • Product validation: Support the design, build, and test of centrifugal compressors made to customer specifications.
  • Communication: Communicate progress, questions, and roadblocks clearly and proactively to mentors and the team; actively seek feedback to accelerate learning.
  • Travel: Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 5%.

Qualifications

  • BS in Mechanical Engineering
  • 3+ years of related design or product development experience with a solid undergraduate foundation in mechanical design, machine design, mechanics of materials, manufacturing processes, and/or engineering fundamentals.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Exposure to turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or pressure-containing equipment through coursework or internships is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CAD/PLM tools (NX and Teamcenter), finite element analysis, or programming is a plus.
  • Demonstrated eagerness to learn, strong work ethic, and ability to work in a team environment.

Core Competencies

  • Working knowledge of computer systems and basic Microsoft Office.
  • Strong command of the English language with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with peers, mentors, and leadership.
  • Ability to absorb, organize, and apply new technical information quickly.
  • Self-motivated, responsible, detail-oriented, coachable, and personable, with a genuine desire to receive and act on feedback.
  • Ability to own and manage assignments within a supportive team environment while developing and agile resilience to change within specific customer constraints and aggressive schedules.

Travel & Work Arrangements / Requirements

  • Fully Onsite in Buffalo, NY.

Location:  Monroe, LA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring.  Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions. 
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.


Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.

  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.

  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.

  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.


Core Competencies 

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement. 
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions. 
  • Customer Focus – Evaluates quality through the customer’s perspective and takes action to improve product performance, reliability, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes personal accountability for commitments, respects deadlines, drives actions to completion, and operates effectively without constant direction.
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds productive relationships across Engineering, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, and other functions to resolve issues and advance quality initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance Excellence – Maintains high standards for quality, process discipline, documentation, and compliance while supporting effective quality management systems.


Preferences: 

  • Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar quality certification.
  • Experience with PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 certified manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T, blueprint reading, and metrology systems.
  • Experience in machining, assembly, pump manufacturing, or other industrial manufacturing environments.


Travel & Work Arrangements

  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer audits, supplier visits, training, or other business needs.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.

Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.

Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting

Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle.

Job Overview:

Ingersoll Rand is seeking a highly motivated, early-career NPD Engineer to join an interactive and dynamic team where safety, quality, creativity, and continuous improvement are paramount. This is a role designed for a recent graduate or engineer with limited industry experience who is eager to learn centrifugal compressor design fundamentals. Working under the guidance and mentorship of senior engineers, the NPD Engineer will support concept development, detailed mechanical design, and design verification while building the technical foundation needed to grow into an independent contributor. Assignments are typically well-defined in scope and reviewed regularly to support learning and skill development.

Responsibilities:

  • Design support: Assist in developing and releasing mechanical designs for centrifugal compressor components under the direction of senior engineers, including 3D models, drawings, and bills of material.
  • Team collaboration: Participate in cross-functional discussions with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Service teams to understand how product requirements translate into design solutions.
  • Product validation: Build centrifugal compressor prototypes to be used for pre-production testing and verification, implementing any lessons learned during the build into the design.
  • Communication: Communicate progress, questions, and roadblocks clearly and proactively to mentors and the team; actively seek feedback to accelerate learning.
  • Travel: Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 5%.

Qualifications:

  • BS in Mechanical Engineering
  • 1+ years of related design or product development experience with a solid undergraduate foundation in mechanical design, machine design, mechanics of materials, manufacturing processes, and/or engineering fundamentals.
Preferences:
  • Exposure to turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or pressure-containing equipment through coursework or internships is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CAD/PLM tools (NX and Teamcenter), finite element analysis, or programming is a plus but not required
  • Demonstrated eagerness to learn, strong work ethic, and ability to work in a team environment.

Core Competencies:

  • Working knowledge of computer systems and basic Microsoft Office.
  • Strong command of the English language with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with peers, mentors, and leadership.
  • Ability to absorb, organize, and apply new technical information quickly.
  • Self-motivated, responsible, detail-oriented, coachable, and personable, with a genuine desire to receive and act on feedback.
  • Ability to manage assigned contributions within a supportive team environment while developing resilience to change and pressure.

Travel & Work Arrangements / Requirements:

  • The location for this position is Buffalo, NY. 4 days onsite, 1 day remote.

The pay range for this role is $70,000-$80,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title: Quality Engineer                
Location:  Monroe, LA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring.  Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions. 
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.

Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.
  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.
  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.

Core Competencies 
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement. 
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions. 
  • Customer Focus – Evaluates quality through the customer’s perspective and takes action to improve product performance, reliability, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes personal accountability for commitments, respects deadlines, drives actions to completion, and operates effectively without constant direction.
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds productive relationships across Engineering, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, and other functions to resolve issues and advance quality initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance Excellence – Maintains high standards for quality, process discipline, documentation, and compliance while supporting effective quality management systems.

Preferences: 
  • Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar quality certification.
  • Experience with PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 certified manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T, blueprint reading, and metrology systems.
  • Experience in machining, assembly, pump manufacturing, or other industrial manufacturing environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer audits, supplier visits, training, or other business needs.

Job Title: Field Service Manager, Industrial Compressors & Controls              
Location: Ponoma, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

Pay Range: Total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $125,000 - $160000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Overview:
As the Quality Manager, you'll lead the Quality Department, playing a pivotal role in the local leadership team. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring compliance with ISO-9001 International Quality Standards, developing and maintaining all ISO 9001 procedures and audits at our facility. Collaborating closely with Procurement, you'll guarantee that external suppliers, both domestic and international, deliver raw materials and components that meet our engineering and purchasing specifications. We're seeking a candidate who can serve as a player-coach in a dynamic machining manufacturing environment, fostering effective collaboration with key stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise Quality Team and oversee plant warranty administration.
  • Create and foster a highly engaged and performing team, through strategic talent and engagement plans.
  • Manage plant compliance with ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 Quality System standards, coordinating ISO visits and managing corrective actions from external audits.
  • Drive improvement of First Pass-Yield data, supplier scorecards, warranty trends, and other quality metrics.
  • Manage key processes such as 4D/8D, SCAR, CAPA to enhance Customer Satisfaction and improve Supplier performance.
  • Develop and implement effective quality control processes aligned with customer needs and requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering, and Customer Service Teams to address customer and production issues for product portfolio (legacy and/or new products).
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineers to troubleshoot and resolve quality-related production issues.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to enhance manufacturing processes for purchased components.
  • Actively engage in Kaizen Events and Lean activities to improve quality and reduce manufacturing waste and costs.
  • Utilize advanced Quality Assurance techniques (FMEA, CMM Inspection, GD&T, Gage R&R Studies, Process Capability Studies, Six Sigma, statistical quality/process control methods) to proactively manage product quality.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field (Mechanical/Industrial Engineering).
  • 5+ years of quality assurance experience, ideally in a machining/assembly facility.
  • 3+ years of progressive leadership, managing quality assurance programs and leading audits.
  • 1+ years of experience in Manufacturing/Quality Engineering in machining manufacturing, utilizing Lean Six Sigma techniques.
  • 1+ years of experience in regulatory accreditation processes (UL, CE, ATEX, IECEx, CSA, CSA-UK, TUV, NSF, RoHS, REACH, Prop 65, ITAR, and related).
  • 1+ years of experience in managing and implementing quality control procedures and relevant standards.
  • 1+ years of experience with ERP systems.

Preferences:
  • Engineering Management preferred
  • SAP experience preferred

Core Competencies:

  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and knowledge of general machinery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Suite.
  • Leads Authentically: Exhibits a poised and calm demeanor that instills confidence and respect, while embodying humility and consideration for others. Advocates for the organization's mission and values authentically.
  • Project Management: Proven track record in effectively managing projects, adept at organizing tasks and optimizing time management to handle multiple assignments concurrently within set timelines and budget constraints.
  • Decisiveness and Results Orientation: Demonstrates the ability to make timely decisions with creativity and sound judgment. Utilizes rigorous logic and problem-solving methods to devise effective solutions for complex issues. Capable of articulating rationale clearly and compellingly, ensuring understanding and buy-in from stakeholders. Consistently delivers on commitments.
  • Customer Focus: Committed to meeting the needs and expectations of both internal and external customers, ensuring their satisfaction remains a top priority.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
