Job Title: Field Service Manager, Industrial Compressors & Controls              
Location: Ponoma, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

Pay Range: Total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $125,000 - $160000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. The Sales Manager - Data Center Power Generation will play a key role in supporting some of the world's largest and most advanced data center infrastructure projects. This position is responsible for developing customer relationships, driving business growth, and managing the sales process for medium-voltage generator systems and backup power solutions across hyperscale, colocation, and EPC accounts. As a trusted advisor to customers, the Sales Manager will work closely with engineering, project management, and executive stakeholders to develop power solutions that support mission-critical operations. The role offers the opportunity to engage in large-scale, high-value projects, contribute to the growth of a rapidly expanding market, and collaborate with industry-leading organizations shaping the future of digital infrastructure. This position combines technical and commercial responsibilities, including solution development, account management, project pursuit leadership, proposal development, contract negotiations, and customer engagement throughout the project lifecycle. Candidates will have the opportunity to work on complex power generation applications supporting the continued growth of cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data center technologies.

  • Lead sales efforts for large-scale backup power projects, including pricing, proposal development, contract negotiations, and commercial strategy.
  • Build and maintain relationships with executive and technical stakeholders within strategic accounts and key industry partners.
  • Develop account plans aligned with customer growth, capacity expansion, and long-term infrastructure requirements.

  • Manage project pursuits from opportunity identification through contract award and delivery transition, including change order and risk management.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, order management, and service teams to ensure alignment between customer requirements and project execution.
  • Monitor competitive activity, pricing trends, specification changes, and developments in the data center and power infrastructure markets.
  • Provide market and customer insights to support business planning, product strategy, and go-to-market initiatives.

  • Strategic account planning and management
  • Executive-level stakeholder relationship management
  • Contract negotiation, business communication, and presentation skills
  • Cross-functional team coordination and collaboration
  • Sales pipeline management and forecasting
  • Opportunity assessment and pursuit management
  • Customer relationship development and maintenance
  • Commercial and business planning
  • Market analysis and competitive awareness

Preferences:

  • Experience with long sales cycles (12–36 months)
  • Knowledge of generator systems and backup power applications
  • Knowledge of medium-voltage electrical systems (5-15 kV)
  • Understanding of data center power infrastructure and redundancy architectures
  • Experience with power generation and electrical distribution solutions
  • Commercial proposal development and bid management

  • Deal structuring and commercial agreement management

This is a role designed for a recent graduate or engineer with limited industry experience who is eager to learn centrifugal compressor design fundamentals. Working under the guidance and mentorship of senior engineers, the NPD Engineer will support concept development, detailed mechanical design, and design verification while building the technical foundation needed to grow into an independent contributor. Assignments are typically well-defined in scope and reviewed regularly to support learning and skill development.

Responsibilities:

  • Design support: Assist in developing and releasing mechanical designs for centrifugal compressor components under the direction of senior engineers, including 3D models, drawings, and bills of material.
  • Team collaboration: Participate in cross-functional discussions with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Service teams to understand how product requirements translate into design solutions.
  • Product validation: Build centrifugal compressor prototypes to be used for pre-production testing and verification, implementing any lessons learned during the build into the design.
  • Communication: Communicate progress, questions, and roadblocks clearly and proactively to mentors and the team; actively seek feedback to accelerate learning.
  • Travel: Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 5%.

Qualifications:

  • BS in Mechanical Engineering
  • 1+ years of related design or product development experience with a solid undergraduate foundation in mechanical design, machine design, mechanics of materials, manufacturing processes, and/or engineering fundamentals.

  • Familiarity with CAD/PLM tools (NX and Teamcenter), finite element analysis, or programming is a plus but not required
  • Demonstrated eagerness to learn, strong work ethic, and ability to work in a team environment.

  • Working knowledge of computer systems and basic Microsoft Office.
  • Strong command of the English language with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with peers, mentors, and leadership.

Job Overview 
The IT Cloud Cybersecurity Architect sits within the Infrastructure organization and owns the technical architecture of Ingersoll Rand’s PaaS and SaaS cloud footprint across Azure and AWS – designing scalable, resilient platform patterns while partnering closely with the cybersecurity team to ensure every architecture decision is secure by design. This role bridges infrastructure engineering and security, translating business and application requirements into cloud architecture standards that IR can build on for years to come. 

Responsibilities 

  • Design and evolve enterprise PaaS and SaaS cloud architecture patterns across Azure and AWS, including landing zones, networking, compute, and platform services. 
  • Define architecture standards and reference designs for cloud-native and hybrid workloads, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency across the platform. 
  • Partner closely with the cybersecurity team to embed security, identity, and compliance requirements directly into architecture designs from the outset. 
  • Evaluate and select PaaS/SaaS platforms and services (e.g., database platforms, integration services, application hosting) to meet evolving business and application needs. 
  • Lead technical design reviews for new infrastructure and application projects, ensuring alignment to enterprise architecture standards and roadmap. 
  • Collaborate with network, cloud platform, and DBA teams to ensure architecture decisions integrate cleanly with existing infrastructure and operational practices. 
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, and decision records to guide engineering teams and support audits or reviews. 
  • Stay current on emerging cloud architecture patterns and platform capabilities, recommending adoption where it advances IR’s technology roadmap. 


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture roles, with hands-on design experience across PaaS and SaaS services in Azure and/or AWS. 
  • 2+ years of experience in cloud networking, landing zone design, and platform architecture patterns at enterprise scale. 
  • 2+ years of experience partnering with security or cybersecurity teams to build secure-by-design architecture. 


Core Competencies

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, particularly with cybersecurity, network, and platform engineering teams. 
  • Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery timelines.
  • Ability to translate business and application requirements into scalable, well-documented technical architecture. 
  • Clear communicator, able to present architecture decisions and trade-offs to both technical and business audiences. 
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a remote setting. 


Preferences

  • Industry certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect, CISSP, or CCSP. 
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep) for repeatable architecture deployment. 
  • Familiarity with identity and access management (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID) and its role in secure architecture design. 
  • Experience with compliance and security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, CIS) as they relate to architecture decisions. 
  • Experience in a global industrial manufacturing or OT-adjacent IT environment. 


Travel & Work Arrangements 

  • This position is fully remote, based in the US (Eastern, Central Time Zone) 
  • Minimal travel required, estimated at 0–10% annually for occasional team or project meetings. 


Pay Range:  
The pay range for this role is $150,000 - $180,000, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Job Overview:
There’s a sustainability movement underway in manufacturing that leverages control systems to proactively monitor mission-critical equipment to evaluate & improve efficiencies and predict & prevent system downtime and equipment failures. If you’re looking to be at the leading edge of progress, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated System Design Engineer to join our dynamic team.
Eco plant is seeking a System Design Engineer to help drive the company’s continued expansion in the United States & Canada by being the product technical expert for the North America market. Your primary responsibilities will be to support the Ecoplant sales team as the EcoPlant controls expert during the sales process; design the system architecture and provide technical documentation and support during system installation process; and support troubleshooting with technical expertise for installed systems. You will liaison with the product management team to provide feedback on product design and product enhancements.
 
Responsibilities
  • Provide pre-sales support to the sales team as the technical expert on the product and participate in customer calls as necessary to overcome customer objections.
  • Be the first line of support to answer customer questions on architecture / data security protocols.
  • Occasionally perform a site survey / audit at the customer site, as needed, as part of the pre-sale process to qualify or design a solution for a complex installation.
  • Design the system architecture for a new installation, including the selection of hardware and sensor location; generate the required bill of materials; generate the piping & instrumentation diagram (P&ID) for the new system; and identify the compressor integration strategy.
  • Provide technical specifications to the Ecoplant Engine team to finalize the Dynamic Engine design.
  • Build the customer dashboard prior to installation and support the installation team with remote technical support during installation.
  • Complete all required technical / system documentation post deployment, including as-builts, register mapping, and compressor integration details.
  • Manage the troubleshooting process for any technical issues post-installation, including managing the escalation process to product management and R&DE, as required.
  • Liaison to product management team to provide feedback on product design, product enhancements, and support the development of the product roadmap.
  • Support the training and onboarding of new associates with technical product training, as required.  
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field and/or combination of education
  • 5+ years related industrial controls support experience required.
  • 2+ years’ industrial IT / networking experience and a willingness to learn new skills with installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols required.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience in a technical industry.
  • 1+ years of experience reading blueprints & schematics, coupled with strong technical problem-solving skills required.
  • 1+ years of proficiency in computer applications such as Google and Microsoft Office suite (including Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel) required.
 
Preferences
  • Experience with industrial compressed air systems.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the demonstrated ability to work independently as well as guide the work of others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and self-motivation.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IoT communication protocols (such as Modbus, Profibus, TCP/IP), networking, and data security.
  • The ability to manage multiple urgent issues in parallel.
  • Demonstrated experience with system architecture design, with a focus on industrial systems.  
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements
  • This position is eligible for remote work in the continental United States.
  • Interested candidates should have access to a major airport for travel.
  • Travel up to 30% of time across North America.

Pay Range 
The total pay range for this role is $85,000 - $135,000. The actual pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Location: Lincolnshire, IL

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable regulatory requirements within our medical device manufacturing environment. This role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, including validation activities, process improvements, nonconformance and CAPA management, auditing responsibilities, risk assessments, and training initiatives. The Senior Quality Engineer also collaborates across departments to enhance current manufacturing/quality processes and supports new product introductions. The Senior Quality Engineer is expected to provide guidance and leadership to other members of the quality department, including Document Technicians, Quality Inspectors, and Quality Engineers.  

Responsibilities:
Co-manage the New Product Introduction (NPI) process by ensuring compliance with necessary documentation such as checklists, validation protocols, validation reports, statistical analyses, customer specifications, and relevant ISO documents. 
Assist engineering teams with sustaining manufacturing projects by ensuring compliance with change control, tool and equipment maintenance, and revalidation procedures. 
Review and approve engineering documentation, including validation protocols/reports, sample run requests, and manufacturing procedures, ensuring adherence to customer and regulatory requirements. 
Develop procedures and work instructions to streamline processes n compliance with FDA regulations, ISO standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.  
Review and approve change requests, ensuring proper evaluation of the impact on product quality, processes, and regulatory compliance. 
Lead the resolution of internal and external nonconformances by performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. 
Oversee the investigation of product complaints, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate reporting. 
Represent Flexan effectively during customer and supplier meetings. 
Complete customer surveys and requests in a timely manner.  
Contribute to the Supplier Management Program by assessing new and existing suppliers,  managing the approved supplier list, and other related tasks.   
Manages change requests submitted to customers through completion.  
Provide expertise on environmental and cleanroom requirements, ensuring compliance with relevant guidelines. 
Evaluate new technologies and tools for potential integration into processes to enhance efficiency. 
Monitor key quality metrics and provide regular reports to management. 
Lead risk management activities by conducting risk assessments and pFMEAs sessions, as required 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify equipment, testing, and resource needs, effectively communicating these to management. 
Host or co-host customer and ISO audits, as well as FDA inspections, ensuring preparedness and compliance. 
Serve as a backup for various quality functions, including Document Technicians and Quality Engineers, as needed. 
Support the Quality Manager in the overall maintenance and monitoring of the Quality Management System (QMS). 
Lead initiatives to improve the Quality Management System and participate in the periodic review of documents.  
Conduct employee training sessions. 
Perform internal and external audits as assigned.  
Assist other business units with projects as assigned. 
Engage with key stakeholders to promote a culture of quality throughout the organization. 

Requirements:

  • BA / BS in Engineering or related field. 
  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering or similar experience in a medical device manufacturing environment and/or regulated industry. 
  • 3+ years of experience in process improvement methodologies and technical writing. 
  • 3+ years of success in leading new product introductions with a focus on quality assurance and compliance throughout the development process. 


Core Competencies:

  • Active involvement in FDA and ISO audits, with a strong understanding of regulatory compliance requirements. 


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Fully on-site


The pay range for this role is $80-$120k, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Title: Maintenance Technician

Location: Tulsa, OK (Onsite)

 

Pay Range - Starting pay range for this position is $25.00 - $32.00 per hour.  This is a full-time, hourly position.


About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet operating with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and the planet. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies—from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and powders—to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by 80+ brands, our products serve various end markets including life sciences, food & beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we're driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview

As a Maintenance Technician, you will support manufacturing operations by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining production equipment. This role is responsible for performing preventative maintenance, responding to equipment issues, and helping ensure safe, reliable operation of manufacturing processes. The position is primarily focused on production equipment maintenance, with occasional responsibility for general facility maintenance and repairs.

 

Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative maintenance on manufacturing equipment according to established schedules.
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems.
  • Diagnose equipment issues and perform corrective maintenance to minimize downtime.
  • Inspect equipment and identify worn or defective components requiring repair or replacement.
  • Install, replace, and adjust machine parts and equipment components as needed.
  • Reassemble and test equipment following maintenance or repair activities to ensure proper operation.
  • Read work orders, manuals, schematics, and technical documents to determine repair requirements.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, repair logs, and preventative maintenance documentation.
  • Assist with equipment installations, modifications, and continuous improvement projects.
  • Coordinate with production personnel to prioritize repairs and support manufacturing needs.
  • Maintain spare parts inventories and identify replacement part requirements.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, lifts, hoists, and other maintenance equipment safely.
  • Perform general facility maintenance, including minor repairs to building systems, lighting, plumbing, and infrastructure.
  • Maintain clean and organized maintenance and work areas.
  • Follow all safety policies, lockout/tagout procedures, and company guidelines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of industrial maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting mechanical equipment and production machinery.
  • Working knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, low-voltage control, motor control, and three-phase power systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, manuals, and work instructions.
  • Proficiency with common hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment.
  • Basic computer skills for maintenance documentation and work-order systems.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple maintenance tasks.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical maintenance activities including standing, bending, climbing, and reaching.

 

Core Competencies

  • Mechanical troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Electrical troubleshooting, including low-voltage control circuits, motor controls, and three-phase power systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Effective communication and teamwork.
  • Safety-focused mindset.
  • Time management and organizational skills.
  • Continuous improvement orientation.

 

Preferences

  • Associate degree or technical certification in Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, Electrical Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance programs and CMMS systems.
  • Experience maintaining CNC equipment, assembly equipment, conveyors, or automated manufacturing systems.
  • Forklift, scissor lift, or aerial lift certification.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements

  • Onsite position based in Tulsa, OK.
  • No travel required.
  • Must be available for overtime as needed, including weekends or extended shifts.

 

Pay Range - Starting pay range for this position is $25.00 - $32.00 per hour.  This is a full-time, hourly position.

Job Title: Order Management Specialist
Location:  Campbellsville, KY
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
If you’re someone who enjoys keeping things moving, solving problems, and being the person customers and teammates can count on, this could be a great next step. As an Order Management Specialist, you’ll play an important role in the customer experience—coordinating orders from entry through invoicing, resolving issues or changes, and keeping customers and channel partners informed along the way.  You’ll work closely with operations, sales, finance, and other internal teams to help ensure customer commitments are met and issues are resolved. You’ll also work with account-level details such as pricing, payment terms, invoicing, credits, and order discrepancies, making strong attention to detail and comfort working with numbers especially valuable.

This is more than simply entering orders. It’s an opportunity to take greater ownership of the customer and order process, build strong relationships, solve day-to-day business challenges, and gain broader exposure across a manufacturing organization.  You don’t need to be a highly senior expert to succeed here. If you're early in your career, and have experience in customer service, order support, billing, accounts receivable, cash applications, credit/collections, customer account coordination, or a similar customer-focused business environment with financial or account-level responsibility, your skills may translate well to this opportunity.

If you’re organized, responsive, comfortable working in business systems, skilled at building customer trust, and known for following through, this could be an opportunity to broaden your experience and take on greater end-to-end ownership.

Responsibilities:
  • Customer, Channel Partner & Distributor Support
    • Act as key liaison between assigned Channel Partners and operations to ensure timely delivery of goods.
    • Develop and cultivate effective relationships with key accounts/distribution partners.
    • Manage customer expectations by clearly communicating commitments, including delivery dates and problem resolution, while keeping customers informed of order status, issues, and updates.
    • Execute daily tasks and customer responses with a sense of ownership and urgency.
    • Provide support and training to distributors on order entry application.
  • Order Management & Fulfillment
    • Manage customer orders from placement to invoicing through multiple channels, including phone, fax, EDI, email, and websites to ensure 100% customer satisfaction.
    • Manage Sales Order bookings/backlog in relation to dates, holds, quotes, and P.O. errors.
    • Coordinate cancellation requests with supplier/customer to avoid discrepancies or excess inventory.
  • Systems, Tools & Process Execution
    • Provide high-quality service through efficient use of all Oracle/CRM functionalities related to order fulfillment and customer activity.
    • Identify improvements by using IR Lean tools and methodology through MDI, 9-steps, and RIEs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and people without direct authority.

Requirements:
  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience working in a customer-facing role that involves responsiveness, follow-through, and strong communication skills.
  • 1+ year of experience regularly using an ERP, CRM system or similar system as part of daily work responsibilities.
  • 1+ year of experience using Microsoft Office products as a regular part of daily work responsibilities.

Core Competencies:
  • Customer Focus – Strong service mindset with the ability to communicate clearly, build trust, manage expectations, and support a positive customer experience.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes responsibility for daily tasks, customer responses, and order issues with urgency, accountability, and reliable follow-up.
  • Organization & Prioritization – Able to manage multiple orders, requests, deadlines, and customer needs while keeping details accurate and work moving.
  • Numerical & Account Detail Acumen – Applies sound math logic and attention to detail when reviewing pricing, payment terms, quantities, credits, invoices, account information, and discrepancies to ensure accuracy and identify issues.
  • Resourceful Problem Solving – Uses available tools, systems, documentation, and team resources to work through questions and resolve issues effectively.
  • Team Collaboration – Works effectively with operations, sales, finance, suppliers, distributors, and internal partners to support order flow and customer commitments.

Preferences:
  • Education & Experience: Associate’s or bachelor’s degree; however, relevant experience, customer focus, communication skills, and ability to learn are more important than formal education. Brining prior experience in order management, order fulfillment, distribution support, or related business support environment preferred.
  • Systems & Tools: Experience with Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or similar platforms is especially valued.
  • Order & Account Support: Experience supporting order entry, order fulfillment, shipment coordination, invoicing, backlog management, customer account activity, purchase orders, holds, quotes, pricing, payment terms, or order discrepancies.
  • Customer, Distributor & Channel Support: Experience supporting customers, distributors, channel partners, key accounts, or customer-facing operations.
  • Finance Exposure: Background in a coordinator role as accounts receivable, accounts payable, billing, invoicing, or finance-related support work is a plus

Travel and Work Arrangements
  • This role is based on site in Campbellsville, KY in a manufacturing facility 
  • This position is Monday through Friday; regular schedule is either 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m
  • The office space is located on the second floor and is accessible by stairs; the building does not currently have elevator access.

Position Summary

The Material Handler / Parts Picker is responsible for accurately picking, staging, and delivering materials to support production operations. This role ensures production lines receive the correct materials on time while maintaining inventory accuracy, warehouse organization, and safe material handling practices.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Pick, stage, and deliver materials to support production schedules.
  • Verify part numbers, quantities, and inventory locations.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy and complete material transactions within SAP.
  • Load, unload, move, and store materials safely and efficiently.
  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment.
  • Support shipping, receiving, cycle counts, and inventory control activities.
  • Read work instructions, labels, and production documents.
  • Communicate material shortages, damaged materials, and inventory concerns.
  • Follow all safety policies and procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
 

Qualifications

 

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Ability to obtain forklift certification.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

Preferred:

  • Warehouse, manufacturing, logistics, or material handling experience.
  • Forklift operation experience.
  • SAP or inventory management system experience.
  • Experience supporting production environments.
 

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive movements throughout the shift.
  • Ability to frequently lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Ability to safely operate forklifts and material handling equipment.
 

Key Attributes

  • Detail-oriented and organized.
  • Safety-conscious and dependable.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

  Job Title: Area Service Leader 

Location: Pomona, CA; San Diego, CA; Phoenix, AZ

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

 

Job Summary  

The Area Service Leader position is responsible for providing the leadership for all service activities from the installation of new equipment to the implementation of a services contract through lifetime connectivity with that customer.  Processes within that oversight include support of sales through contract pricing on parts and service, field service coordination, management of technicians and service supervisors, customer satisfaction, and responsibility for the revenue and margin of the parts and service business within the geography.  Provides strategy for connectivity and services growth within the defined region. This position is responsible for service growth for office locations within the West Region (Southern California, Arizona & Nevada).   

 

Responsibilities  

  • Accountable for full services portfolio performance.  Ensure technicians training and skill level is appropriately balanced to service customers, and leverage resources across the area.  This includes emergency repair (break/fix), regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components (parts), and long-term service agreements (Package Care).  

  • Collaborate with the Operations Leader to ensure service coordination processes/functions are aligned with service objectives. Collaborate with sales on contract pricing of parts and services to maintain and enhance profitable service operations. 

  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, and develop all service employees.  Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process and technical skills, to the highest degree possible.    

  • Proactively build the technician and service supervisor pipeline (internally and externally) and strategically manage your workforce to prevent resource gaps.  

  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team.  Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  

  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure a safe and productive work environment both in the shop and at customer sites.  

  • Visit customers on a regular basis to build relationships and provide solutions.  

 

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s Degree required in a related discipline; Engineering, Technical, Marketing or Business preferred. 

  • 5+ years of experience in industrial product space, preferably with a diverse product portfolio including service offerings.   

  • 3+ years management experience, preferably in a customer facing environment.  

 

Key Competencies 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Leadership skills are essential. Individual must be able to manage an hourly technical workforce, including remote employees, as well as salaried staff.   

  • Work is completed through other employees, so this person must excel at hiring, developing, training, coaching, leading and motivating a diverse workforce for optimal results.   

  • Profit & Loss experience is critical. Individual must have experience in forecasting needs, obtaining resources, and managing budgets.? 

  • A strategic business mindset is important. This individual must be able to support the Regional Director in creation of a strategic business plan for growing the service business through internal process improvements and lean strategies to positively impact our market position.
     

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent from a four-year college or university 
  • Technical and/or mechanical capabilities are a plus.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements  

This position will be based out of one of the West region area customer centers with regional and overnight, out of town travel required (30%). 

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role, including incentive compensation, is $100,000 - $200,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case

Job Title: Designer/Draftsman

Location: Charleroi, PA

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
The Designer / Draftsman handles design drafting or technical assignments including the preparation of designs of conventional products, assemblies and components, complicated layout and detail drawings, bill of materials or technical machine or composition assignments.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilizes computer aided engineering, analytical, and sophisticated instrumentation technology to assist in the development of company products. Maintains professional technical competence in fields of engineering science.
  • Designs or redesigns complicated equipment and/or technical compositions. Utilizes calculations, standards, and procedures provided by the Design Supervisor or Applications/Project Engineer to complete projects. Produces designs, complex layouts, assemblies, detail parts list Drawings on the CAD system and generates associated bills of material. Revises assembly and parts list drawings to correspond to changes made to detail drawings and bills of material.
  • Constructs Layout and detail drawing calculations. Performs some design analysis using established engineering methods.
  • Follows up to expedite and correct drawings, bills of material and engineering documents. Works with QA to ensure quality and ISO standards are met.
  • Follows ISO and other global quality standards/guidelines as required regarding design and production of new/revised products. Assists manufacturing and quality departments in correcting any problems encountered in the machine shop or on the assembly floor.
  • Prepares or assists others in preparing project time estimates and product cost comparisons, selects materials, commercial parts and technical data.
  • Provides clear, concise, and precise verbal and written communications.
  • Works with Customer Service, Field Service and Manufacturing personnel to resolve issues.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned or required.

Requirements:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience.
  • Good communication skills required to be effective with customers and company contacts.
  • Extensive knowledge of drafting standards, symbols, nomenclature, engineering terms, bills of material, proper use of material and engineering reference books and catalogs required.
  • Comprehensive abilities in layout and detail drafting techniques, using AutoCAD/Inventor system needed.
  • Microsoft Office software experience.

Preferences:

  • Associate Degree in Mechanical Drafting or equivalent; computer experience in AutoCAD/Inventor (with emphasis on structural steel and piping).
  • Vault and SAP experience.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Charleroi, PA

  Job Title: Area Service Leader 

Location: Pomona, CA; San Diego, CA; Phoenix, AZ

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

 

Job Summary  

The Area Service Leader position is responsible for providing the leadership for all service activities from the installation of new equipment to the implementation of a services contract through lifetime connectivity with that customer.  Processes within that oversight include support of sales through contract pricing on parts and service, field service coordination, management of technicians and service supervisors, customer satisfaction, and responsibility for the revenue and margin of the parts and service business within the geography.  Provides strategy for connectivity and services growth within the defined region. This position is responsible for service growth for office locations within the West Region (Southern California, Arizona & Nevada).   

 

Responsibilities  

  • Accountable for full services portfolio performance.  Ensure technicians training and skill level is appropriately balanced to service customers, and leverage resources across the area.  This includes emergency repair (break/fix), regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components (parts), and long-term service agreements (Package Care).  

  • Collaborate with the Operations Leader to ensure service coordination processes/functions are aligned with service objectives. Collaborate with sales on contract pricing of parts and services to maintain and enhance profitable service operations. 

  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, and develop all service employees.  Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process and technical skills, to the highest degree possible.    

  • Proactively build the technician and service supervisor pipeline (internally and externally) and strategically manage your workforce to prevent resource gaps.  

  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team.  Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  

  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure a safe and productive work environment both in the shop and at customer sites.  

  • Visit customers on a regular basis to build relationships and provide solutions.  

 

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s Degree required in a related discipline; Engineering, Technical, Marketing or Business preferred. 

  • 5+ years of experience in industrial product space, preferably with a diverse product portfolio including service offerings.   

  • 3+ years management experience, preferably in a customer facing environment.  

 

Key Competencies 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Leadership skills are essential. Individual must be able to manage an hourly technical workforce, including remote employees, as well as salaried staff.   

  • Work is completed through other employees, so this person must excel at hiring, developing, training, coaching, leading and motivating a diverse workforce for optimal results.   

  • Profit & Loss experience is critical. Individual must have experience in forecasting needs, obtaining resources, and managing budgets.? 

  • A strategic business mindset is important. This individual must be able to support the Regional Director in creation of a strategic business plan for growing the service business through internal process improvements and lean strategies to positively impact our market position.
     

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent from a four-year college or university 
  • Technical and/or mechanical capabilities are a plus.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements  

This position will be based out of one of the West region area customer centers with regional and overnight, out of town travel required (30%). 

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role, including incentive compensation, is $100,000 - $200,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.

job.title: Assembler
job.description:
Title: Assembler 

Location: Campbellsville, KY 

Shift: 6:00am-2:30pm (Mon.-Fri.) OT work until 4:30pm


About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview:

Assemble various models of product while working at a bench or on the shop floor by performing the following duties. 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble parts according to standard work / job breakdown sheets of unit being assembled, bill of materials and work order instructions, and assembly drawings 
  • Fastens parts together with bolts, screws, speed clips, rivets, or other fasteners according to torque specifications 
  • Operates pneumatic and manual presses to assist in assembly operation, which includes setting up the presses 
  • Set-up and operate identification equipment (stampers, labelers, etc.) 
  • Test product for compliance to meet specifications using manual and automatic test equipment 
  • Paint, label and pack completed product for shipment 
  • Achieve daily departmental productivity and quality levels 
  • Follow all ISO procedures and safety rules, including wearing personal safety equipment 
  • Keep Team Lead informed of mechanical/machine malfunctions or any supplies/tools needed 
  • Handle product to and from stock 
  • Perform in-process testing and make necessary corrections to meet standard work and Procedures for Qualification (PFQ) 
  • Notify team lead of non-conformance material 
  • Report changes in work orders, bill of materials, and pick lists to team lead. 
  • Contribute to department/cell communication boards 
  • Check off and sign work order cover sheets 
  • Complete daily hour by hour production sheet 
  • Maintain work area in accordance with 5S standards 
  • Identify and report all safety issues to team lead 
  • Participate and/or lead continuous improvement events and training 
  • Suggest ideas for overall improvements to the area processes 
  • Cross-train across multiple product lines 
  • Perform additional duties as assigned 

 

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of experience in a manufacturing setting

 

Core Competencies:

  • Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
  • Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
  • Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
  • Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
  • Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, multi-tasked environment.

 

Preferences:

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing setting preferred.
  • Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
  • Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
  • Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position will be based on-site

Job Overview:
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets of Nash, Garo and Runtech products in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the manufacturers representative network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Nash, Garo & Runtech products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, OEMs, Product Management, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintaining a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.

Location:  Charlotte, NC 
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview:
Ready to lead where materials strategy directly impacts customers, operations, and results?  As Materials Manager, you will lead an experienced team of Buyer-Planners responsible for purchasing, materials planning, inventory, supplier performance, and aftermarket kit readiness within a complex manufacturing operation. Your leadership will help ensure the right materials are in the right place at the right time—supporting both legacy and next-generation compressor products.

This is more than a scheduling role. You will be the go-to leader when materials issues get difficult—supplier delays, held orders, inventory concerns, source changes, planning gaps, or cross-functional breakdowns. You will dig into root causes, drive solutions, build sustainable processes, and empower your team to prevent issues from recurring. You will also own key materials priorities including inventory performance, on-time delivery, supplier past dues, labor productivity, and continuous improvement, while partnering across Sourcing, Quality, Engineering, Operations, Order Management, and Customer Service. With an Oracle-to-SAP transition ahead, you will have a meaningful opportunity to shape processes, strengthen performance, and lead the team through significant operational change.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of people leadership and hands-on materials expertise. You know how to develop talent, establish accountability, and set clear priorities—but you are equally comfortable stepping into the details when the business needs you. Most importantly, you can demonstrate where you have solved complex materials problems, identified root causes, implemented lasting improvements, and measured the results. You bring the technical credibility, analytical mindset, and leadership presence to bring clarity to complexity and turn challenges into sustainable operational improvement.

If you are ready to lead a strong team, solve meaningful operational challenges, and make a measurable impact across the business, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead all site materials management activities, including production scheduling, purchasing, inventory control, material movement, indirect materials, and supplier performance.
  • Drive end-to-end material fulfillment from production planning and procurement through warehousing and product shipment.
  • Implement, sustain, and ensure compliance with Materials and SIOP standard work, processes, and systems.
  • Manage materials, suppliers, and inventory within a Lean Six Sigma manufacturing environment, leveraging MRP to improve flow, availability, and inventory performance.
  • Monitor key materials and supplier performance, identify gaps and root causes, and implement countermeasures that deliver measurable, sustainable improvement.
  • Lead, develop, and organize a team of 12–15 Material Planners/Buyers, including performance management, workload allocation, coaching, succession planning, and professional development.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sourcing, Engineering, Accounting, Marketing, Operations, Quality, and Global Procurement to support business priorities, supplier selection, and strategic goals.
  • Strengthen supplier relationships and foster a culture of problem solving, accountability, Daily Management, and continuous improvement across the materials organization.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or another relevant discipline. 
  • 5+ years of experience in the integrated functions of a manufacturing environment that has embraced lean concepts, MRP manufacturing practices, and progressive supplier relationships. 
  • 3+ years in managerial experience focusing on standardizing planning & execution, reducing sourcing complexity, and talent development. 
  • 2+ years experience in operations, inventory management, MRP and lean manufacturing processes. 
  • 1+ years experience with visual management systems. 


Core Competencies
Success in this role requires the following core capabilities and demonstrated strengths.

  • Materials Systems & Manufacturing Flow – Strong knowledge of manufacturing material flow and integrated systems supporting materials management, production planning, procurement, and distribution; proficiency with MRP/ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
  • Leadership & Change Management – Ability to motivate and develop teams, foster collaboration, and lead change while applying Lean methodologies and continuous improvement principles.
  • Problem Solving & Business Impact – Decisive, proactive problem solver who can identify issues, drive solutions, and influence bottom-line results.
  • Communication & Cross-Functional Partnership – Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across functions, support internal customers, and effectively resolve conflict.
  • Execution & Adaptability – Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities, make sound decisions, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure manufacturing environment.


Preferences:

  • APICS Certification in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM)


Travel and Work Arrangements 

  • This is an onsite role based from our Distribution and Logistics Center

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.
Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
Responsibilities
  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 
  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.
  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 
  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.
  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 
  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 
  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.
Requirements
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. 
Core Competencies 
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years
  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences
  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 
  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 
  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.
