Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM 
Hourly Range: $25.00 - $40.00, weekly pay, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

Locations: 
Minneapolis, MN
Kansas City, MO 
Des Moines, IA
Denver, CO
Omaha, NE 
West Fargo, ND
Wichita, KS
Portland, OR

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. 

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment — as well as for our individual well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.

Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.

TO APPLY: Please apply via our website https://careers.irco.com by 12/31/2026 in order to be considered for this position.

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Can be located at one of our Compression Systems manufacturing locations in United States


About Us

Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Sourcing Engineer to support sourcing for our Norther American compressor products. This person will be a member of our Industrial Technologies & Services Americas Sourcing Organization, supporting the development, implementation, and management of standard and engineered to order products to provide Ingersoll Rand with optimal supply assurance, pricing, flexibility, quality, and delivery performance. The Sourcing Engineer builds and leverages strong working relationships with our engineering teams and key suppliers to ensure cost, quality, and delivery targets are met, as well as works towards good supplier relationships to achieve maximum advantage for Ingersoll Rand and our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations and supplier selection
  • Continuously looks for new savings opportunities through analysis of data (spend, purchase price variance, etc.) and hands on review of materials in the production areas.
  • Leads Request for Proposal (RFP) process with all stakeholders.
  • Works with suppliers and internal team members to qualify new parts.
  • Negotiates key items with suppliers including pricing, payment terms, lead time, and inventory programs.
  • Records and tracks information as required for timely and accurate measure of performance regarding sourcing activities and savings.
  • Support the plants to help local teams efficiently resolve escalated issues.
  • Leads Procurement NPD activities through preferred supplier programs and RFQ's.
  • Identify gaps to goals and collaboratively develop and support countermeasures and activities to close the gap and exceed targets.
  • Work to align strategies between commodity and sector localization, plant rationalization and similar
  • Works with suppliers to address significant and/or systemic issues with performance (quality, delivery, warranty, etc.) as may be required in support of plant Manufacturing, Purchasing and Quality teams
  • Responsible for coordinating with commodity teams, materials, operations, engineering, finance, quality, and field operations to complete projects and achieve expected benefits within project timeline.
  • Creates continuous improvement ideation sessions for responsible plants. Generate and evaluate new ideas and opportunities aligned with plant priorities and strategies.
  • Participate in and represent Sourcing function during plant or product Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) or Major Model Review (MMR) events. Responsible for collecting and communicating commodity actions following event.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned and participates in special projects as required.
 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering or equivalent
  • 5+ years' experience of progressively responsible job-related experience
  • 3+ years' experience using Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word, is required.
  • 5+ years' experience well-developed negotiation skills and assessing vendors.
 

Core Competencies:

  • Complex Decision-Making
  • Impeccable time-management
  • Supply Chain Acumen
  • Project Management
  • Relationship Management
  • Strong bias for action and results orientation
  • Must be a self-starter; motivated with expert overall sourcing expertise.
  • Incumbent must have strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated effective leadership and influencing skills and practices
  • Experience coordinating, facilitating discussions, consultation and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability and willingness to understand and interact with diverse groups and cultures
  • Evidence of skills & attributes including effective listening, gathering complete information, ensuring accuracy, problem-solving, negotiating, researching discrepancies, and handling conflict are critical.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, meet compressed deadlines, and handle frequent interruptions is essential.
  • Ability and willingness to respond quickly and appropriately in a dynamic, fast paced work environment and the flexibility to withstand challenging situations

Preferences:
  • Background in engineering or technical sourcing.
  • Oracle & SAP experience in a global environment is beneficial.
  • Experience in manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated career progression.
  • Proficiency using Excel at an advanced level (use financial and logical functions; work with multiple worksheets and workbooks; edit and use macros/ import and export information) is strongly preferred.
  • Previous lean manufacturing or 6 Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt experience a plus.
  • Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data, confirming its accuracy and adequacy, and using it to drive decisions as well as present results and business cases to management

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements: 

  • Fully site based
  • Can be located at one of our Compression Systems manufacturing locations in United States
  • Ability to travel up to 10%

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $80,000 - $90,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. .

Core Competencies 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Location: Remote, United States – must be located within 2 hours of a major airport.
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM (may vary based on customer and project needs)
Salary Range: $75,000 - $120,000 annually, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training. $3000 Sign On Bonus! 

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers. For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities.?

  • Handling inbound customer requests to generate sales of compressed air products, services, and parts.  
  • Assist customers with parts identification and generate quotes for customers to ensure quotes successfully transition to orders.  
  • Manage these orders to ensure delivery schedule is achieved.  
  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.  
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.  
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.  
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance.
  • Operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.  
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 2+ years of customer service experience 

Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity.   
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely   
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods    
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task.  
  • Thinks and acts strategically   
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner  
Preferences:

  • Associates Degree or 2-3 years of relevant experience required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred  
  • Technical background highly preferred  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications required; ability to navigate internal software programs will be needed after hire  
  • SalesForce experience a plus  
  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position will be based in Greer, SC and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview: 
We are seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and results-oriented Sourcing Engineer to support our NASH, Hibon, Fruitland, Excelsior Blower Systems, and Stamford Scientific International  Aeration. The Sourcing Engineer will be a member of our  Process Flow Technologies Sourcing Organization providing Ingersoll Rand with optimal supply assurance, pricing, flexibility, quality, and delivery performance. The Sourcing Engineer builds and leverages strong working relationships with our engineering, operations and quality teams and key suppliers to ensure achievement of cost, quality, and delivery targets, as well as work towards good supplier relationships to achieve maximum results for Ingersoll Rand and our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations and supplier selection
  • Continuously looks for new savings opportunities through analysis of data (spend, purchase price variance, etc.) and hands on review of materials in the production areas.
  • Leads Request for Proposal (RFP) process with all stakeholders.
  • Works with suppliers and internal team members to qualify new parts.
  • Negotiates key items with suppliers including pricing, payment terms, lead time, and inventory programs.
  • Leads Supplier Development initiative for chronic poor performance suppliers
  • Records and tracks information as required for timely and accurate measure of performance regarding sourcing activities and savings.
  • Support the plants to help local teams efficiently resolve escalated issues.
  • Identify gaps to goals and collaboratively develop and support countermeasures and activities to close the gap and exceed targets.
  • Work to align strategies between commodity and sector localization, plant rationalization and similar
  • Works with suppliers to address significant and/or systemic issues with performance (quality, delivery, warranty, etc.) as may be required in support of plant Manufacturing, Purchasing and Quality teams
  • Responsible for coordinating with commodity teams, materials, operations, engineering, finance, quality, and field operations to complete projects and achieve expected benefits within project timeline.
  • Creates continuous improvement ideation sessions for responsible plants. Generate and evaluate new ideas and opportunities aligned with plant priorities and strategies.
  • Participate in and represent Sourcing function during plant or product Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) or Major Model Review (MMR) events. Responsible for collecting and communicating commodity actions following event.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned and participates in special projects as required

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of sourcing experience.
  • 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word. Proficiency using Excel at an advanced level (use financial and logical functions; work with multiple worksheets and workbooks; edit and use macros/ import and export information) is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies:

  • Incumbent must have well-developed negotiation skills and assessing vendors.
  • Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data, confirming its accuracy and adequacy, and using it to drive decisions as well as present results and business cases to management.
  • Strategic communication with suppliers through data based decision making & strong negotiation skills.

Preferences:

  • Lean manufacturing related experience.
  • Experience using Oracle or SAP.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Sedalia, MO; Springfield, MO; or Bentleyville, PA.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Job Title: Service Technician  
Location: Staunton/Lynchburg/Roanoke, VA area

About Us  

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. .

Core Competencies 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

What we Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Overview:

This is an Inside Sales & Service - Parts position based out of the Norcross Customer Center. The role includes sales support from the time of inquiry to delivery, which requires parts identification, quoting, order confirmation/purchase order receipt, pricing, order processing, expediting, and problem solving. As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers. For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities.? 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Handling inbound customer requests to generate sales of compressed air products, services, and parts.  
  • Assist customers with parts identification and generate quotes for customers to ensure quotes successfully transition to orders.  
  • Manage these orders to ensure delivery schedule is achieved.  
  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.  
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.  
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.  
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance.
  • Operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.  
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.  
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.


Requirements: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 2+ years of customer service experience 


Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity.   
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely   
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods    
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task.  
  • Thinks and acts strategically   
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner  

Preferences:

  • Associates Degree or 2-3 years of relevant experience required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred  
  • Technical background highly preferred  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications required; ability to navigate internal software programs will be needed after hire  
  • SalesForce experience a plus  
  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position will be based in Greer, SC and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move 40+ lbs.

Job Overview: 
The Procurement Specialist plays a key role in supporting operations by ensuring that goods and services are sourced, ordered, and received accurately and efficiently. This role requires strong attention to detail, timely execution of purchasing activities, and consistent communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors. The Procurement Specialist will be responsible for maintaining vendor relationships, monitoring order status, and ensuring alignment with company policies to support smooth operational performance. 

Responsibilities:

  • Vendor Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor files; support vendor onboarding; negotiate pricing, terms, and service agreements; resolve vendor performance issues; and monitor delivery status to ensure alignment with purchase orders and company expectations. 
  • Purchase Order Administration: Review and process Purchase Requisitions; prepare, enter, and issue Purchase Orders within the accounting system; ensure timely and accurate order execution; and verify that all purchasing activities adhere to established policies, budgets, and approval workflows. 
  • Vendor Payment Coordination: Compile all required documentation—including Purchase Orders, receiving documents, vendor invoices, and supporting materials—to facilitate timely vendor payments. Provide complete and accurate packets to the Controller & Advisor and resolve any discrepancies promptly. 
  • Inventory Support: Assist with inventory control activities, including assigning part numbers, tracking stock levels, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure adequate supply availability and inventory accuracy. 
  • Shipment & Logistics Communication: Coordinate with Department Heads (Sales, Production, etc.) to provide timely updates on shipment status, delivery schedules, delays, and any procurement related issues impacting operations. Escalate concerns as necessary to maintain workflow continuity. 
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline procurement processes, improve vendor performance, reduce costs, and enhance overall purchasing efficiency. 


Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or G.E.D.
  • 3+ years of procurement experience.


Core Competencies:

  • Proficiency with computer systems and applications, with strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in all data entry and documentation.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound, independent decisions in accordance with established policies and guidelines. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, accounting, or related field.
  • Prior experience with accounting or bookkeeping related function.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • This position will be onsite in Austin, TX.

job.title: Welding Dept Supervisor
job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Job Title: Welding Department Supervisor 
Location: Ocala, FL - Fully onsite 
 

Summary Responsible for the effective direction of the Welding Department, involving full accountability for results in terms of costs, methods, quality and quantity of production, operations and personnel by performing the following duties.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and manage production: Schedule and coordinate Welding/Fabrication/Hydro department work based on production schedules and customer shipment commitments, while monitoring workflow and progress.
  • Lead safety initiatives: Conduct toolbox talks, safety meetings, and job hazard assessments while promoting a safe, clean, and organized work environment.
  • Control quality and materials: Enforce welding procedures and standards, monitor material usage, minimize scrap and rework, and ensure welds meet applicable codes and specifications.
  • Supervise employees: Directly supervise up to 25 employees, including assigning work, training, performance management, hiring, discipline, and resolving employee concerns.
  • Coordinate across departments: Work closely with Production Control, Engineering, and other departments to schedule orders, resolve specification issues, and maintain production commitments.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Evaluate welding processes, equipment, and new industry developments; recommend improvements that increase efficiency, productivity, and cost savings.
  • Monitor and report performance: Prepare production reports and participate in production meetings, tracking quality, labor utilization, safety, delays, and schedule attainment while taking corrective action when needed.
  • Manage technical and external relationships: Coordinate inspections and welding certifications, provide technical guidance, and serve as a liaison with engineering personnel, clients, and outside welding inspectors.

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of related experience/training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Core Competencies                                                   

  • Welding: Knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division I requirements, TIG, MIG, SMA, and stick welding, as well as ASNT-TC-1A NDT testing and acceptance criteria.
  • Lean Manufacturing & Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves issues efficiently, analyzes information, develops solutions, and works effectively in group problem-solving situations.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Resolves conflicts constructively, listens to others, maintains confidentiality, controls emotions, and remains open to new ideas.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly and persuasively, listens effectively, responds to questions, participates in meetings, and produces clear written documentation.
  • Teamwork: Balances individual and team responsibilities, welcomes feedback, builds team morale, and prioritizes shared goals and success.
  • Leadership: Motivates and influences others, accepts feedback, recognizes contributions, and encourages strong performance.
  • People Management: Involves employees in planning and improvement, provides feedback, develops staff skills, encourages growth, and continuously improves supervisory practices.
  • Quality Management: Promotes continuous quality improvement while maintaining accuracy, thoroughness, and high standards in processes, products, and services.
  • Language Skills: Ability to read and interpret business, technical, and regulatory materials; write reports, correspondence, and procedures; and communicate effectively with managers, customers, clients, and the public.
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to apply probability, statistics, geometry, trigonometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to solve practical problems, evaluate variable situations, and interpret written, verbal, diagram, and schedule-based instructions.
  • Computer Skills: Proficiency with database, manufacturing, spreadsheet, and word-processing software.
  • Certifications: Preferred or required certifications include AWS Certified Welding Supervisor, CWI, or SCWI.
  • Technical Skills: Thorough knowledge of ASME welding codes for pressure vessels and welding processes including MIG, TIG, and Sub-Arc.
Preferences: 
  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university,
  • Physical & Work Environment: Ability to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach, communicate, and occasionally climb or lift up to 25 pounds; work may involve mechanical equipment, welding fumes/airborne particles, humidity, and moderate noise.

Pay Range:   
The pay range for this role is $80,000-$100,000.  The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title:
Sewing Operator - Level One - Operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of our products.

Location: ILC Dover/Ingersoll Rand - Frederica, Delaware 19946

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview:
We are seeking a Sewing Operator to operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of our products. This is an entry-level (Level One) position on our Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM shift at our non-union Frederica, DE facility. A formal skills evaluation determines progression to the next level; time in position is not necessarily a factor in promotion.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Sew materials by hand and/or sewing machine to join, gather, reinforce, or decorate materials or fabricated articles
  • Use specialized automatic or semi-automatic sewing equipment and other equipment as required to fabricate product
  • Cut materials according to specifications, including cutting excess material or thread from finished product using a blade, scissors, or hot knife
  • Position and mark patterns on materials to prepare for sewing; fold or fit materials together for machine or hand sewing
  • Position materials through feed rollers and guides, maneuvering under the sewing machine presser foot and needle during operation
  • Mount attachments, change needles, thread the machine, set up the bobbin, and adjust machine guides according to specifications
  • Monitor machine operation to detect problems such as defective stitching, thread breaks, or malfunction; examine and measure finished articles using a ruler to verify conformance to standards
  • Responsible for the quality and accuracy of product fabrication per work instructions and/or drawings, and for adherence to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)

 

 

Requirements:

  • Able to work on government contracts directly or access shared data resources (authorized to work in the U.S.)
  • High school diploma or equivalent, e.g. GED
  • Able to effectively communicate in English (read, write, speak)
  • Knowledgeable of basic math and English measurement, measurements can be as small as 1/32nd(versus metric)
  • Demonstrated communication and team collaboration skills
  • Basic sewing skills and ability to successfully pass ILC Dover sewing aptitude evaluation
  • Able to manage basic sewing tasks; may require guidance and assistance.
  • Must complete a skills evaluation period to determine skill level going forward; up to 12 months in a training period is possible.

 

Core Competencies:

  • Able to manage basic sewing tasks; may require guidance and assistance, with up to a 12-month training/skills evaluation period possible
  • Regularly works near moving mechanical parts and is frequently exposed to heat (non-weather); occasional exposure to toxic or caustic chemicals; moderate noise levels
  • Regularly required to stand, use hands to finger/handle/feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear; frequently required to walk, sit, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Able to regularly lift/move up to 20 lbs, frequently up to 30 lbs, and occasionally up to 50 lbs
  • Vision abilities required include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
Fully site based - Only

Location: Remote, United States – must be located within 2 hours of a major airport.
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM (may vary based on customer and project needs)
Salary Range: $75,000 - $120,000 annually, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training. $3000 Sign On Bonus!

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Sourcing Engineer to support sourcing for our Norther American compressor products. This person will be a member of our Industrial Technologies & Services Americas Sourcing Organization, supporting the development, implementation, and management of standard and engineered to order products to provide Ingersoll Rand with optimal supply assurance, pricing, flexibility, quality, and delivery performance. The Sourcing Engineer builds and leverages strong working relationships with our engineering teams and key suppliers to ensure cost, quality, and delivery targets are met, as well as works towards good supplier relationships to achieve maximum advantage for Ingersoll Rand and our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations and supplier selection
  • Continuously looks for new savings opportunities through analysis of data (spend, purchase price variance, etc.) and hands on review of materials in the production areas.
  • Leads Request for Proposal (RFP) process with all stakeholders.
  • Works with suppliers and internal team members to qualify new parts.
  • Negotiates key items with suppliers including pricing, payment terms, lead time, and inventory programs.
  • Records and tracks information as required for timely and accurate measure of performance regarding sourcing activities and savings.
  • Support the plants to help local teams efficiently resolve escalated issues.
  • Leads Procurement NPD activities through preferred supplier programs and RFQ's.
  • Identify gaps to goals and collaboratively develop and support countermeasures and activities to close the gap and exceed targets.
  • Work to align strategies between commodity and sector localization, plant rationalization and similar
  • Works with suppliers to address significant and/or systemic issues with performance (quality, delivery, warranty, etc.) as may be required in support of plant Manufacturing, Purchasing and Quality teams
  • Responsible for coordinating with commodity teams, materials, operations, engineering, finance, quality, and field operations to complete projects and achieve expected benefits within project timeline.
  • Creates continuous improvement ideation sessions for responsible plants. Generate and evaluate new ideas and opportunities aligned with plant priorities and strategies.
  • Participate in and represent Sourcing function during plant or product Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) or Major Model Review (MMR) events. Responsible for collecting and communicating commodity actions following event.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned and participates in special projects as required.
 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering or equivalent
  • 5+ years' experience of progressively responsible job-related experience
  • 3+ years' experience using Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word, is required.
  • 5+ years' experience well-developed negotiation skills and assessing vendors.
 

Core Competencies:

  • Complex Decision-Making
  • Impeccable time-management
  • Supply Chain Acumen
  • Project Management
  • Relationship Management
  • Strong bias for action and results orientation
  • Must be a self-starter; motivated with expert overall sourcing expertise.
  • Incumbent must have strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated effective leadership and influencing skills and practices
  • Experience coordinating, facilitating discussions, consultation and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability and willingness to understand and interact with diverse groups and cultures
  • Evidence of skills & attributes including effective listening, gathering complete information, ensuring accuracy, problem-solving, negotiating, researching discrepancies, and handling conflict are critical.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, meet compressed deadlines, and handle frequent interruptions is essential.
  • Ability and willingness to respond quickly and appropriately in a dynamic, fast paced work environment and the flexibility to withstand challenging situations

Preferences:
  • Background in engineering or technical sourcing.
  • Oracle & SAP experience in a global environment is beneficial.
  • Experience in manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated career progression.
  • Proficiency using Excel at an advanced level (use financial and logical functions; work with multiple worksheets and workbooks; edit and use macros/ import and export information) is strongly preferred.
  • Previous lean manufacturing or 6 Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt experience a plus.

  • Fully site based

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
•    Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
•    Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
•    Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
•    Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
•    Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
•    Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
•    High school diploma or GED required.
•    Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
•    Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
•    Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
•    Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
•    Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
•     Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences: 
•      Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred. 
•      Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment. 
•     EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred. 
•     Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred. 
•     Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment. 
•     Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•      Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.

The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

About Us 
Cullum & Brown is an industry leading industrial equipment distributor and service company.  With over 135 years of industry experience, Cullum & Brown is a reliable solutions provider with locations in Kansas City and Springfield. We are an authorized distributor of Gardner Denver, Elmo Rietschle, Hoffman, Lamson, Tuthill pumps, Crane Deming, Travaini vacuum pumps, Graco, Dean Pumps, Grundfos, PowerEx, and Great Lakes. Cullum & Brown is proud to offer 24/7 emergency customer service for not only the brands we sell, but all makes and models. Our 18 factory-trained and certified technicians are prepared and the best in the industry. Join our team!  

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Cullum & Brown's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
