  Job Summary:

Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring an Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory in the  Region. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area.  Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfil industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within the Customer Center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures. 
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the Customer Center.
  • Earn Customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions. 
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.
 Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 4+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting or successful completion of the Ingersoll Rand Sales Development Program (SDP).
Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented.
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently.
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required.
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions
  • Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software is preferred
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts
  • Must have excellent prioritization and time management skills
Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent
  • Knowledge of Salesforce
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Regional travel to customer sites is required within assigned geographic territory.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations included, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, Multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
Pay Range:

 The total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $60,000 - $180,000. The total pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

Our air-displacement and positive-displacement pumps offer exceptional flow stability and precision for low-volume dispensing.  Backed by over 40 years of engineering excellence and innovation, TriContinent stands out as the reliable choice for OEMs worldwide. Come join a nimble and knowledgeable team with an established and well respected product.

Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
This position is responsible for work on designing and implementing custom mechanical and electromechanical products and sub-systems for Tricontinent Syringe pumps and other equipment. This position requires Product Development experience, knowledge of process capability, materials knowledge, troubleshooting aptitude, and understanding of fluidics. The position also requires data acquisition experience and the ability to use Machine tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Research & Evaluation: Evaluates existing products for re-design, reliability, improved function, or value engineering
  • Designs precision machined components for fluidic systems
  • Designs linear mechanical drive systems
  • Identifies and defines new product requirements
  • Participates in value engineering initiatives for our division.
  • Production Processing: Support activities to introduce new production, including manufacturability improvements.
  • Design: Create all documentation needed for new or updated products, including drawings, BOMs, product quality documents.
  • Testing: Coordinates all product test activities. Builds and tests prototypes.
  • Work directly with other engineers to design and develop quality products
  • Product designs and design layouts are developed from ideas, sketches and verbal instruction
  • Take product design from concept to production    
  • Responsible for timely, efficient, and quality execution of the assigned tasks
  • Create finished drawings of parts and assemblies
  • Execution of ECO (Engineering Change Order) documentation changes
  • Work with vendors, manufacturing, and engineering to procure parts and build prototypes
  • Develop schedules and time estimates for product design and modification
  • Write project reports such as project status reports


Requirements:

  • BS Degree in Mechanical Engineering
  • 4+ years working in design
  • 2+ years of experience with solid modeling software preferably SolidWorks
  • Experience doing design layouts and tolerance studies
  • Expertise in the design and integration of complex electromechanical systems in regulated or high-precision environments

Preferences:
  • Experience with robotic systems, medical device design, and/or biotechnology diagnostic equipment development
  • Background in engineering and product development for robotics, healthcare devices, or diagnostic instrumentation
  • 4+ years working in a mechanical engineering 
  • General Machining Skills working with metals and plastics (lathe and mill work)
  • Design Reviews and Design Verification Testing
  • Experience, exposure to designing plastic injection molded parts
  • General knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and their application
  • Ability to inspect parts using applicable measuring devices, Micrometers, Calipers, Optical comparator, etc.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
  • Onsite
The pay range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title:  Sustaining Engineer Manager

Location: Sheboygan, WI 
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  
 
 
Job Overview:
The Sustaining Engineering Manager oversees all activities related to legacy product support, including production troubleshooting, supplier obsolescence management, cost-reduction initiatives, and design improvements (I2V). This role is responsible for setting team priorities, developing engineering talent, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals. The manager serves as the primary interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and external partners to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement for legacy products. Lead and manage the Sustaining Engineering team responsible for supporting and improving legacy pump products, ensuring production continuity, supply chain resilience, and ongoing product quality through strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration.
 
Responsibilities: 
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of sustaining engineers to support legacy pump production lines.
  • Oversee and prioritize the resolution of complex production and supplier issues to minimize downtime and ensure supply continuity.
  • Direct the identification and qualification of alternative components and suppliers to address obsolescence and mitigate supply risks.
  • Guide and approve I2V (Innovation to Value), cost-reduction, and design simplification projects to improve product performance and reduce costs.
  • Ensure all engineering changes and documentation updates comply with regulatory, quality, and company standards.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action for recurring or high-impact production and field issues.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and R&D leadership to align on priorities and resource allocation.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to sustaining engineering activities, such as uptime, cost savings, and issue resolution.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence within the team.
  • Manage team workload, performance, and professional development, including recruiting, training, and performance reviews.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for legacy product support with internal and external stakeholders.
 
Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience 
  • 3+ years in a technical leadership or management role within pump solutions, fluid handling, or related industries.
 
Preferences:
  • Proactive, self-organized leader with strong organizational skills, strategic planning experience, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • Strong customer-facing communicator with excellent verbal and written communication skills, active listening abilities, and the capability to uncover customer needs and articulate value propositions.
  • Technical and analytical problem solver with strong engineering principles, mechanical comprehension, and expertise in Fluid Power (Hydraulics, Pneumatics, and Electromechanical Systems).
  • Experienced cross-functional leader skilled at influencing teams, managing stakeholders, and driving business results through collaboration and effective team management.
  • Product and project execution expert with experience delivering impactful presentations, optimizing processes, and applying project management methodologies (PMP/Six Sigma certifications a plus).
  • Continuous learner and team mentor with experience developing junior engineers, adapting to evolving technologies, and supporting growth in Life Science market applications.
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements
  • Fully site based in Sheboygan, WI
  • Availability to travel up to 15% of the time (e.g., customer visits, training at our technical centers, trade shows, etc.).

Job Overview:
The Product Development Engineer II is a mid-level engineer who independently researches, designs, tests, and develops pump products and systems. This role applies engineering expertise to solve moderately complex problems, evaluates design factors for performance and cost, and utilizes simulations and analysis tools to optimize solutions. The Engineer II collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, prepares technical documentation and reports, and ensures products meet quality and reliability standards. This position also supports project management activities and may provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers. Independently researches, designs, tests, and develops products and systems, applying engineering principles to solve moderately complex problems. Contributes technical expertise to projects and collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure product performance and quality.
 
Responsibilities: 
  • Lead the development of conceptual and detailed product specifications for pump products based on performance data and customer requirements.
  • Evaluate design factors such as function, materials, performance, cost, efficiency, and compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Apply scientific analysis and mathematical modeling to predict and assess design outcomes and alternatives.
  • Interpret and validate test results, conduct failure analysis, and recommend qualification procedures to ensure product reliability and safety.
  • Utilize simulations and predictive models to verify and optimize design concepts.
  • Provide technical guidance and documentation for engineering teams, ensuring adherence to standards and best practices.
  • Prepare and review technical reports, procedures, and customer proposals.
  • Manage project milestones, cost, and schedule, implementing corrective actions as needed.
  • Identify and resolve design errors and deficiencies, recommending revisions and improvements.
  • Mentor junior engineers and share specialized knowledge with colleagues.
 
Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution.
  • 4+ years of relevant engineering experience minimum, preferably in pump design, fluid handling, or related mechanical systems.
 
Preferences:
  • Proficiency in engineering design tools (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar) and experience with simulation or analysis software.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently execute engineering tasks and contribute to cross-functional projects.
  • Experience with product testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Experience with FEA/FEM software solutions for electromagnetic, computational fluid dynamics, and static and dynamic mechanical simulation preferred
  • Certifications such as PMP or Six Sigma are a plus.
  • Self-driven & organized: proactive, strong prioritization/multitasking, communicates with urgency.
  • Customer/commercial strength: active listening to uncover pain points, articulate value, strong commercial awareness.
  • Communication & presentations: excellent written/verbal skills and ability to deliver impactful product presentations.
  • Analytical problem-solver: strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Technical engineering depth: strong engineering fundamentals, mechanical comprehension, fluid power (hydraulics/pneumatics/electromechanical), prototype development/testing.
  • Collaborative leadership: leads through influence, works effectively through others, manages cross-functional teams; manufacturing processes/materials knowledge.
 
Travel Expectations:

  • Availability to travel up to the first 6-9 months to Sheboygan, WI

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview: 
The Senior Compressor Development Engineer III is a senior technical contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of advanced pump products and systems.  This role applies deep technical knowledge and advanced analysis techniques to drive innovation, product reliability, and continuous improvement.  Leads complex projects, mentors junior team members, and ensures technical solutions align with cost, schedule, and quality objectives. This position is instrumental in identifying and implementing process improvements, resolving high-level technical challenges, and sharing specialized expertise across the team. Leads the design, development, and optimization of advanced products and systems, applying deep technical knowledge and innovative problem-solving.  Drives continuous improvement, mentors junior engineers, and ensures solutions meet technical, cost, and quality targets. 
 
Responsibilities:  
  • Lead the development of conceptual and detailed product specifications for compressor products, ensuring alignment with performance data, customer requirements, and strategic objectives. 
  • Evaluate and optimize design factors such as function, materials, performance, cost, efficiency, and compliance with contractual and regulatory obligations. 
  • Apply advanced scientific analysis and mathematical modeling to predict, assess, and improve design outcomes and alternatives. 
  • Interpret and validate complex test results, conduct in-depth failure analysis, and establish robust qualification procedures to enhance product reliability and safety. 
  • Utilize, refine, and develop simulations and predictive models to verify, optimize, and innovate design concepts. 
  • Provide expert technical guidance, documentation, and peer review for engineering teams, ensuring strict adherence to standards and best practices. 
  • Prepare, review, and present comprehensive technical reports, procedures, and customer proposals. 
  • Lead the management of project milestones, budgets, and schedules, proactively implementing corrective actions and process improvements as needed. 
  • Identify, resolve, and prevent design errors and deficiencies, driving revisions, engineering change orders, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, actively sharing specialized knowledge, fostering professional development, and promoting a culture of innovation and collaboration. 
 
Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited institution required.  
  • 8+ years of Mechanical Engineering including design experience utilizing CAD, FEA, and other engineering tools OR Master's degree from an accredited institution  
  • 5+ years experience developing hydraulic or pneumatic actuator flow control or electromechanical products 

Preferences:
  • Strong mechanical engineering expertise in vapor/fluid control actuators and structural component development  
  • Compressor expert, especially regarding piston-types 
  • Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills  
  • Leadership and mentoring skills to guide Junior Engineers and support their professional development. 
  • Expertise with CAD, CFD, and FEA for design and analysis. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance. 
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork and stakeholder engagement.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, reliability engineering, and asset management best practices. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements
  • Fully site based in Sheboygan, WI
  • Availability to travel up to 10% of the time (e.g., customer visits, training at our technical centers, trade shows, etc.)

Job Title: Manager Materials, Industrial Manufacturing
Location:  West Chester, PA (onsite)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Own the Flow. Drive the Operation. Lead What Moves the Business. At the Ingersoll Rand West Chester site, you’ll step into a mission-critical hub where uptime, precision, and real-world impact collide. As Manager, Materials, you own the flow of materials, teams, and execution across a high-velocity manufacturing operation. You’ll lead an integrated network of material planning, buyer/planners, and production scheduling, ensuring seamless alignment from demand through delivery in a fast-paced, just-in-time, make-to-order environment.

This role carries full accountability for materials planning, inventory strategy, and supply execution, making you a key driver of plant performance, scalability, and continuous improvement. You will also own warehouse operations and inventory control end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, discipline, and integrity across physical inventory and cycle count processes. In addition, you will lead shipping and receiving operations through a supervisor and broader team responsible for inbound, outbound, and traffic execution—ensuring materials move with speed and precision across the site.

Deeply embedded in Lean and continuous improvement, this role drives impact across key KPIs including inventory turns, on-time shipping to request date, and days past due, while strengthening overall supply chain performance. You will ensure uninterrupted material availability to support production, proactively closing gaps, removing constraints, and elevating execution across the operation. What sets this role apart is the expectation for hands-on leadership when it matters most—month-end close, peak shipping or receiving volumes, and urgent customer demands. This is not a distance-based leadership role; it is real-time ownership of execution.

If you’re looking to lead broadly, execute deeply, and directly impact plant performance in motion—this is it.

Responsibilities: 
  • Safety: Fosters a safety culture and the implements safety policies and training in compliance with the company safety program and OSHA regulations to eliminate work related injuries. 
  • Inventory Control: Plans, orders, executes and manages storage of critical raw materials in accordance with supplier selections and guidelines provided by Sourcing Operations using SAP/MRP system to achieve the Master Schedule and Service requirements.? Oversees Lean raw material replenishment and storage on the production floor, including initial set up, daily usage estimates, trigger points, and reorder quantities. Coordinates with other facilities to forecast any remanufactured product requirements.? 
  • Strategy: Deploys strategic objectives into annual goals and individual KPIs across the organization by working with teams to set appropriate targets to build daily and monthly routines to manage the business. 
  • Product Lifecycle: Plans for material life cycle management and eliminates obsolete inventory items while working to reduce waste through the value chain. Develops and monitors compliance with requirements related to the introduction of new products. 
  • Management: Develops employees through recruitment, training, coaching and establishing goals and objectives. 
  • Problem solving culture: Develops a culture that is tied to Daily Management by leveraging tools, consulting skills and change management processes. 
  • Other responsibilities as assigned or required. 

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • 5+ years of experience in the integrated functions of materials management in a manufacturing environment that has embraced lean concepts, MRP manufacturing practices, and progressive supplier relationships. 
  • 5+ years of ERP System experience (SAP, Oracle, etc)
  • 3+ years in managerial experience focusing on standardizing planning & execution, reducing sourcing complexity, and talent development. 
  • 3+ years of experience driving cross-functional alignment across operations, supply chain, and production planning teams to execute on business objectives

Core Competencies: 
  • Integrated Materials & Inventory Leadership: Leads end-to-end materials management across planning, procurement, and inventory in a Lean, MRP environment—ensuring material availability while optimizing flow, replenishment (Kanban), and inventory levels.
  • Operational Execution & Continuous Improvement: Drives disciplined execution in a high-velocity, JIT environment. Identifies gaps, implements Lean improvements, and delivers on KPIs—inventory turns, on-time delivery, and past due reduction.
  • Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management: Translates business objectives into clear plans and KPIs. Oversees material lifecycle, including new product introduction and obsolescence reduction, to minimize waste and complexity.
  • People Leadership, Culture & Problem Solving: Builds and develops teams through coaching and accountability. Fosters a safety-first, problem-solving culture using data, daily management, and effective change leadership.

Preferences:
  • Bachelor’s concentration (or international equivalent) in materials management, business, management or related degree.
  • APICS Certification in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM). 
  • Experience implementing inventory control systems (Kanban) in a manufacturing environment. 
  • Experience in operations, inventory management, MRP and lean manufacturing processes. 
  • Experience with visual and daily management systems. 

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Position is based on-site in West Chester, PA 
 
What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.



 

  Job Title: System Design Engineer - EcoPlant

Location: Remote, US

 

About Us
Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

EcoPlant is our pioneering SaaS technology division and is at the forefront of innovation! Harnessing the power of IoT technology and predictive analytics, we seamlessly automate air compressor systems, elevating energy efficiency, boosting system reliability, and enhancing off-site productivity. We’re leading the charge in a sustainable industrial revolution, where cutting-edge technology meets eco-friendly solutions, transforming the very essence of how factories operate.

 

Job Summary
There’s a sustainability movement underway in manufacturing that leverages control systems to proactively monitor mission-critical equipment to evaluate & improve efficiencies and predict & prevent system downtime and equipment failures. If you’re looking to be at the leading edge of progress, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated System Design Engineer to join our dynamic team.

 

Ecoplant is seeking a System Design Engineer to help drive the company’s continued expansion in the United States & Canada by being the product technical expert for the North America market. Your primary responsibilities will be to support the Ecoplant sales team as the EcoPlant controls expert during the sales process; design the system architecture and provide technical documentation and support during system installation process; and support troubleshooting with technical expertise for installed systems. You will liaison with the product management team to provide feedback on product design and product enhancements.

 

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales support to the sales team as the technical expert on the product and participate in customer calls as necessary to overcome customer objections.
  • Be the first line of support to answer customer questions on architecture / data security protocols.
  • Occasionally perform a site survey / audit at the customer site, as needed, as part of the pre-sale process to qualify or design a solution for a complex installation.
  • Design the system architecture for a new installation, including the selection of hardware and sensor location; generate the required bill of materials; generate the piping & instrumentation diagram (P&ID) for the new system; and identify the compressor integration strategy.
  • Provide technical specifications to the Ecoplant Engine team to finalize the Dynamic Engine design.
  • Build the customer dashboard prior to installation and support the installation team with remote technical support during installation.
  • Complete all required technical / system documentation post deployment, including as-builts, register mapping, and compressor integration details.
  • Manage the troubleshooting process for any technical issues post-installation, including managing the escalation process to product management and R&DE, as required.
  • Liaison to product management team to provide feedback on product design, product enhancements, and support the development of the product roadmap.
  • Support the training and onboarding of new associates with technical product training, as required.  
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field and/or combination of education and at least 5 years related industrial controls support experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience with system architecture design, with a focus on industrial systems.  
  • 2+ years’ industrial IT / networking experience and a willingness to learn new skills with installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols required.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience in a technical industry.
  • Ability to read blueprints & schematics, coupled with strong technical problem-solving skills required.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IoT communication protocols (such as Modbus, Profibus, TCP/IP), networking, and data security.
  • The ability to manage multiple urgent issues in parallel.
  • Proficient in computer applications such as Google and Microsoft Office suite (including Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel) required.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is eligible for remote work in the continental United States.
  • Interested candidates should have access to a major airport for travel.
  • Travel up to 30% of time across North America.
 

Preferences

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field, such as Engineering or Engineering Technology.
  • Experience with industrial compressed air systems.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the demonstrated ability to work independently as well as guide the work of others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and self-motivation.
 

Pay Range 

The total pay range for this role is $85,000 - $135,000. The actual pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.??

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

? 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).? 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

? 

Key Competencies? 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.? 

  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.? 

  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 

  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 

?

  Job Title: System Design Engineer - EcoPlant

Location: Remote, US

 

About Us
Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

EcoPlant is our pioneering SaaS technology division and is at the forefront of innovation! Harnessing the power of IoT technology and predictive analytics, we seamlessly automate air compressor systems, elevating energy efficiency, boosting system reliability, and enhancing off-site productivity. We’re leading the charge in a sustainable industrial revolution, where cutting-edge technology meets eco-friendly solutions, transforming the very essence of how factories operate.

 

Job Summary
There’s a sustainability movement underway in manufacturing that leverages control systems to proactively monitor mission-critical equipment to evaluate & improve efficiencies and predict & prevent system downtime and equipment failures. If you’re looking to be at the leading edge of progress, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated System Design Engineer to join our dynamic team.

 

Ecoplant is seeking a System Design Engineer to help drive the company’s continued expansion in the United States & Canada by being the product technical expert for the North America market. Your primary responsibilities will be to support the Ecoplant sales team as the EcoPlant controls expert during the sales process; design the system architecture and provide technical documentation and support during system installation process; and support troubleshooting with technical expertise for installed systems. You will liaison with the product management team to provide feedback on product design and product enhancements.

 

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales support to the sales team as the technical expert on the product and participate in customer calls as necessary to overcome customer objections.
  • Be the first line of support to answer customer questions on architecture / data security protocols.
  • Occasionally perform a site survey / audit at the customer site, as needed, as part of the pre-sale process to qualify or design a solution for a complex installation.
  • Design the system architecture for a new installation, including the selection of hardware and sensor location; generate the required bill of materials; generate the piping & instrumentation diagram (P&ID) for the new system; and identify the compressor integration strategy.
  • Provide technical specifications to the Ecoplant Engine team to finalize the Dynamic Engine design.
  • Build the customer dashboard prior to installation and support the installation team with remote technical support during installation.
  • Complete all required technical / system documentation post deployment, including as-builts, register mapping, and compressor integration details.
  • Manage the troubleshooting process for any technical issues post-installation, including managing the escalation process to product management and R&DE, as required.
  • Liaison to product management team to provide feedback on product design, product enhancements, and support the development of the product roadmap.
  • Support the training and onboarding of new associates with technical product training, as required.  
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field and/or combination of education and at least 5 years related industrial controls support experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience with system architecture design, with a focus on industrial systems.  
  • 2+ years’ industrial IT / networking experience and a willingness to learn new skills with installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols required.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience in a technical industry.
  • Ability to read blueprints & schematics, coupled with strong technical problem-solving skills required.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IoT communication protocols (such as Modbus, Profibus, TCP/IP), networking, and data security.
  • The ability to manage multiple urgent issues in parallel.
  • Proficient in computer applications such as Google and Microsoft Office suite (including Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel) required.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is eligible for remote work in the continental United States.
  • Interested candidates should have access to a major airport for travel.
  • Travel up to 30% of time across North America.
 

Preferences

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field, such as Engineering or Engineering Technology.
  • Experience with industrial compressed air systems.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the demonstrated ability to work independently as well as guide the work of others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and self-motivation.
 

Pay Range 

The total pay range for this role is $85,000 - $135,000. The actual pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Service Technician  

Location: Multiple positions located at or near our East Customer Center Locations - Allentown, PA; Aston, PA; Edison, NJ; Marlborough, MA; Scarsborough, ME; Shrewsbury, PA; Richmond, VA; Greensboro, NC; Charlotte, NC. This role is typically not eligible for relocation. If a position is not currently open in an area that you are seeking employment, we will reach out to qualified candidates once an opening is available. 

 

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

? 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).? 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

? 

Key Competencies? 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.? 

  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.? 

  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 

  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 

?

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.?   • High school diploma or equivalent required.??

Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered.

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).?

About Us

Harnessing the power of IoT technology and predictive analytics, we seamlessly automate air compressor systems, elevating energy efficiency, boosting system reliability, and enhancing off-site productivity. We’re leading the charge in a sustainable industrial revolution, where cutting-edge technology meets eco-friendly solutions, transforming the very essence of how factories operate.

 

Job Summary
There’s a sustainability movement underway in manufacturing that leverages control systems to proactively monitor mission-critical equipment to evaluate & improve efficiencies and predict & prevent system downtime and equipment failures. If you’re looking to be at the leading edge of progress, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated System Design Engineer to join our dynamic team.

 

Ecoplant is seeking a System Design Engineer to help drive the company’s continued expansion in the United States & Canada by being the product technical expert for the North America market. Your primary responsibilities will be to support the Ecoplant sales team as the EcoPlant controls expert during the sales process; design the system architecture and provide technical documentation and support during system installation process; and support troubleshooting with technical expertise for installed systems. You will liaison with the product management team to provide feedback on product design and product enhancements.

 

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales support to the sales team as the technical expert on the product and participate in customer calls as necessary to overcome customer objections.
  • Be the first line of support to answer customer questions on architecture / data security protocols.
  • Occasionally perform a site survey / audit at the customer site, as needed, as part of the pre-sale process to qualify or design a solution for a complex installation.
  • Design the system architecture for a new installation, including the selection of hardware and sensor location; generate the required bill of materials; generate the piping & instrumentation diagram (P&ID) for the new system; and identify the compressor integration strategy.
  • Provide technical specifications to the Ecoplant Engine team to finalize the Dynamic Engine design.
  • Build the customer dashboard prior to installation and support the installation team with remote technical support during installation.
  • Complete all required technical / system documentation post deployment, including as-builts, register mapping, and compressor integration details.
  • Manage the troubleshooting process for any technical issues post-installation, including managing the escalation process to product management and R&DE, as required.
  • Liaison to product management team to provide feedback on product design, product enhancements, and support the development of the product roadmap.
  • Support the training and onboarding of new associates with technical product training, as required.  
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field and/or combination of education and at least 5 years related industrial controls support experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience with system architecture design, with a focus on industrial systems.  
  • 2+ years’ industrial IT / networking experience and a willingness to learn new skills with installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols required.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience in a technical industry.
  • Ability to read blueprints & schematics, coupled with strong technical problem-solving skills required.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IoT communication protocols (such as Modbus, Profibus, TCP/IP), networking, and data security.
  • The ability to manage multiple urgent issues in parallel.
  • Proficient in computer applications such as Google and Microsoft Office suite (including Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel) required.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is eligible for remote work in the continental United States.
  • Interested candidates should have access to a major airport for travel.
  • Travel up to 30% of time across North America.
 

Preferences

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field, such as Engineering or Engineering Technology.
  • Experience with industrial compressed air systems.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the demonstrated ability to work independently as well as guide the work of others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and self-motivation.
 

Pay Range 

The total pay range for this role is $85,000 - $135,000. We’re leading the charge in a sustainable industrial revolution, where cutting-edge technology meets eco-friendly solutions, transforming the very essence of how factories operate.

 

Job Summary
There’s a sustainability movement underway in manufacturing that leverages control systems to proactively monitor mission-critical equipment to evaluate & improve efficiencies and predict & prevent system downtime and equipment failures. If you’re looking to be at the leading edge of progress, we’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated System Design Engineer to join our dynamic team.

 

Ecoplant is seeking a System Design Engineer to help drive the company’s continued expansion in the United States & Canada by being the product technical expert for the North America market. Your primary responsibilities will be to support the Ecoplant sales team as the EcoPlant controls expert during the sales process; design the system architecture and provide technical documentation and support during system installation process; and support troubleshooting with technical expertise for installed systems. You will liaison with the product management team to provide feedback on product design and product enhancements.

 

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales support to the sales team as the technical expert on the product and participate in customer calls as necessary to overcome customer objections.
  • Be the first line of support to answer customer questions on architecture / data security protocols.
  • Occasionally perform a site survey / audit at the customer site, as needed, as part of the pre-sale process to qualify or design a solution for a complex installation.
  • Design the system architecture for a new installation, including the selection of hardware and sensor location; generate the required bill of materials; generate the piping & instrumentation diagram (P&ID) for the new system; and identify the compressor integration strategy.
  • Provide technical specifications to the Ecoplant Engine team to finalize the Dynamic Engine design.
  • Build the customer dashboard prior to installation and support the installation team with remote technical support during installation.
  • Complete all required technical / system documentation post deployment, including as-builts, register mapping, and compressor integration details.
  • Manage the troubleshooting process for any technical issues post-installation, including managing the escalation process to product management and R&DE, as required.
  • Liaison to product management team to provide feedback on product design, product enhancements, and support the development of the product roadmap.
  • Support the training and onboarding of new associates with technical product training, as required.  
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field and/or combination of education and at least 5 years related industrial controls support experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience with system architecture design, with a focus on industrial systems.  
  • 2+ years’ industrial IT / networking experience and a willingness to learn new skills with installing IoT devices, including advanced industrial communication protocols required.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience in a technical industry.
  • Ability to read blueprints & schematics, coupled with strong technical problem-solving skills required.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IoT communication protocols (such as Modbus, Profibus, TCP/IP), networking, and data security.
  • The ability to manage multiple urgent issues in parallel.
  • Proficient in computer applications such as Google and Microsoft Office suite (including Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel) required.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is eligible for remote work in the continental United States.
  • Interested candidates should have access to a major airport for travel.
  • Travel up to 30% of time across North America.
 

Preferences

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field, such as Engineering or Engineering Technology.
  • Experience with industrial compressed air systems.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the demonstrated ability to work independently as well as guide the work of others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and self-motivation.
 

Pay Range 

The total pay range for this role is $85,000 - $135,000. The actual pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.??

Job Title: Service Technician  
Location: Shrewsbury, PA, Baltimore, MD, Washington DC area

About Us  

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. .

Core Competencies 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $25-$40/hr.  The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.


What we Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
  • Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:

  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided.

Core Competencies: 

  • Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting.
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
  • Hybrid
Pay Range:

Starting pay will range between $25.00 - $40.00 per hour depending on multiple factors, including candidate qualifications and experience. It is not typical for candidates to be paid at the top of the range. This is a full-time, hourly position.


What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Job Overview:
Gardner Denver - Industrial Technology and Services, LLC, a division of Ingersoll Rand, manufactures blowers and compressors for industrial, commercial, and government applications. Our products are designed by industry leading engineers and manufactured to exacting specifications.  Our knowledgeable team takes metal castings and other raw materials and turns them into the high-performing products we are known for around the world.  

The Assembler/Machine Operator will perform various tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product.  The Assembler/Machine Operator works under limited supervision, responsible to perform a variety of duties efficiently with high quality results.  This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands. You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. and follow them with precision. 

Responsibilities:

  • Perform static and dynamic balancing of rotating assemblies in accordance with established specifications and quality standards.
  • Assemble machines to customer specifications and blueprints using standard and specialized tools while following required torque specifications.
  • Operate grinding machines to produce parts within specified tolerances, including diameters requiring accuracy up to ±0.0002".
  • Read, understand, edit, and offset CNC programs by interpreting program code and monitoring machine operation and performance.
  • Take, verify, and document measurements using appropriate measuring tools to ensure parts meet required specifications.
  • Safely move, arrange, and handle parts and materials using forklifts, overhead cranes, and walk-behind lifts.
  • Identify and report quality defects, equipment concerns, and unsafe conditions while following established safety and quality procedures.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area, follow established processes, and communicate or ask questions as needed to ensure accurate and safe operations.

 

Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of machining experience; CNC experience preferred, manual machining experience may be accepted
  • Ability to work to tight tolerances, specifically ±0.0002" (two tenths) on grinding diameters
  • Blueprint reading experience required
  • Ability to understand and edit CNC programs and make offsets
  • Proficiency with basic machine shop gauging tools (OD micrometers, snap gauges, height gauges, etc.)
  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs throughout the shift
  • Ability to operate cranes and walk-behind lifts as needed
  • High school diploma or GED preferred, but not required

.

Location:  Shrewsbury, PA, Baltimore, MD - Washington DC area 


About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets.
