Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
  • Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:

  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided.

Core Competencies: 

  • Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting.
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
  • Hybrid
Pay Range:

Starting pay will range between $25.00 - $40.00 per hour depending on multiple factors, including candidate qualifications and experience. It is not typical for candidates to be paid at the top of the range. This is a full-time, hourly position.

Job Title: Principal Architect – Digital Solutions

 
Location: Davidson, NC or Quincy, IL

 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planet. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and power – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.


Job Summary

We are hiring a Principal Architect to lead the product and systems architecture of Ingersoll Rand’s Digital Solutions portfolio. Our products combine industrial compressors and blowers with embedded controls, edge connectivity, and cloud services — used by customers in demanding environments around the world.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical direction that subsystem teams across the company build against, and you will be a recognized technical voice within Ingersoll Rand. You’ll spend most of your time on deep architectural work and on the high-leverage artifacts that direct the portfolio, working closely with Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and architects across our digital subsystems.


Responsibilities

  • Define and own the product and systems architecture across the Digital Solutions portfolio, from embedded firmware and Linux platforms to connectivity and cloud services.
  • Own the ecosystem architecture and ensure it remains coherent as products, platforms, and integrations evolve.
  • Translate product strategy and commercial roadmaps into clear technical direction, and adapt the architecture as new opportunities are identified.
  • Interface with architects across all digital subsystems to drive alignment on shared architecture, resolve cross-team architectural conflicts, and approve changes to shared interfaces.
  • Author and maintain the reference architectures, architectural decision records, and design standards that subsystem teams build against.
  • Contribute architectural insight to build-versus-buy decisions, technology selection, and partner evaluations.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in software, systems, or embedded engineering, with several years operating at a portfolio, platform, or principal-architect level of scope.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel 10-15% (primarily domestic to Ingersoll Rand testing and manufacturing facilities).


Key Competencies

  • Track record of architecting products that combine embedded firmware (bare-metal or RTOS), embedded Linux platforms (for example Yocto-based distributions), connectivity, and cloud or backend services.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity for connected products, including secure boot, identity and key management, and over-the-air update strategies.
  • Experience with industrial control systems, motor control, or industrial protocols is a strong plus. Familiarity with regulatory standards such as UL, IEC, ISO, or EMI/EMC is also a plus.
  • Fluent in modern software engineering practice: Agile delivery, CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and observability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineering teams, executive leadership, and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple regions.


Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $150,000-$160,000, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation. 
 

What we Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

About Us

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated Cooling System Design Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of cooling infrastructure for hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation data center projects. This role is responsible for designing efficient, reliable, and sustainable thermal management solutions that support mission-critical environments.

The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, equipment vendors, construction partners, and project stakeholders to develop cooling system designs that meet performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and operational requirements throughout the project lifecycle.




Key Responsibilities

Cooling System Design

  • Develop conceptual, preliminary, and detailed designs for data center cooling systems.
  • Design and optimize chilled water, direct expansion (DX), liquid cooling, air-side and water-side economization systems.
  • Perform cooling load calculations and thermal analyses for white space, support spaces, and critical infrastructure areas.
  • Develop HVAC system layouts, piping schematics, flow diagrams, and equipment specifications.
  • Evaluate emerging cooling technologies, including direct-to-chip and immersion cooling solutions.
Engineering & Technical Analysis

  • Conduct system sizing calculations for chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, heat exchangers, and associated equipment.
  • Perform computational modeling and simulations to validate cooling performance and energy efficiency.
  • Support CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) analyses for airflow management and thermal optimization.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices.
Project Delivery

  • Support project planning, design reviews, and technical coordination throughout all project phases.
  • Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, structural, controls, and commissioning teams.
  • Review vendor submittals, shop drawings, and equipment specifications.
  • Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Resolve design and field issues while maintaining schedule and budget commitments.
Sustainability & Energy Efficiency

  • Design solutions that achieve high levels of energy efficiency and operational resiliency.
  • Support PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) optimization initiatives.
  • Evaluate energy consumption and lifecycle cost impacts of cooling system alternatives.
  • Contribute to corporate sustainability and carbon reduction goals.
Documentation & Standards

  • Prepare engineering reports, calculations, technical specifications, and design documentation.
  • Develop and maintain design standards and best practices for data center cooling infrastructure.
  • Ensure complete and accurate project documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in HVAC, mission-critical facilities, or data center infrastructure design.
    • Experience performing HVAC load calculations and system sizing.
    • Proficiency with engineering design software such as:
      • AutoCAD
      • Revit
      • BIM platforms
      • HVAC modeling tools
      Core Competencies

    • Data Center Thermal Management
    • HVAC Design Engineering
    • Mission-Critical Infrastructure
    • Cooling System Optimization
    • Energy Efficiency & Sustainability
    • CFD Analysis
    • Technical Documentation
    • Vendor & Stakeholder Management
    • Risk Assessment & Problem Solving
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience supporting hyperscale or large-scale data center projects.
    • Familiarity with ASHRAE Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments.
    • Experience with CFD modeling tools such as 6SigmaDCX, Future Facilities, or equivalent.
    • Knowledge of liquid cooling technologies for AI/HPC workloads.
    • Experience with Uptime Institute Tier standards and TIA-942 requirements.
    • LEED Accreditation or experience with sustainable design initiatives.
    • Project management experience in multi-disciplinary engineering environments.
    • Strong knowledge of:
      • Air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
      • Chilled water systems
      • Cooling towers
      • CRAH and CRAC systems
      • Pumping systems
      • Heat exchangers
      • Building Management Systems (BMS)

      • Work in a culture that values ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated Cooling System Design Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of cooling infrastructure for hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation data center projects. This role is responsible for designing efficient, reliable, and sustainable thermal management solutions that support mission-critical environments.

The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, equipment vendors, construction partners, and project stakeholders to develop cooling system designs that meet performance, energy efficiency, scalability, and operational requirements throughout the project lifecycle.




Key Responsibilities

Cooling System Design

  • Develop conceptual, preliminary, and detailed designs for data center cooling systems.
  • Design and optimize chilled water, direct expansion (DX), liquid cooling, air-side and water-side economization systems.
  • Perform cooling load calculations and thermal analyses for white space, support spaces, and critical infrastructure areas.
  • Develop HVAC system layouts, piping schematics, flow diagrams, and equipment specifications.
  • Evaluate emerging cooling technologies, including direct-to-chip and immersion cooling solutions.
Engineering & Technical Analysis

  • Conduct system sizing calculations for chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, heat exchangers, and associated equipment.
  • Perform computational modeling and simulations to validate cooling performance and energy efficiency.
  • Support CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) analyses for airflow management and thermal optimization.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices.
Project Delivery

  • Support project planning, design reviews, and technical coordination throughout all project phases.
  • Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, structural, controls, and commissioning teams.
  • Review vendor submittals, shop drawings, and equipment specifications.
  • Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Resolve design and field issues while maintaining schedule and budget commitments.
Sustainability & Energy Efficiency

  • Design solutions that achieve high levels of energy efficiency and operational resiliency.
  • Support PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) optimization initiatives.
  • Evaluate energy consumption and lifecycle cost impacts of cooling system alternatives.
  • Contribute to corporate sustainability and carbon reduction goals.
Documentation & Standards

  • Prepare engineering reports, calculations, technical specifications, and design documentation.
  • Develop and maintain design standards and best practices for data center cooling infrastructure.
  • Ensure complete and accurate project documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in HVAC, mission-critical facilities, or data center infrastructure design.
    • Experience performing HVAC load calculations and system sizing.
    • Proficiency with engineering design software such as:
      • AutoCAD
      • Revit
      • BIM platforms
      • HVAC modeling tools
      Core Competencies

    • Data Center Thermal Management
    • HVAC Design Engineering
    • Mission-Critical Infrastructure
    • Cooling System Optimization
    • Energy Efficiency & Sustainability
    • CFD Analysis
    • Technical Documentation
    • Vendor & Stakeholder Management
    • Risk Assessment & Problem Solving
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience supporting hyperscale or large-scale data center projects.
    • Familiarity with ASHRAE Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments.
    • Experience with CFD modeling tools such as 6SigmaDCX, Future Facilities, or equivalent.
    • Knowledge of liquid cooling technologies for AI/HPC workloads.
    • Experience with Uptime Institute Tier standards and TIA-942 requirements.
    • LEED Accreditation or experience with sustainable design initiatives.
    • Project management experience in multi-disciplinary engineering environments.
    • Strong knowledge of:
      • Air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
      • Chilled water systems
      • Cooling towers
      • CRAH and CRAC systems
      • Pumping systems
      • Heat exchangers
      • Building Management Systems (BMS)

Job Title: Retail & eCommerce Operations Specialist

Location: Davidson, NC- Hybrid (2 days per week onsite)

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Compression Systems & Services (CSS) North America The Retail & eCommerce Operations Specialist is responsible for the administration, execution, and continuous improvement of retail and eCommerce channel programs that support profitable growth and channel compliance. This role serves as the primary operational resource for the company's Minimum Advertised Pricing (MAP) Program, Authorized Online Reseller Program (AORP), and other day-to-day channel support activities. The position works closely with Channel Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Care, Legal, and Distribution partners to ensure consistent policy enforcement, operational efficiency, and positive channel partner experiences.

Minimum Advertised Pricing (MAP) Program Administration

  • Manage daily administration of the MAP policy and compliance processes.
  • Monitor reported and identified pricing violations across retail and online channels.
  • Coordinate violation investigations, documentation, notifications, and resolution tracking.
  • Maintain accurate records of violations, corrective actions, and program performance metrics.
  • Partner with Pricing, Sales, Legal, and channel stakeholders to ensure consistent policy application.
  • Develop regular compliance reporting and insights for leadership review.
Authorized Online Reseller Program (AORP) Management

  • Administer reseller application, approval, onboarding, and renewal processes.
  • Maintain authorized reseller databases, agreements, and program documentation.
  • Monitor reseller adherence to program requirements and marketplace standards.
  • Coordinate communications related to reseller status, program changes, and eligibility requirements.
  • Support audits and reviews of online sellers operating across key marketplaces.
Retail & eCommerce Operations Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for daily retail and eCommerce operational requests from field sales, channel partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resolution of channel issues related to pricing, listings, product setup, content, compliance, and program participation.
  • Support retailer setup and maintenance processes by working with internal cross-functional teams.
  • Assist with retail assortment updates, product transitions, and channel readiness activities.
  • Maintain channel documentation, standard operating procedures, and training resources.
Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and distribute reporting on MAP compliance, reseller activity, retail performance indicators, and operational service metrics.
  • Track and analyze recurring channel issues to identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Support forecasting, rebate tracking, and program measurement activities as required.
  • Provide operational insights that improve channel execution and partner satisfaction.
Process Improvement & Governance

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and consistency across retail and eCommerce channel operations.
  • Maintain governance processes for channel policies and program administration.
  • Support implementation of new systems, workflows, and digital tools related to channel management.
  • Ensure program compliance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • 2+ Years Excel Skills: Advanced Formulas and Functions - Using more complex formulas and functions, such as VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, IF, AND, OR, etc. Data Analysis
  • 2+ Years experience in ecommerce/and or retail

Preferences:

  • Bachelor degree in Marketing, Engineering or Business  
  • Experience with ERP systems preferred. Examples - SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle NetSuite, etc..
  • Performing basic data analysis tasks, such as creating charts and graphs, and using pivot tables.
  • Data Validation - Using data validation to ensure data accuracy.
  • Conditional Formatting - Using conditional formatting to highlight specific data patterns.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C distribution.  E-Commerce and retail a huge plus.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
This position will be based at our corporate offices in Davidson, NC, with minimal anticipated travel.

Job title: Order Management Specialist

Location: Charlotte, NC (onsite)

  About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

  Job Overview:
 

Play a critical role in delivering exceptional customer service while managing customer orders from entry through fulfillment. In this fast-paced, customer-focused role, you will serve as a key liaison between customers, operations, and internal teams to ensure timely order processing, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while building strong relationships with customers and business partners. This position offers an excellent opportunity to grow your career within a global organization that values initiative, continuous learning, and long-term development.

 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as key liaison between assigned Channel Partners and operations to ensure timely delivery of goods.
  • Execute daily tasks and customer responses with a sense of ownership and urgency.
  • Manage customer expectations by clearly communicating our commitments (i.e. delivery dates or problem resolution), and keeping customers informed of status of orders, issues, etc.
  • Develop and cultivate effective relationships with key accounts/distribution partners.
  • Manage customer orders from placement to invoicing through multiple channels, including phone, fax, EDI, E-Mail, and websites to ensure 100% customer satisfaction.
  • Manage Sales Order bookings / backlog in relation to dates / holds / quotes and P.O. errors.
  • Provide high-quality service through efficient use of all Oracle/CRM functionalities related to order fulfillment and relative to customer activity.
  • Coordinate cancellation requests with supplier/customer in order to avoid any discrepancy / excess in inventory.
  • Provide support and training to distributors on order entry application.

Description du poste: Électromécanicien (Machines rotatives)

 

Emplacement du bureau: 190 Av. du Voyageur #100, Pointe-Claire, Québec H9R 6A

 

À propos de nous

Ingersoll Rand est une entreprise Fortune 500 passionnée par l'amélioration de la vie. Nous y parvenons en incarnant nos valeurs, en nous concentrant sans relâche sur la réussite de nos clients et en collaborant avec nos employés pour penser et agir comme des propriétaires. Nous croyons en la durabilité grâce au développement et à la distribution d'une large gamme de marques mondiales conçues pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients de manière efficace et responsable. Ingersoll Rand valorise un environnement diversifié et inclusif. Pour plus d'informations, visitez : www.irco.com.

Aperçu du poste
L’Électromécanicien spécialisé en machines rotatives est responsable de l’installation, l’entretien, la réparation et le diagnostic d’équipements tels que moteurs électriques, soufflantes, pompes, ventilateurs, compresseurs et autres systèmes rotatifs industriels.

Il effectue également la maintenance préventive et corrective, l’analyse vibratoire et contribue à l’amélioration de la fiabilité des équipements.

Responsabilités :

  • Installer, inspecter et réparer les équipements électromécaniques.
  • Effectuer l’entretien préventif et correctif des machines rotatives.
  • Effectuer des diagnostics de défaillance mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques et pneumatiques.
  • Réaliser l’alignement laser ou au comparateur.
  • Lire et interpréter des plans mécaniques et schémas électriques.
  • Assurer les tests de fonctionnement après réparation.
  • Rédiger des rapports de maintenance et de service.
  • Respecter les normes de santé et de sécurité au travail.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de production et d’ingénierie.
  • Utiliser des équipements de levage pour manipuler des pièces lourdes.

Compétences et exigences:

  • DEP en électromécanique, Mécanique industrielle, ou diplôme équivalent.
  •  2 à 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance industrielle (atout).
  •  Excellentes compétences en dépannage mécanique et électrique.
  •  Maîtrise des outils comme multimètre, analyseur de vibrations, tachymètre.
  •  Expérience en alignement laser (atout).
  •  Bonne condition physique
  • Compétences informatiques de base (Microsoft Office).

Ce que nous offrons
Chez Ingersoll Rand, nous promouvons une culture de responsabilité personnelle — en prenant soin de notre entreprise, de nos communautés et de notre environnement, ainsi que de notre santé et bien-être individuels. Notre programme complet d'avantages est conçu pour vous offrir les outils et le soutien nécessaires pour prendre en main votre santé, afin qu'ensemble, nous puissions continuer à améliorer la vie.

Notre gamme d'avantages comprend :

  • Culture responsabilisante : Encourager la responsabilité personnelle dans la réussite de notre entreprise, l'engagement communautaire et la protection de l'environnement.
  • Options de soins de santé : Plans complets de couverture médicale, dentaire et visuelle, ainsi que des assurances vie pour répondre à divers besoins de santé.
  • Programmes de bien-être : Ressources et initiatives pour soutenir votre bien-être global.
  • Plan d'épargne-retraite : Un plan solide avec des contributions de l'employeur pour sécuriser votre avenir.
  • Attribution d'actions aux employés : Une opportunité de partager la croissance et le succès de l'entreprise.
  • Congés payés : Pour vous assurer d'avoir le temps de vous ressourcer et de profiter de la vie en dehors du travail.
  • Environnement de soutien : Un programme d'avantages conçu pour vous aider à donner le meilleur de vous-même au travail et dans la vie.

 

 

Job title: Electromechanic / Electromechanical Technician – Rotating Machinery

Location: 190 Av. du Voyageur #100, Pointe-Claire, Québec H9R 6A

 

About Us 

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better.  We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Job Overview:

The Electromechanic specializing in rotating machinery is responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing, and diagnosing industrial equipment such as electric motors, blowers, pumps, fans, compressors, and other rotating systems.

The role also includes performing preventive and corrective maintenance, vibration analysis, troubleshooting, and contributing to equipment reliability improvements.

Responsibilities:

• Install, inspect, and repair electromechanical equipment.
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on rotating machinery.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic failures.
• Perform laser alignment or dial?indicator alignment.
• Read and interpret mechanical drawings and electrical schematics.
• Conduct operational tests after repairs.
• Prepare maintenance and service reports.
• Comply with workplace health and safety standards.
• Collaborate with production and engineering teams.
• Use lifting and handling equipment to move heavy parts.

Skills/Requirements:

  • Diploma in Electromechanics, Industrial Mechanics, or an equivalent field
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in industrial maintenance (an asset).
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  •  Proficiency with tools such as a multimeter, vibration analyzer, and tachometer.
  • Experience with laser alignment (an asset).
  • Good physical condition.
  •  computer skills (Microsoft Office). 
  • mechanically inclined, self-motivated and able to work without supervision.
  • Additional job training on the assembly of blowers may be required upon request.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, PLC diagrams, work instructions, safety instructions, operates forklift and overhead crane.
  • Have demonstrated crane and rigging experience, knowledge of rigging and lifting equipment as well as parts that do not have a center of gravity that are easily identified.

EDUCATION/TRAINING REQUIRED:

  • High School Diploma, or equivalent.
  • courses completed (Mechanical, Pneumatics, PLC, Hydraulics, is a plus).
  • Experience substituted for education.

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM, occasional overtime.

Louisville, KY

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
•This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).
•This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables 
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (i.e. 5 Whys) as trained 
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization. 
 
Preferences: 
  • HS Diploma or GED preferred. Higher Education or certificate is a plus.
  • Experience with manual machining such as VTL/Boring Mill/ or Horizontal Lathe. Brands would include but not limited to Cincinnati and King brand.
  • Proven ability to set up and operate Manual Machines, work centers, specializing in tool changes and in-process offset adjustments.

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

Job Title: Service Technician  
Location: Greensboro, NC

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

Job title: Quality Inspector

Location:
Ocala, FL - Industrial Technical & Services (4647 SW 40th Ave. Ocala, FL 34474)
1st Shift, Monday - Friday 6:00AM - 2:30 PM

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

Plans, organizes, conducts, evaluates, dispositions, and reports on activities associated with Quality Assurance and Control in regard to manufacturing materials, processes, and products.  Activities include auditing, problem analysis, data gathering, problem resolution, and processing documentation in a concise and timely manner to support company objectives.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Responsibilities:

  • Inspect, test, measure, analyze, and document materials, components, processes, and finished products to ensure conformance with specifications and quality requirements.
  • Interpret blueprints, drawings, manuals, specifications, and technical data to determine inspection methods, testing requirements, tolerances, and appropriate measuring instruments.
  • Identify, document, quarantine, and disposition non-conforming material through the NCR/MRB process; communicate significant quality issues and support timely closure of open NCRs.
  • Maintain accurate and organized quality records, inspection documentation, procedures, work instructions, and files to support internal requirements and third-party inspections.
  • Calibrate, adjust, maintain, and perform routine checks or repairs on inspection and measurement equipment while maintaining accurate calibration records and logs.
  • Support ISO 9001 and applicable regulatory, customer, and industry quality requirements by conducting internal audits, documenting findings, reporting deficiencies, and supporting corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, and other departments to resolve quality and documentation issues, communicate technical findings, and drive quality and efficiency improvements.
  • Follow company policies, procedures, work instructions, safety requirements, and housekeeping standards while promoting a safe, organized, and quality-focused work environment.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent or two or more years’ experience in a manufacturing environment with welding, electrical wiring, and assembly processes. 
  • Receiving inspections on machine parts background.
  • Ability to use precision measuring instruments and complex test equipment and accurately interpret the results.
  • AWS Welding symbols comprehension
  • Prefer welding knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Div. I welding requirements and GTAW, GMAW, FCAW, SAW, and SMAW welding processes.
  • Understand and read WPS/PQRs/WPQs
  • Individual should have knowledge of manufacturing, and typical office software spreadsheet and word processing programs.
  • Read and understand fabrication blueprints/drawings

Job Title: Service Technician  
Location: Greensboro, NC

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers.?   • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.  
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance.?   
  • Operate forklift within compliance as needed.  
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.  
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.?  
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.

  • 2+ years of experience in customer service-related role
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Office computer applications

  
Core Competencies:

  • Technical background highly preferred  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task.

  • Technical background

Location: Remote, Territory - Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
Responsible for sales growth and business development activities with distribution partners and OEMs.  Provide technical, application, product, and sales support for the assembly tool portfolio in support of end user growth.  Implement plans to grow overall sales revenue and market share within the region.  Candidate must be knowledgeable of technical products, services, and solutions. You will establish yourself as the significant point of contact for each assigned distributor including business owners, sales teams and service leaders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage Assembly distribution network to meet or achieve sales growth targets.
  • Cultivate product sales at end-users via relationship development & demonstrations.
  • Analyze target account requirements and develop penetration plans to increase market share.
  • Provide timely submission of reporting tools, inclusive of CRM data/pipeline management, forecasts, and project visibility.
  • Coordinate with marketing or other business unit resources as necessary.
  • Responsible for the measurement of distributor performance and implementing distributor performance improvement programs.
  • Actively conduct, seek out, and participate in both formal and informal training opportunities
  • All other duties assigned by management. 

Requirements:

  • Technical Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Work Experience
  • 3+ years in sales experience, working for a manufacturer or distributor

Core Competencies:

  • Drives Results – consistently achieving results leveraging the team even under tough circumstances
  • Communicates effectively – develop and deliver communications that are clear, including constructive feedback
  • Customer focus – build relationships and deliver customer centric solutions to meet
  • expectations and maintain customer relationship
  • Action oriented – take new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high sense of enthusiasm
  • Interpersonal Savvy – builds rapport, relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people
  • Being resilient – maintains a positive attitude despite setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.

Preferences:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office computer applications required.
  • Ability to travel 50-60% of time
  • Ability to understand and communicate in technical matter
  • Prefer understanding of air and electric powered power tools used in industrial settings, competitors and applications.
  • Prefer Knowledge of multi-channel distribution functions and end user selling experience preferred

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be Remote and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (50%).

The total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $115,000 - $130,000. Job Title: Marketing Manager (Commercial Excellence)
Location: Remote

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
The commercial excellence manager will own CRM roadmap within the Ingersoll Rands Process Flow Technologies business unit for the North America region, working with business and technical stakeholders to align on priorities. They will establish key performance indicators and targets while enabling commercial teams with visibility and dashboards to drive compliance and performance improvements. The role operates at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Experience, ensuring consistent adoption of commercial standards, pipeline accuracy, and operating excellence that drives a winning customer experience.  

Responsibilities:

Commercial Capability Building - 
 

  • Metrics Standards & Insight Engine: Define the KPI architecture (conversion, velocity, win rate, leakage, customer mix) and deliver insights that drive commercial action 
  • SFDC Accuracy, Governance & Adoption: Establish the global governance model, activity expectations, data quality rules, and compliance cadence that ensure forecasting accuracy and reliable revenue visibility 
  • Modular Learning Architecture: Develop scalable, role-specific enablement programs—live, recorded, and micro-learning, focused on commercial process mastery, applications, and customer pain points 
  • Distributor Performance Enablement: Build partner onboarding, funnel-management standards, and performance scorecards that strengthen distributor execution and accountability, business unit ownership of the distributor CRM portal and other tools
  • Leadership Dashboards & Review Cadence: Build executive dashboards and establish global performance review rhythms that reinforce accountability and pipeline accuracy 
  • Global Benchmarking & Best-Practice Sharing: Identify high-performing behaviors, codify them into global standards, and drive adoption across markets 


Pipeline Intelligence & Revenue Visibility - 

  • Strategic Revenue Visibility Models: Build forecasting frameworks and future-state pipeline views that illuminate revenue potential by region, segment, and product line 
  • Pipeline Trends, Win/Loss Analytics & Predictive Indicators: Create scalable reporting that surfaces leading indicators, compliance trends, risk signals, and growth drivers 
  • Renewal & Expansion System: Define renewal workflows and build retention, upsell, and cross-sell playbooks that strengthen recurring revenue performance 
  • Consumption & Program Tracking: Standardize tracking of main systems, aftermarket spare parts, recurring programs, renewals, and churn dynamics to improve visibility and execution 


Commercial CRM Roadmap - 

  • Align with business stakeholders on overall priority of CRM capabilities that support business growth and visibility to predictable revenue  
  • Work with technical teams to prioritize business inputs into roadmap of necessary capabilities (e.g. quoting, attribution, ERP integration, CPQ, automation of components, etc.)  
  • Gain stakeholder alignment with roadmap and partner with other technical system owners such as ERP, CPQ, engineering systems and ecommerce
  • Review budget, resource planning and implementation steps with business stakeholders to ensure project success.  


Systems, Tools & Data Governance -

  • Commercial Systems Ownership: Serve as the business owner or co-owner of key commercial tools (Salesforce, CPQ, analytics platforms), defining requirements, partnering with IT, and ensuring tools support global commercial workflows 
  • Data Quality & Segmentation Governance: Define rules for account hierarchy governance, segmentation models, customer classification, data quality, and routing logic 
  • Golden Record Foundation: Partner with IT and Data teams to evolve toward a unified customer “golden record” that improves targeting, visibility, and commercial alignment 
  • Customer Segmentation & Prioritization: Build frameworks that identify priority segments, ICP (ideal customer profile) definitions, and resource allocation strategies 


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing.
  • 3+ years of project leadership experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in Salesforce (data governance, reporting, analytics, dashboards). No coding experience required.  
  • 3+ years of training design, enablement content creation, and curriculum development.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate insights into process improvements and commercial actions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Comfort with global matrixed environments and multi-brand complexity.
  • Technical experience with all types of reporting in Salesforce, dashboards and possibilities and limitation of Salesforce objects.  
  • Cross-functional leadership experience across Sales, Marketing, Product, Channel, IT.
  • Understanding of B2B sales processes, funnel management, and commercial execution.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Remote with minimal travel as needed (including international).


Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Location: Georgia or South Carolina

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Take the lead in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment as our Service Supervisor for the compressed air commercial segment. You will oversee the local service function across the full life cycle of our plant air centrifugal (PAC) compressed air equipment, driving service excellence and exceptional customer satisfaction.

In this pivotal role, you will lead a team of Service Technicians responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining PAC equipment, rotary screw and reciprocating air compressors, and related compressed air system components throughout the region. You will oversee the complete equipment service life cycle—from installation and start-up through ongoing maintenance and repair—while using your mechanical aptitude and field-service leadership experience to keep customers’ operations running reliably. As the operational core of the Customer Center, you will partner with Sales to grow the PAC business, collaborate with Service Coordination to streamline execution, and build a high-performing, customer-focused technician team. You will also take ownership of the Service P&L, ensuring the operation meets its financial and performance goals while continuing to raise the bar for service quality.

If you thrive on leadership, technical variety, customer partnership, and building a winning team culture, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements:
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent from a four-year college, or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • 3+ years’ experience in an industrial, mechanical, sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in managing teams of people, ideally field service technicians
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to:
    • DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 
Core Competencies:
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage 
  • Proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases. 
  • Advanced verbal/written communication skills 
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 

Preferences:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business
  • Experience in managing teams of people, to include experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.   
  • Management of processes and budgets 

Travel and Work Arrangements
  • Frequent regional travel to customers is required, which may include outdoor work and/or work in mechanical/equipment rooms.
  • Travel up to 50%; Company vehicle provided.  
  • Required ability to work in diverse conditions at times, requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.  
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.  

What We Offer

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:

The Operations & Sales Manager is responsible for the day to day operational and commercial growth of the Chicago manufacturing facility (50+ employees, ~$12M annual revenue). This role serves as the onsite Plant Leader, accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people leadership, and customer execution.

The Operations & Sales Manager executes operational strategies and standardized operating practices established by the Multisite Operations Manager, while providing strong hands-on leadership to ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and profitability. This role is critical to enabling effective multisite leverage while maintaining strong site level execution. This role has direct responsibility for driving revenue expansion, improving profitability, and developing new business.

 
Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily manufacturing operations to achieve SQDCP (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People) targets.

  • Ensure on-time productions while meeting quality, regulatory, and compliance standards.

  • Align production schedules, materials, and customer demand across the site.

  • Maintain a safe, compliant work environment (OSHA, EHS, environmental standards).

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvement and cost reduction actions.

  • Own site revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership on business development, demand planning, and quoting.

  • Manage site financial performance, including budget, costs, and CAPEX execution.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team and culture, ensuring alignment with multi-site strategy and governance.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required

  • 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.

  • 7+ years of experience leading operations in a manufacturing environment with 20+ employees.

  • 5+ years of strong financial acumen with experience managing site level P&L, labor models, and budgets.

  • 4+ years working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement tools.

Preferences:

  • Bachelors in technical or engineering discipline preferred.

  • Prior experience as a Site Leader, Plant Manager, or Senior Operations Manager.

  • Experience supporting customer interactions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent practical experience.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position will be based at our Chicago, IL location, with minimal anticipated travel.

  The pay range for this role is $100-150k, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.
