Job Overview:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform a variety of tasks to support the assembly and test of industrial machinery and compression equipment within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
  • Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.  
  • Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
  • Be knowledgeable and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
  • Interpretation of drawings and specifications to determine dimensions, identify materials for construction, and assemble components.
  • Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
  • Maintain and inspect tools and equipment and create work orders for repaired as needed.
  • Loading and unloading of equipment utilizing fork trucks, and hoists.
  • Work in a team environment and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
  • Maintains safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Material handling activities may include managing inventory levels by checking stock to determine inventory level, anticipating needed supplies, shipping and receipt of supplies.  
  • Assembles components by examining connections for correct fit, fastening parts and subassemblies.
  • Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
  • Tasks can include but are not limited to welding, painting, operating machines and presses, assembly and disassembly of parts, wiring, shipping preparation, and performing quality checks and tests.
  • All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.

 
Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED) is required.
  • Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
  • Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
  • Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.
  • Frequently required to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
  • Reaching and handling with high levels of dexterity.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds from floor to waist.  Occasionally required to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Occasionally required to work near moving mechanical equipment.
  • Frequent exposure to various chemicals, sealants, and lubricants.
  • Occasionally required to work outside where weather conditions range from moderate cold to moderate heat.
  • Normal exposure to moderate noise levels.  Occasional exposure to high noise, levels where hearing protection will be required.


Core Competences:

  • Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
  • Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
  • Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
  • Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
  • Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Must be able to work in a multi-tasked environment.


Preferences:

  • Three (3) years in manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Prior experience in mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, precision measurement, blueprint reading and pipefitting is preferred.

 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Job Overview: The Customer Service Technician is an integral part of a dynamic and a highly communicative cross-functional team environment working together to build seamless customer service. Responsibilities:

  • Run reports to monitor and correct on line orders to ensure accurate data  
  • Communicate with customers via email, Sales Force or telephone regarding open orders, technical information and support in understanding the product. 
  • Work with the Shipping, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Product Management, Distributor Development and other pertinent departments to ensure excellent communication. 
  • Source information via SAP, lead-time sheets and purchasing tracking log and analyze data to understand trends and communicate the best available information to the customer.  
  • Work directly with Scheduling to communicate any requests or changes in order book 
  • Create and understand the credit and debit process for returns, damaged freight, pricing and various other issues, create quotes for units, parts and repair opportunities 
  • Create freight claims for damaged or lost shipments 
  • Communicate and support the Sales team with ship dates, sales opportunities and other information that may be pertinent 
 
Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED required 
  • 3+ years of experience with product and/or customer service
  • 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point 
 
Core Competencies: 

  • Ability to provide first class customer service & support by e-mail and phone 
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in an efficient and professional manner 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to handle internal and external contacts in a positive, assertive and effective manner is required 
  • Able to interact and coordinate with internal company resources and vendor resources to resolve issues for customers and distributors
  • Analytical skills to aid in assessing customer needs
 
Preferences: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, or Technical related field is preferred 
  • SAP knowledge and experience preferred
  • service notifications are a plus

Job Overview:

The Operations & Sales Manager is responsible for the day to day operational and commercial growth of the Chicago manufacturing facility (50+ employees, ~$12M annual revenue). This role serves as the onsite Plant Leader, accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people leadership, and customer execution.

The Operations & Sales Manager executes operational strategies and standardized operating practices established by the Multisite Operations Manager, while providing strong hands-on leadership to ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and profitability. This role is critical to enabling effective multisite leverage while maintaining strong site level execution. This role has direct responsibility for driving revenue expansion, improving profitability, and developing new business.

 
Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily manufacturing operations to achieve SQDCP (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People) targets.

  • Ensure on-time productions while meeting quality, regulatory, and compliance standards.

  • Align production schedules, materials, and customer demand across the site.

  • Maintain a safe, compliant work environment (OSHA, EHS, environmental standards).

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvement and cost reduction actions.

  • Own site revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership on business development, demand planning, and quoting.

  • Manage site financial performance, including budget, costs, and CAPEX execution.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team and culture, ensuring alignment with multi-site strategy and governance.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required

  • 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.

  • 7+ years of experience leading operations in a manufacturing environment with 20+ employees.

  • 5+ years of strong financial acumen with experience managing site level P&L, labor models, and budgets.

  • 4+ years working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement tools.

Preferences:

  • Bachelors in technical or engineering discipline preferred.

  • Prior experience as a Site Leader, Plant Manager, or Senior Operations Manager.

  • Experience supporting customer interactions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent practical experience.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position will be based at our Chicago, IL location, with minimal anticipated travel.

  The pay range for this role is $100-150k, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

About Us:  
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview: The Customer Service Technician is an integral part of a dynamic and a highly communicative cross-functional team environment working together to build seamless customer service. This position involves detailed interaction with internal and external customers including issuing quotations, order entry, and communicating delivery schedules. It involves communicating clearly with all internal departments and customers/distributors outside the company on a daily basis. 


Responsibilities:

  • Run reports to monitor and correct on line orders to ensure accurate data  
  • Communicate with customers via email, Sales Force or telephone regarding open orders, technical information and support in understanding the product. 
  • Work with the Shipping, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Product Management, Distributor Development and other pertinent departments to ensure excellent communication. 
  • Source information via SAP, lead-time sheets and purchasing tracking log and analyze data to understand trends and communicate the best available information to the customer.  
  • Work directly with Scheduling to communicate any requests or changes in order book 
  • Create and understand the credit and debit process for returns, damaged freight, pricing and various other issues, create quotes for units, parts and repair opportunities 
  • Create freight claims for damaged or lost shipments 
  • Communicate and support the Sales team with ship dates, sales opportunities and other information that may be pertinent 
 
Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED required 
  • 3+ years of experience with product and/or customer service
  • 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point 
 
Core Competencies: 

  • Ability to provide first class customer service & support by e-mail and phone 
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in an efficient and professional manner 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to handle internal and external contacts in a positive, assertive and effective manner is required 
  • Able to interact and coordinate with internal company resources and vendor resources to resolve issues for customers and distributors
  • Analytical skills to aid in assessing customer needs
 
Preferences: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, or Technical related field is preferred 
  • SAP knowledge and experience preferred
  • service notifications are a plus 
  • Sales Force knowledge a plus 
  Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • On site with travel limited to rare circumstances only

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.  Job title: Operations & Sales Manager

Location: Chicago, IL

  About Us 

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

The Operations & Sales Manager is responsible for the day to day operational and commercial growth of the Chicago manufacturing facility (50+ employees, ~$12M annual revenue). This role serves as the onsite Plant Leader, accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people leadership, and customer execution.

The Operations & Sales Manager executes operational strategies and standardized operating practices established by the Multisite Operations Manager, while providing strong hands-on leadership to ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and profitability. This role is critical to enabling effective multisite leverage while maintaining strong site level execution. This role has direct responsibility for driving revenue expansion, improving profitability, and developing new business.

 
Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily manufacturing operations to achieve SQDCP (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People) targets.

  • Ensure on-time productions while meeting quality, regulatory, and compliance standards.

  • Align production schedules, materials, and customer demand across the site.

  • Maintain a safe, compliant work environment (OSHA, EHS, environmental standards).

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvement and cost reduction actions.

  • Own site revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership on business development, demand planning, and quoting.

  • Manage site financial performance, including budget, costs, and CAPEX execution.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team and culture, ensuring alignment with multi-site strategy and governance.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required

  • 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.

  • 7+ years of experience leading operations in a manufacturing environment with 20+ employees.

  • 5+ years of strong financial acumen with experience managing site level P&L, labor models, and budgets.

  • 4+ years working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement tools.

Preferences:

  • Bachelors in technical or engineering discipline preferred.

  • Prior experience as a Site Leader, Plant Manager, or Senior Operations Manager.

  • Experience supporting customer interactions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent practical experience.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position will be based at our Chicago, IL location, with minimal anticipated travel.

  The pay range for this role is $100-150k, excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.


What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

  Job title: Senior Blower Applications Engineer

About Us:

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Applications Sales Engineer to support and expand our presence in the water and wastewater treatment industry, serving both municipal and industrial markets. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong commercial acumen to deliver engineered solutions centered on blower systems, with a primary focus on Hoffman & Lamson equipment.

The Senior Applications Engineer serves as a strategic technical sales leader, responsible for driving complex engineered solution sales, influencing customer decisions early in the buying cycle, and owning technical win strategies across key opportunities. This position extends well beyond traditional application support, requiring close partnership with Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to drive revenue growth and successful outcomes.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical authority within the organization. The ideal candidate will bring extensive knowledge of multistage centrifugal blowers, high-speed turbo blowers, regenerative blowers, rotary lobe, and screw blower technologies, along with strong expertise in process applications, controls integration, and system optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical strategy for complex, high-value sales opportunities

  • Partner with Sales to define win strategies and value propositions
  • Drive customer decision-making through value-based positioning
  • Influence bid/no-bid decisions
Customer & Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with engineers, EPCs, OEMs, and end users
  • Influence project specifications early in the procurement and design cycle
  • Evaluate customer requirements and develop optimized solutions
  • Lead executive-level technical discussions
Solution Architecture & Technical Authority

  • Serve as technical subject matter expert for blower technologies and systems across water and wastewater applications
  • Support optimized, integrated solutions for industrial and municipal projects including process air systems, vapor handling and gas boosting/recovery.
  • Act as escalation point for complex applications
  • Support troubleshooting, performance optimization, and retrofit opportunities.
  • Prepare and deliver technical proposals, costing estimates, presentations, and value-based solutions.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building

  • Partner with Product Management on VOC and roadmap
  • Mentor Sales Engineering and Sales Teams
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Operations on Product Roadmaps and Life cycle management
  • Lead resolution of critical escalations
  • Provide training and technical guidance to customers and internal teams
Post-Sale Strategic Engagement

  • Provide oversight on key projects
  • Drive long-term customer success
Revenue Impact & Pipeline Ownership

  • Contribute to pipeline growth, support forecasting accuracy and win rates
  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities
Industry Engagement

  • Deliver advanced training strategies both internal and external
  • Represent company at Industry Events/Conferences/Tradeshows (as needed)
Qualifications Required Experience

  • 12+ years in applications engineering or technical sales--This is a benchmark, ok with a little less or a little more experience, for the right candidate. We need a Sr level person.
  • Experience selling complex engineered and configured systems in water & wastewater industry applications
  • Experience working with EPCs, General Contractors, and Customers in Industrial + Municipal Markets
  • Proven success closing high-value deals--Need to be able to able to speak to this Tech in a sales environment with customers, reps, etc…
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of municipal and industrial treatment processes and systems (Aerations systems including pre-treatment, SBRs, MBRs, secondary clarification, tertiary/advanced treatment, sludge handling etc)
  • Hands-on experience with, familiar with or has relevant experience in multistage centrifugal blowers, positive displacement (rotary lobe and screw), high speed turbo blowers and regenerative blowers
  • Basic understanding of controls systems (PLC/SCADA) and system integration.
  • Proven track record in technical sales or applications engineering.
Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Industrial, or related discipline) preferred, or equivalent combination of technical education and relevant industry or business experience.
Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Commercial acumen, ability to bridge engineering and sales
  • Executive-level communication
  • Technical expertise with Blower Technologies and Applications
  • Leadership and influence
  • Customer-focused solution development
  • Leadership and mentorship capability
Tools & Systems

  • Experience leveraging CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, SAP) for workload metrics and decision-making.
  • Experience and proficiency with multistage centrifugal, positive displacement and high speed turbo blower selection/sizing software.
Travel & Work Environment Hybrid role with 25% travel.

Job Title: Warehouse & Shipping Supervisor         
Location:  Sedalia, MO (onsite)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview: At Gardner Denver – Industrial Technology and Services, LLC, a division of Ingersoll Rand, your leadership will directly impact product performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence at our Sedalia facility.

The Warehouse & Shipping Supervisor will lead first-shift warehouse, shipping, and aftermarket operations. This hands-on position extends well beyond traditional dock supervision and requires proven strength across warehouse operations, inventory flow, and daily shipping execution. The supervisor will also lead an aftermarket team responsible for packing and shipping lubricants, filters, and other customer-requested products. Because the position spans multiple operational areas, it requires a versatile professional who can manage changing priorities, work effectively through ambiguity, and maintain a clear understanding of the broader warehouse operation.

The ideal candidate will bring proven supervisory experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to keep people, products, and processes moving efficiently. This professional will take ownership of the operation, strengthen accountability, drive continuous improvement, and turn frontline ideas into meaningful results. Ready to lead more than the shipping dock? Join our Sedalia team and help drive the entire operation forward.

Responsibilities:
  • Operations: Plans, organizes and delegates work assignments in order to best utilize man-hours, skills, and equipment.
  • Production: Anticipate production problems and devise and implement procedures to offset lost production and schedule interruptions.
  • Management: Involved in the recruitment, training, goal-setting and performance management of production staff.
  • Training: Coordinates and participates in a variety of training programs for employees.
  • Plant Safety: Inspects machines and equipment. Polices the use of safety equipment, departmental housekeeping and maintains a continual alert for hazardous conditions.
  • Employee Safety: Proactively supervise safety, including accident investigation and follow-up, departmental inspections, employee training, and safety rule enforcement.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience in warehouse operations to include inventory control and shipping flow
  • 1+ years of experience in team supervisory or as a team lead

Core Competencies
  • Warehouse and Inventory Acumen: Understands warehouse operations, inventory control, shipping flow, and the importance of accuracy in a revenue-generating environment.
  • Hands-On Floor Presence: Spends time on the floor learning processes, understanding workflows, and building credibility with the team.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities, solves problems, and implements practical improvements.
  • Operational Leadership: Leads daily shipping and aftermarket operations while keeping the team focused, accountable, and aligned with business needs.
  • Accountability Mindset: Sets clear expectations, follows through, coaches employees, and addresses performance effectively.
  • Adaptability: Operates comfortably in gray areas and manages changing customer orders, aftermarket products, and operational priorities.

Preferences:
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • SAP experience 
  • Experience in a variable warehouse environment beyond single-product or repetitive shipping operations.
  • Demonstrated career progression within one organization through promotions or expanded responsibility.
  • Experience leading process improvements or operational change initiatives.
  • Manufacturing or industrial operations experience and significant warehouse exposure.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • Based in Sedalia, MO (onsite) 
  • This is first shift and starts between 6:00- 7:00am

Title: Manufacturing Tech &  Field Services, PVC & CPVC
Location: Sedalia, MO (Hybrid)
 
About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview: 
Build it. Prove it. Start it up. On the floor and in the field, this isn’t a stay-in-one-place technician role. As our Manufacturing Systems Technician, you’ll operate in two worlds—splitting your time between hands-on fabrication in our Sedalia facility (~70%) and field support (~20–30%). From cutting and assembling PVC/CPVC systems (with some stainless in the mix), this is precision, hands-on work where what you build is exactly what ships—no separation between effort and outcome. The other 20–30% of the time, you’re on-site, in front of the customer, watching your system come to life.

You’ll verify installations, run wet and leak testing, and troubleshoot in real time—making the call when something’s off and fixing it before it slows the project down. When things don’t go to plan—and sometimes they won’t—you’re the one who figures it out and keeps everything moving. We’re not standing still either. We’re expanding and actively scaling, with a strong pipeline of projects already lined up. You won’t be stepping into maintenance mode—you’ll be stepping into build mode, where your impact is visible from day one. If you read mechanical drawings, system layouts, without hesitation, work confidently in fabrication, and communicate clearly when it matters—especially under pressure—you’ll do well here. More importantly, this is for someone who takes ownership when the system is live, not just when it’s on paper.  
Bottom line: This role is built for someone who wants to go beyond building parts—someone who takes pride in building complete systems and seeing them through to successful startup and real-world performance.

Responsibilities
  • Operate fabrication equipment including saws, drills, routers, CNC machines, and injection molding equipment to cut, drill, and assemble PVC/CPVC components.
  • Measure, fit, and assemble parts according to shop drawings, blueprints, and work orders.
  • Perform machine setups, routine maintenance, and troubleshooting to support efficient production operations.
  • Conduct quality inspections to ensure products meet company standards and specifications.
  • Maintain accurate production records and report material usage, equipment issues, or production concerns.
  • Collaborate with team members to meet daily production goals, schedules, and deadlines.
  • Load and unload shipments, pick and pack orders, and assist with inventory management activities.
  • Support field installations and system startups for aeration equipment, including inspections and functional verification.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and communicate effectively with contractors, supervisors, and engineering teams during startup activities.
  • Follow all workplace safety procedures while maintaining a clean, organized, and professional work environment.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED 
  • 1+ years of experience in manufacturing, field experience with equipment installation, startup, troubleshooting.
  • 1+ years experience reading drawings, blue prints, basic system layouts

Core Competencies 
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, blueprints, and system layouts with strong mechanical aptitude and experience using hand tools, power tools, and production equipment.
  • Commitment to quality workmanship with strong attention to detail and adherence to production and inspection standards.
  • Strong problem-solving and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Proficient computer and communication skills for documentation, reporting, production tracking, and collaboration across teams.
  • Adaptable, dependable, and eager to learn new skills while supporting evolving production and field operations.

Preferences: 
  • Experience in pipe fabrication, plumbing, aeration systems, or plastics manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with PVC solvent welding, mechanical fittings, or aeration diffuser systems.
  • OSHA 10/30 safety training.

Travel & Work Arrangements:
  • Based onsite in Sedalia, MO
  • National Field Travel up to 30% 
  • Travel expenses covered to include company Vehicle use

About Us:

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Applications Sales Engineer to support and expand our presence in the water and wastewater treatment industry, serving both municipal and industrial markets. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong commercial acumen to deliver engineered solutions centered on blower systems, with a primary focus on Hoffman & Lamson equipment.

The Senior Applications Engineer serves as a strategic technical sales leader, responsible for driving complex engineered solution sales, influencing customer decisions early in the buying cycle, and owning technical win strategies across key opportunities. This position extends well beyond traditional application support, requiring close partnership with Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to drive revenue growth and successful outcomes.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical authority within the organization. The ideal candidate will bring extensive knowledge of multistage centrifugal blowers, high-speed turbo blowers, regenerative blowers, rotary lobe, and screw blower technologies, along with strong expertise in process applications, controls integration, and system optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical strategy for complex, high-value sales opportunities

  • Partner with Sales to define win strategies and value propositions
  • Drive customer decision-making through value-based positioning
  • Influence bid/no-bid decisions
Customer & Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with engineers, EPCs, OEMs, and end users
  • Influence project specifications early in the procurement and design cycle
  • Evaluate customer requirements and develop optimized solutions
  • Lead executive-level technical discussions
Solution Architecture & Technical Authority

  • Serve as technical subject matter expert for blower technologies and systems across water and wastewater applications
  • Support optimized, integrated solutions for industrial and municipal projects including process air systems, vapor handling and gas boosting/recovery.
  • Act as escalation point for complex applications
  • Support troubleshooting, performance optimization, and retrofit opportunities.
  • Prepare and deliver technical proposals, costing estimates, presentations, and value-based solutions.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building

  • Partner with Product Management on VOC and roadmap
  • Mentor Sales Engineering and Sales Teams
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Operations on Product Roadmaps and Life cycle management
  • Lead resolution of critical escalations
  • Provide training and technical guidance to customers and internal teams
Post-Sale Strategic Engagement

  • Provide oversight on key projects
  • Drive long-term customer success
Revenue Impact & Pipeline Ownership

  • Contribute to pipeline growth, support forecasting accuracy and win rates
  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities
Industry Engagement

  • Deliver advanced training strategies both internal and external
  • Represent company at Industry Events/Conferences/Tradeshows (as needed)
Qualifications Required Experience

  • 12+ years in applications engineering or technical sales--This is a benchmark, ok with a little less or a little more experience, for the right candidate. We need a Sr level person.
  • Experience selling complex engineered and configured systems in water & wastewater industry applications
  • Experience working with EPCs, General Contractors, and Customers in Industrial + Municipal Markets
  • Proven success closing high-value deals--Need to be able to able to speak to this Tech in a sales environment with customers, reps, etc…
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of municipal and industrial treatment processes and systems (Aerations systems including pre-treatment, SBRs, MBRs, secondary clarification, tertiary/advanced treatment, sludge handling etc)
  • Hands-on experience with, familiar with or has relevant experience in multistage centrifugal blowers, positive displacement (rotary lobe and screw), high speed turbo blowers and regenerative blowers
  • Basic understanding of controls systems (PLC/SCADA) and system integration.
  • Proven track record in technical sales or applications engineering.
Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Industrial, or related discipline) preferred, or equivalent combination of technical education and relevant industry or business experience.
Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Commercial acumen, ability to bridge engineering and sales
  • Executive-level communication
  • Technical expertise with Blower Technologies and Applications
  • Leadership and influence
  • Customer-focused solution development
  • Leadership and mentorship capability
Tools & Systems

  • Experience leveraging CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, SAP) for workload metrics and decision-making.
  • Experience and proficiency with multistage centrifugal, positive displacement and high speed turbo blower selection/sizing software.
Travel & Work Environment Hybrid role with 25% travel.

Job Overview: At Gardner Denver – Industrial Technology and Services, LLC, a division of Ingersoll Rand, your leadership will directly impact product performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence at our Sedalia facility.

The Warehouse & Shipping Supervisor will lead first-shift warehouse, shipping, and aftermarket operations. This hands-on position extends well beyond traditional dock supervision and requires proven strength across warehouse operations, inventory flow, and daily shipping execution. The supervisor will also lead an aftermarket team responsible for packing and shipping lubricants, filters, and other customer-requested products. Because the position spans multiple operational areas, it requires a versatile professional who can manage changing priorities, work effectively through ambiguity, and maintain a clear understanding of the broader warehouse operation.

The ideal candidate will bring proven supervisory experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to keep people, products, and processes moving efficiently. This professional will take ownership of the operation, strengthen accountability, drive continuous improvement, and turn frontline ideas into meaningful results. Ready to lead more than the shipping dock? Join our Sedalia team and help drive the entire operation forward.


Responsibilities:
  • Operations: Plans, organizes and delegates work assignments in order to best utilize man-hours, skills, and equipment.
  • Production: Anticipate production problems and devise and implement procedures to offset lost production and schedule interruptions.
  • Management: Involved in the recruitment, training, goal-setting and performance management of production staff.
  • Training: Coordinates and participates in a variety of training programs for employees.
  • Plant Safety: Inspects machines and equipment. Polices the use of safety equipment, departmental housekeeping and maintains a continual alert for hazardous conditions.
  • Employee Safety: Proactively supervise safety, including accident investigation and follow-up, departmental inspections, employee training, and safety rule enforcement.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience in warehouse operations to include inventory control and shipping flow
  • 1+ years of experience in team supervisory or as a team lead

Core Competencies
  • Warehouse and Inventory Acumen: Understands warehouse operations, inventory control, shipping flow, and the importance of accuracy in a revenue-generating environment.
  • Hands-On Floor Presence: Spends time on the floor learning processes, understanding workflows, and building credibility with the team.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities, solves problems, and implements practical improvements.
  • Operational Leadership: Leads daily shipping and aftermarket operations while keeping the team focused, accountable, and aligned with business needs.
  • Accountability Mindset: Sets clear expectations, follows through, coaches employees, and addresses performance effectively.
  • Adaptability: Operates comfortably in gray areas and manages changing customer orders, aftermarket products, and operational priorities.

Preferences:
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • SAP experience 
  • Experience in a variable warehouse environment beyond single-product or repetitive shipping operations.
  • Demonstrated career progression within one organization through promotions or expanded responsibility.
  • Experience leading process improvements or operational change initiatives.
  • Manufacturing or industrial operations experience and significant warehouse exposure.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • Based in Sedalia, MO (onsite) 
  • This is first shift and starts between 6:00- 7:00am

job.title: Senior Application Engineer
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Application Engineer is the technical authority responsible for supporting customers, sales teams, and channel partners with engineering expertise in compressed air purification and gas generation systems. This role provides advanced product selection, system design support, sizing calculations, and technical proposals for air treatment equipment such as desiccant dryers, refrigerated dryers, filtration systems, condensate management, and on?site gas generation. This position also plays a key role in driving solution accuracy, improving engineering tools, and mentoring junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application & Technical Support

  • Provide expert-level application guidance on compressed air and gas treatment solutions.
  • Select and size air dryers, filtration, and gas generation equipment based on customer operating conditions, ISO 8573.1 requirements, dew point specifications, and environmental factors.
  • Evaluate customer data on pressure, flow, inlet temperature, ambient conditions, and contamination levels to recommend optimal solutions.
  • Review engineering drawings, P&IDs, and customer specifications to ensure compliance and identify risks or deviations.
2. Proposal & Solution Development

  • Prepare detailed technical proposals, system schematics, tender responses, and custom configuration documents.
  • Develop system layouts including dryers, filters, aftercoolers, condensate drains, receivers, controls, and interconnecting piping.
  • Perform dew point calculations, purge air calculations, and pressure drop estimations.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to ensure feasibility of custom configurations.
3. Cross?Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, and Quality to support winning project bids.
  • Provide technical input for New Product Introduction (NPI) and voice-of-customer data.
  • Assist Field Service with complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Support Operations with technical clarification needed for build?to?order systems.
4. Customer Interaction & Training

  • Participate in customer meetings, technical workshops, on?site assessments, and presentations.
  • Deliver training to distributors, internal teams, and customers on air treatment technologies, system balancing, and proper installation.
  • Build credibility through responsive, accurate, and high?quality technical communication.
5. Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and improve sizing tools, configurators, technical databases, and engineering templates.
  • Develop standard work, application guides, and best?practice documents for internal and external use.
  • Mentor junior application engineers through guidance, coaching, and technical reviews.
Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related technical field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in application engineering or technical support within industrial air treatment, compressed air systems, or related process equipment.

Highly Preferred
  • Strong experience with desiccant dryers, refrigerated dryers, filtration, gas generation, or HVAC/process air handling preferred.
  • Experience with ISO 8573.1, NFPA, OSHA, and industry air quality standards is advantageous.
Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of adsorption/absorption principles, heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and pneumatic systems.
  • Ability to perform dew point, heat load, pressure drop, purge loss, and filtration efficiency calculations.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools (AutoCAD, Inventor ) for system layout support.
  • Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, technical specifications, and electrical schematics.
  • Proficiency with MS Office, CRM/ERP systems, and engineering sizing software.
Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex engineering concepts.
  • Highly analytical with strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong project management and multitasking ability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-first mindset with a collaborative working style.
  • Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead by example.
Key Competencies

  • Technical Mastery in Air Treatment
  • Application & System Design
  • Customer Engagement
  • Cross?Functional Collaboration
  • Analytical Decision Making
  • Engineering Documentation
  • Project Coordination
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Coaching & Mentoring
Working Conditions

  • Mix of office, manufacturing, and occasional customer site environments.
  • Travel requirement: typically 10–20%, including customer visits and field troubleshooting.

job.description:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. 

Job Title: Inside Sales and Service Representative - Parts
Location: Kansas City, MO (Onsite)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
This is an Inside Sales & Service - Parts position based out of the Kansas City Customer Center. The role includes sales support from the time of inquiry to delivery, which requires parts identification, quoting, order confirmation/purchase order receipt, pricing, order processing, expediting, and problem solving. As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers.For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities.

Responsibilities:

  • Handling inbound customer requests to generate sales of compressed air products, services, and parts.
  • Assist customers with parts identification and generate quotes for customers to ensure quotes successfully transition to orders.  
  • Manage these orders to ensure delivery schedule is achieved.
  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.  
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance. 
  • Operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience in customer service related role
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Office computer applications
  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  

Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely   
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods    
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task
  • Thinks and acts strategically   
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner  

Preferences:

  • Associates or Bachelors degree
  • Technical background
  • Experience using Salesforce

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • This position will be based in Kansas City, MO, and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.? It requires employees to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move 40+ lbs.  

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Location: Kansas City, MO (Onsite)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview: 
This is an Inside Sales & Service - Parts position based out of the Kansas City Customer Center. The role includes sales support from the time of inquiry to delivery, which requires parts identification, quoting, order confirmation/purchase order receipt, pricing, order processing, expediting, and problem solving. As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers.For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities.

Responsibilities:

  • Handling inbound customer requests to generate sales of compressed air products, services, and parts.
  • Assist customers with parts identification and generate quotes for customers to ensure quotes successfully transition to orders.  
  • Manage these orders to ensure delivery schedule is achieved.
  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.  
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance. 
  • Operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience in customer service related role
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Office computer applications
  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  

Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely   
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods    
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task
  • Thinks and acts strategically   
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner  

Preferences:

  • Associates or Bachelors degree
  • Technical background
  • Experience using Salesforce

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • This position will be based in Kansas City, MO, and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.? It requires employees to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move 40+ lbs.

  Job title: Senior Blower Applications Engineer

About Us:

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Applications Sales Engineer to support and expand our presence in the water and wastewater treatment industry, serving both municipal and industrial markets. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong commercial acumen to deliver engineered solutions centered on blower systems, with a primary focus on Hoffman & Lamson equipment.

The Senior Applications Engineer serves as a strategic technical sales leader, responsible for driving complex engineered solution sales, influencing customer decisions early in the buying cycle, and owning technical win strategies across key opportunities. This position extends well beyond traditional application support, requiring close partnership with Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to drive revenue growth and successful outcomes.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical authority within the organization. The ideal candidate will bring extensive knowledge of multistage centrifugal blowers, high-speed turbo blowers, regenerative blowers, rotary lobe, and screw blower technologies, along with strong expertise in process applications, controls integration, and system optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical strategy for complex, high-value sales opportunities

  • Partner with Sales to define win strategies and value propositions
  • Drive customer decision-making through value-based positioning
  • Influence bid/no-bid decisions
Customer & Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with engineers, EPCs, OEMs, and end users
  • Influence project specifications early in the procurement and design cycle
  • Evaluate customer requirements and develop optimized solutions
  • Lead executive-level technical discussions
Solution Architecture & Technical Authority

  • Serve as technical subject matter expert for blower technologies and systems across water and wastewater applications
  • Support optimized, integrated solutions for industrial and municipal projects including process air systems, vapor handling and gas boosting/recovery.
  • Act as escalation point for complex applications
  • Support troubleshooting, performance optimization, and retrofit opportunities.
  • Prepare and deliver technical proposals, costing estimates, presentations, and value-based solutions.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building

  • Partner with Product Management on VOC and roadmap
  • Mentor Sales Engineering and Sales Teams
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Operations on Product Roadmaps and Life cycle management
  • Lead resolution of critical escalations
  • Provide training and technical guidance to customers and internal teams
Post-Sale Strategic Engagement

  • Provide oversight on key projects
  • Drive long-term customer success
Revenue Impact & Pipeline Ownership

  • Contribute to pipeline growth, support forecasting accuracy and win rates
  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities
Industry Engagement

  • Deliver advanced training strategies both internal and external
  • Represent company at Industry Events/Conferences/Tradeshows (as needed)
Qualifications Required Experience

  • 12+ years in applications engineering or technical sales--This is a benchmark, ok with a little less or a little more experience, for the right candidate. We need a Sr level person.
  • Experience selling complex engineered and configured systems in water & wastewater industry applications
  • Experience working with EPCs, General Contractors, and Customers in Industrial + Municipal Markets
  • Proven success closing high-value deals--Need to be able to able to speak to this Tech in a sales environment with customers, reps, etc…
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of municipal and industrial treatment processes and systems (Aerations systems including pre-treatment, SBRs, MBRs, secondary clarification, tertiary/advanced treatment, sludge handling etc)
  • Hands-on experience with, familiar with or has relevant experience in multistage centrifugal blowers, positive displacement (rotary lobe and screw), high speed turbo blowers and regenerative blowers
  • Basic understanding of controls systems (PLC/SCADA) and system integration.
  • Proven track record in technical sales or applications engineering.
Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Industrial, or related discipline) preferred, or equivalent combination of technical education and relevant industry or business experience.
Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Commercial acumen, ability to bridge engineering and sales
  • Executive-level communication
  • Technical expertise with Blower Technologies and Applications
  • Leadership and influence
  • Customer-focused solution development
  • Leadership and mentorship capability
Tools & Systems

  • Experience leveraging CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, SAP) for workload metrics and decision-making.
  • Experience and proficiency with multistage centrifugal, positive displacement and high speed turbo blower selection/sizing software.
Travel & Work Environment Hybrid role with 25% travel.

Job Title: Regional Sales Manager
Location: Remote within territory (MI, OH. KY, WV, PA, MD, DE, NJ, NY, CT, VT, RI, MA, NH, ME)

About Us

SEEPEX, an acquisition of Ingersoll Rand in 2021, is a leading worldwide specialist in pump technology. SEEPEX progressive cavity pumps, pump systems and digital solutions are used wherever low to highly viscous, aggressive, or abrasive media must be conveyed at low pulsation rates – we keep everything flowing. For more information visit: https://www.seepex.com/ 

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales growth within the Southeast territory by managing and developing distributor/channel partner relationships, meeting or exceeding booking targets, and serving as the product and technical expert for industrial pump solutions. This role is a highly autonomous, individual contributor position requiring strong technical aptitude, customer-facing skills, and extensive travel.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and grow distributor/channel partner relationships across the assigned territory

  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers, distributors, and the internal SEEPEX sales and operations teams

  • Achieve or exceed annual bookings and sales targets for the territory

  • Support distributors with technical expertise, product application knowledge, and solution development

  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop quotations, manage opportunities, and support order execution

  • Conduct product presentations, training, and sales meetings for distributors and end users

  • Identify new business opportunities and drive market share growth

  • Accurately forecast sales activity and maintain CRM and reporting expectations

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

  • 3+ years of field sales experience.

  • 1+ year prior experience selling, supporting, or applying industrial pump solutions in a field sales or technical sales environment.

  • 1+ year working knowledge of pump fundamentals, including applications, sizing considerations, and performance characteristics.

  • 1+ year experience discussing pump solutions with distributors, customers, and engineers, including technical and commercial requirements.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to navigate complex technical discussions

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to both small and large groups

  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, field-based role

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities

Preferences:

  • Degree in engineering, business, or a related field

  • Experience within industrial, manufacturing, or process-related markets

  • Prior exposure to highly technical, application-driven sales environments

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

This position is fully remote and requires approximately 75% travel within the assigned territory (MI, OH. KY, WV, PA, MD, DE, NJ, NY, CT, VT, RI, MA, NH, ME)
A company vehicle is provided. Candidates must be able to travel by car and air as needed to support customer and distributor demands.

Pay Range:

The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $90,000 – $115,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and geographic location. Hired applicants will be eligible to participate in a Sales Incentive Plan with a target incentive of approximately 30% of base salary.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage, wellness programs, life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings.  These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Location:  Multiple positions available (Los Angeles, CA; San Diego, CA; Phoenix, AZ; Las Vegas, NV, Tulsa, OK, Edmond, OK, Dallas, TX, San Antonio, TX)


About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required. 

•Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; speciality tools will be provided.

Core Competencies: 
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

 

Pay Range:

Starting pay will range between $25.00 - $40.00 per hour depending on multiple factors, including candidate qualifications and experience. It is not typical for candidates to be paid at the top of the range. This is a full-time, hourly position.

Job Overview:

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales growth within the Southeast territory by managing and developing distributor/channel partner relationships, meeting or exceeding booking targets, and serving as the product and technical expert for industrial pump solutions. This role is a highly autonomous, individual contributor position requiring strong technical aptitude, customer-facing skills, and extensive travel.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and grow distributor/channel partner relationships across the assigned territory

  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers, distributors, and the internal SEEPEX sales and operations teams

  • Achieve or exceed annual bookings and sales targets for the territory

  • Support distributors with technical expertise, product application knowledge, and solution development

  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop quotations, manage opportunities, and support order execution

  • Conduct product presentations, training, and sales meetings for distributors and end users

  • Identify new business opportunities and drive market share growth

  • Accurately forecast sales activity and maintain CRM and reporting expectations

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

  • 3+ years of field sales experience.

  • 1+ year experience discussing pump solutions with distributors, customers, and engineers, including technical and commercial requirements.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to navigate complex technical discussions

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to both small and large groups

  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, field-based role

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities

Preferences:

  • Experience within industrial, manufacturing, or process-related markets

  • Prior exposure to highly technical, application-driven sales environments

This position is fully remote and requires approximately 75% travel within the assigned territory (MI, OH. KY, WV, PA, MD, DE, NJ, NY, CT, VT, RI, MA, NH, ME)
A company vehicle is provided. Candidates must be able to travel by car and air as needed to support customer and distributor demands.

Job Overview: 
This role plays a critical role in delivering a differentiated customer experience and driving growth within key strategic accounts across North America, including ARO, MPOB/IRP, Hartell, and Rotodel brands. 

This role serves as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for high-value customers within key growth segments such as Data Center and Advanced Dispense. The position is accountable for end-to-end account management, ensuring seamless execution across the order-to-cash lifecycle while proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen engagement, remove operational barriers, and support revenue growth. 

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance to influence outcomes, resolve complex issues, and deliver customer-centric solutions. The Customer Experience Account Manager is expected to balance strategic account management with operational excellence, while reducing administrative work through standardization and leveraging support resources. 

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for assigned strategic and high-growth accounts, ensuring a consistently high level of service and engagement 
  • Develop deep understanding of customer business models, priorities, and growth opportunities to proactively align solutions and drive long-term partnerships 
  • Execute customer engagement strategies in partnership with Sales to increase market share, retention, and overall satisfaction 
  • Oversee complex, non-standard orders and proactively manage order flow, backlog, and delivery commitments to ensure accuracy and timeliness  
  • Own and manage the end-to-end customer journey, from order intake through fulfillment, invoicing, and post-delivery support 
  • Resolve escalations and complex issues related to pricing, inventory, delivery, and contracts using sound judgment and decision-making authority 
  • Handle escalations related to inventory constraints, delivery delays, pricing discrepancies, and contractual exceptions 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally and influence outcomes to remove barriers, improve the order-to-cash process, and enhance service performance 
  • Lead data accuracy, and operational efficiency  
  • Own the development and implementation of standard work and process improvements for the CX team 
  • Drive continuous improvement focused on process standardization for account management and customer service processes 
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert and resource for ERP systems (SAP) and for the CX team; providing mentorship, guidance, and training to new and developing team members 


Requirements:

  • High School or G.E.D.
  • 5+ years of experience in account management, customer service, or sales, preferably in a B2B environment 


Core Competencies:

  • Ability to build and sustain strategic relationships across multiple levels within customer organizations 
  • Strong customer advocacy and problem-solving capabilities 
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment 
  • Effective cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills 
  • Experience mentoring, training, or onboarding team members 
  • Strong business acumen with a customer and growth mindset 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
  • High attention to detail and organizational effectiveness 


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain or Finance
  • Experience using SAP or a similar ERP tool


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite with up to 5% travel
