Job Overview: 

The CNC Machine Operator is an experienced machine operator who is disciplined, creative and an excellent problem solver who will thrive in our lean manufacturing environment.  A successful candidate is a reliable individual who is able to read blueprints and hold tight tolerances with a strong mechanical aptitude. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Follow Standard Work Machine set up, running parts and preventative maintenance (PM).
  • Inspect, deburr, and perform manual operations and/or operate other equipment, including the selection and presetting of tools which will be required for the next scheduled job.
  • Update and maintain all visual controls and Create and/or support countermeasures and operate in and maintain a clean and safe environment.
  • Participate and engage in SMED, Kaizen events, and ‘5 Whys’ problem-solving exercises.

Job Title: Senior Lean Leader
Location: Ivyland, PA (Hybrid)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Lean Leader to drive operational excellence across multiple production sites. In this role, you will lead large-scale Lean and footprint initiatives, build Lean capability within site teams, and develop internal ‘multipliers’—employees who can independently apply Lean tools to sustain long-term improvements. The purpose of the role is to help build an organization that uses lean tools to drive tangible productivity that helps us achieve our financial goals. This position requires deep technical knowledge of lean tools, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver efficiency improvements, cost reductions, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Lean Leadership Across Multiple Sites:
  • Lead and coordinate Lean transformation initiatives across several factories.
  • Conduct Value Stream Mapping to evaluate processes and design future workflows.
  • Drive company-wide adoption of Lean principles through structured deployment.
  • Capability Building & Coaching:
  • Train and develop Lean practitioners to build a network of Lean multipliers.
  • Facilitate workshops on A3 problem solving, 5S, and other Lean tools.
  • Coach plant leaders and CI teams in daily Lean application.
  • Continuous Improvement Execution:
  • Lead Kaizen events and improvement projects across sites.
  • Ensure consistent Lean methods across factories.
  • Analyze KPIs to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Change Management & Stakeholder Alignment:
  • Support leadership in building a continuous improvement culture.
  • Communicate progress and resource needs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in Lean/CI in multi-site manufacturing.
  • 5+ years of experience in VSM, A3, 5S, Standard Work, RCA, PDCA.
  • Any lean related certification.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills.
  • Technical Mastery in applying lean tools.
  • Strategic Thinking & System-Level Understanding.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement.
  • Problem-Solving & Root-Cause Analysis.

Preferences:

  • Mechanical Engineering degree.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience in machining environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Ivyland, PA (Hybrid).

Location: Austin, TX 

 

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview: 

The Customer Service Representative serves as a vital connection between our customers and the company, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and care. In this role, you will prepare precise quotes and purchase orders, respond to inquiries with attention to detail, and provide solutions for questions related to accounts, billing, refunds, cancellations, and general service needs. 

You will also engage with existing customers to strengthen relationships, support sales of products and services, and communicate relevant offers and promotions. Customer Service Representatives assist customers with technical products both by email and phone. Success in this role requires the ability to multitask effectively, provide courteous and knowledgeable support, and confidently navigate technical terminology and specifications. 


Responsibilities: 

  • Respond to customer inquiries and resolve complaints through phone, email, and other communication channels. 
  • Prepare accurate quotes and process orders, exchanges, refunds, and cancellations. 
  • Verify, update, and maintain customer account information with attention to detail. 
  • Provide information on products, services, warranties, and terms of sale.

About Us:

Job Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Lean Leader to drive operational excellence across multiple production sites. In this role, you will lead large-scale Lean and footprint initiatives, build Lean capability within site teams, and develop internal ‘multipliers’—employees who can independently apply Lean tools to sustain long-term improvements. The purpose of the role is to help build an organization that uses lean tools to drive tangible productivity that helps us achieve our financial goals. This position requires deep technical knowledge of lean tools, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver efficiency improvements, cost reductions, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Lean Leadership Across Multiple Sites:
  • Lead and coordinate Lean transformation initiatives across several factories.
  • Conduct Value Stream Mapping to evaluate processes and design future workflows.
  • Drive company-wide adoption of Lean principles through structured deployment.
  • Capability Building & Coaching:
  • Train and develop Lean practitioners to build a network of Lean multipliers.
  • Facilitate workshops on A3 problem solving, 5S, and other Lean tools.
  • Coach plant leaders and CI teams in daily Lean application.
  • Continuous Improvement Execution:
  • Lead Kaizen events and improvement projects across sites.
  • Ensure consistent Lean methods across factories.
  • Analyze KPIs to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Change Management & Stakeholder Alignment:
  • Support leadership in building a continuous improvement culture.
  • Communicate progress and resource needs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in Lean/CI in multi-site manufacturing.
  • 5+ years of experience in VSM, A3, 5S, Standard Work, RCA, PDCA.
  • Any lean related certification.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills.
  • Technical Mastery in applying lean tools.
  • Strategic Thinking & System-Level Understanding.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement.
  • Problem-Solving & Root-Cause Analysis.

Preferences:

  • Mechanical Engineering degree.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience in machining environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Ivyland, PA (Hybrid).

Job Overview:

Power Tools and Lifting Equipment division of Ingersoll Rand has an opportunity to join the Commercial Sales Team as a Specialty Commercial Account Manager.  We are committed to building strong partnerships – both with our distributors, customers and our cross-functional teams.  This position will be responsible for relationship-building, project management, vendor management, problem-solving, and deliver exceptional customer experience. 

 

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for specialty, ERGO and custom order process and will ensure smooth order execution, proactive communication, project management and long-term account growth.  In addition, the position will be asked to assist with problem solving for products manufactured within the company and with vendors. This position will be a hybrid position and will work on site at the Southern Pines, NC manufacturing plant 3 days each week.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage client accounts as the primary point of contact, ensuring clear communication, proactive support, and strong long-term relationships.
  • Drive account growth by identifying expansion opportunities, leading account reviews, and enhancing product and service offerings.
  • Oversee vendor and customer relationships to ensure timely product delivery and high customer satisfaction.
  • Review quotes, convert opportunities into orders, and manage custom-order projects from initiation through delivery.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Production, Quality, Sales, and Marketing to align resources, schedules, and customer priorities.
  • Maintain accurate order documentation, production schedules, shipment records, and sales activity reporting.
  • Analyze customer demand, order trends, forecasting data, and SKU performance to support planning and operational efficiency.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives, support cross-functional project execution, and mentor team members involved in account coordination.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of work experience within an Industrial Sales, Account Management or Customer Service within a Manufacturing environment

Core Competences:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Customer service mindset with strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
  • Detail-oriented, especially with data entry, tracking, and documentation
  • Collaborative and team-focused, with the ability to work across departments
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications required; ability to navigate internal software programs will be needed after hire. Oracle experience a plus

Preferences:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering or a related field preferred. 
  • System experience, Oracle r12, Windchill, Creo, Microsoft Excel and Salesforce experience preferred

  • Local travel to vendor sites

Title: Material Handler
Location:
Ivyland, PA (Onsite) (Milton Roy - 201 Ivyland Rd. Warminster, PA 18974) 
1st Shift Mon - Fri (7am - 3:30pm)

 

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Material Handler to support the efficient operation of our manufacturing facility. This position is responsible for receiving, storing, moving, and distributing materials, components, and supplies throughout the plant while maintaining accurate inventory records. The Material Handler will work closely with Production, Procurement, and Quality teams to ensure materials are available when needed, production schedules are met, and safety and quality standards are maintained. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, team-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

Material Handling & Inventory Control

  • Receive, move, stage, and distribute materials between receiving, warehouse, and production areas to support production schedules and TAKT requirements.
  • Maintain accurate inventory locations and transactions in JD Edwards, including material transfers, bin locations, part receipts, and work order staging.
  • Perform cycle counts, monitor inventory levels, and identify and report shortages, discrepancies, damaged materials, or non-conforming products.
  • Load, unload, and transport materials safely using forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment.
  • Inspect incoming and outgoing materials for quantity and quality accuracy and prepare materials for shipment with appropriate packaging and documentation.
  • Complete production logs, inventory transactions, work orders, and other required documentation accurately and timely.
  • Support quality and MRB processes by documenting defects, deviations, and non-conforming materials in accordance with company and ISO requirements.
  • Follow all safety, PPE, EHS, and 5S requirements while maintaining a clean and organized work environment.\

Core Competencies:

  • Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Effective communication and teamwork across Production, Quality, Receiving, and other departments.
  • Strong safety awareness and commitment to established procedures.
  • Basic computer and inventory system skills with the ability to accurately complete electronic transactions.
  • Ability to identify and communicate material, quality, or inventory issues in a timely manner.

 

Preferences:

  • Previous material handling, warehouse, or manufacturing experience.
  • Forklift and pallet jack operation experience.
  • Experience with JD Edwards or a similar ERP/inventory management system.
  • Experience performing cycle counts and maintaining inventory accuracy.
  • Familiarity with 5S, ISO, EHS, and manufacturing quality requirements.


Qualifications:  
 

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED), required
  • 1 – 2 years’ experience in Material Handling or manufacturing environment, preferred
  • Ability to operate fork trucks, preferred
  • Demonstrated time management skills, strategic thinking, and adaptability
  • General computer knowledge (i.e. log on credentials (SSO), JD Edwards, and Microsoft Outlook)
  • Ability to lift up to 35lbs

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

Fully onsite no traveling required for this role.

Title: Generalist Maintenance Technician
Location: Sedalia, MO (Gardner Denver - 305 N State Fair Blvd. Sedalia, MO 65301)
Shift: 2nd Shift, Monday - Friday 3PM - 1130PM
 
About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview: 
The Maintenance Technician plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of facilities. Responsibilities include promptly addressing repair requests, maintaining safety measures (such as alarms and fire systems), and handling emergency maintenance tasks. This role requires communication skills, adaptability, and knowledge of building systems and tools. Maintenance technicians contribute to the overall functionality and safety of the facility. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Install, troubleshoot, repair and maintain CNC machinery, electrical systems, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment. Start machines and observe mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems. Install, replace, or change machine parts and attachments, according to production specifications. 
  • Reassemble machines after the completion of repair or maintenance work. Dismantle machines and remove parts for repair, using hand tools, chain falls, jacks, cranes, or hoists. 
  • Inspect or test damaged machine parts and mark defective areas or advise supervisors of repair needs. 
  • Lubricate or apply adhesives or other materials to machines, machine parts, or other equipment, according to specified procedures. 
  • Record production, repair, and machine maintenance information. 
  • Read work orders and specifications to determine machines and equipment requiring repair or maintenance. 
  • Set up and operate machines and adjust controls to regulate operations. 
  • Collaborate with other workers to repair or move machines, machine parts, or equipment. 
  • Inventory and requisition machine parts, equipment, and other supplies so that stock can be maintained and replenished. 
  • Transport machine parts, tools, equipment, and other material between work areas and storage, using cranes, hoists, or dollies. 
  • Collect and discard worn machine parts and other refuse in order to maintain machinery and work areas. 
  • Clean machines and machine parts, using cleaning solvents, cloths, air guns, hoses, vacuums, or other equipment. 
  • Replace or repair metal, wood, leather, glass, or other lining in machines, or in equipment compartments or containers. 
  • Inspect, and adjust machine geometry. 
  • Troubleshoot, and repair servo drives, motors, computer systems and NC controls, and high voltage systems up to 480VAC 3 phase. 
  • Inspect, and repair Power transmissions, and gear boxes. Fabrication of brackets, hangers, and special tools needed for repairs.
  • Develops, coordinates & maintains TPM events in the facility
  • Flexible to train and lead events on off-shift as required
  • Coordinate maintenance & PM repairs with production master techs and team leaders
  • Works with blueprints, diagrams, and schematics to diagnose and remedy electronic problems
  • Must have knowledge of basic electronics, analog & digital, logic circuitry and the use of multimeters, oscilloscopes and logic probes

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing Maintenance.

Core Competencies: 

  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, electronic, CNC machines and controls. 
  • Ability to work with concepts when detailed prints, drawings, and specifications are not available.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation for equipment and processes.
  • Ability to maintain mechanical machine tools to include lathes, grinders, mills, drills, machining centers, and other similar equipment.
  • Ability to interpret schematics and blueprints.
  • Exhibits teamwork skills
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs. alone, or 70 lbs. with assistance, repeatedly over an 8-hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.

Preferences: 

  • High School Diploma or GED 
  • 3+ years of experience in a CNC machine maintenance.
  • Technical degree in Industrial Maintenance or equivalent Preferred  

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Sedalia, MO no travel.

Title: CNC Machinist
Location: Mocksville, NC (Onsite) (338 Valley Rd. Mocksville, NC 27028) 
Shift: 3rd Shift (Monday - Friday 11PM - 7AM) - Full-time Direct Hire

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
We are looking for a skilled CNC Machinist to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands. 

You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. and follow them with precision.

Responsibilities:

  • Uses blueprints, sketches, drawings, and/or job instruction sheets to produce dimensions and tolerances of finished work-piece and setup requirements.
  • Cutting tools, attachments, accessories, and materials on machines such as mills, lathes, grinders, machining centers, drill presses, and drill machines.
  • Enters commands to retrieve, input, or edit control information for CNC machines.
  • Sets up, operates, and monitors machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining, and adjusts machine controls or control media as required.
  • Utilizes a variety of measurement tools and methods to evaluate finished parts against specifications.
  • Reworks parts that don't meet specifications.
  • Confers with supervisor, engineers, and production personnel to resolve machining problems.
  • Follows all ISO procedures and safety rules, including wearing personal safety equipment and performing hoist inspections.
  • Routes completed parts to next machine according to the routing sequence.
  • Performs data entry on the computer to update part locations.
  • Updates work order cover sheets, daily production sheets, status sheets, and quality records.
  • Participates in regular communication among peers and Team Leads to maintain productivity and solve problems as they arise.
  • Operates with the close attention to detail required to meet print specifications, down to 0.0002in tolerances.
  • Maintains 5S standards of organization and housekeeping of work area.
  • Participates in improvement efforts for cell layout, process efficiencies, etc.
  • Attends monthly departmental meetings and quarterly town hall meetings.
  • Other assigned duties

Requirements:
  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of CNC machining experience

Key Competencies:
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, blueprints, memos, and procedure manuals. 
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Ability to perform basic calculations with numbers between 0.0001 and 0.1 
  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure. 
  • Ability to understand and carry out detailed written or oral instructions. 
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (ie. 5 Whys) as trained
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs alone, or 70 lbs with assistance, repeatedly over an 8 hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.

Preferences:
  • Associates degree, or training certification
  • Ability to effectively use tools such as the following: depth gages, bore gages, height gages, feeler gages, micrometers, calipers, deburring tools, die grinders, drill presses, overhead lifting equipment, etc.

 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Job Overview:
 

The Warehouse Associate (Material Handler) distributes either production or non - production items and materials to various locations throughout the warehouse. Materials may consist of purchased parts, in process parts, or finished goods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow company packaging procedures and quality standards to ensure products are shipped accurately and safely.
  • Review shipments and related documentation for quality, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Verify shipping details and special customer instructions.
  • Inspect, weigh, label, and package products for shipment.
  • Move materials and products throughout the warehouse to support production and customer fulfillment.
  • Maintain an organized, clean, and safe work environment.
  • Assist at various workstations as needed to support team goals.
  • Properly dispose of packaging materials, including cardboard and strapping.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts and support operational excellence.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • At least 1 year of experience in a manufacturing or warehouse environment, preferably in material handling.
  • Working knowledge of inventory management processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Dependable, accountable, and committed to meeting deadlines and commitments.
  • Ability to follow work instructions, maintain attendance standards, and adapt to changing priorities.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and/or walk for the duration of the shift.
  • Frequent bending, stooping, and lifting throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds unassisted on a regular basis.
  • Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled warehouse environment.

  Job Title:  Specialty Sales Account Manager – ERGO & Industrial


Location: Southern Pines, NC- Onsite

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  


Job Overview:

Power Tools and Lifting Equipment division of Ingersoll Rand has an opportunity to join the Commercial Sales Team as a Specialty Commercial Account Manager.  We are committed to building strong partnerships – both with our distributors, customers and our cross-functional teams.  This position will be responsible for relationship-building, project management, vendor management, problem-solving, and deliver exceptional customer experience. 

 

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for specialty, ERGO and custom order process and will ensure smooth order execution, proactive communication, project management and long-term account growth.  In addition, the position will be asked to assist with problem solving for products manufactured within the company and with vendors. This position will be a hybrid position and will work on site at the Southern Pines, NC manufacturing plant 3 days each week.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage client accounts as the primary point of contact, ensuring clear communication, proactive support, and strong long-term relationships.
  • Drive account growth by identifying expansion opportunities, leading account reviews, and enhancing product and service offerings.
  • Oversee vendor and customer relationships to ensure timely product delivery and high customer satisfaction.
  • Review quotes, convert opportunities into orders, and manage custom-order projects from initiation through delivery.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Production, Quality, Sales, and Marketing to align resources, schedules, and customer priorities.
  • Maintain accurate order documentation, production schedules, shipment records, and sales activity reporting.
  • Analyze customer demand, order trends, forecasting data, and SKU performance to support planning and operational efficiency.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives, support cross-functional project execution, and mentor team members involved in account coordination.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of work experience within an Industrial Sales, Account Management or Customer Service within a Manufacturing environment

Core Competences:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Customer service mindset with strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
  • Detail-oriented, especially with data entry, tracking, and documentation
  • Collaborative and team-focused, with the ability to work across departments
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications required; ability to navigate internal software programs will be needed after hire. Oracle experience a plus

Preferences:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering or a related field preferred. 
  • System experience, Oracle r12, Windchill, Creo, Microsoft Excel and Salesforce experience preferred
  • Industrial tool, hoist or parts experience preferred 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position will be based in Southern Pines, NC
  • Local travel to vendor sites

Location: Ivyland, PA (Hybrid)

Job Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Lean Leader to drive operational excellence across multiple production sites. In this role, you will lead large-scale Lean and footprint initiatives, build Lean capability within site teams, and develop internal ‘multipliers’—employees who can independently apply Lean tools to sustain long-term improvements. The purpose of the role is to help build an organization that uses lean tools to drive tangible productivity that helps us achieve our financial goals. This position requires deep technical knowledge of lean tools, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver efficiency improvements, cost reductions, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Lean Leadership Across Multiple Sites:
  • Lead and coordinate Lean transformation initiatives across several factories.
  • Conduct Value Stream Mapping to evaluate processes and design future workflows.
  • Drive company-wide adoption of Lean principles through structured deployment.
  • Capability Building & Coaching:
  • Train and develop Lean practitioners to build a network of Lean multipliers.
  • Facilitate workshops on A3 problem solving, 5S, and other Lean tools.
  • Coach plant leaders and CI teams in daily Lean application.
  • Continuous Improvement Execution:
  • Lead Kaizen events and improvement projects across sites.
  • Ensure consistent Lean methods across factories.
  • Analyze KPIs to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Change Management & Stakeholder Alignment:
  • Support leadership in building a continuous improvement culture.
  • Communicate progress and resource needs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in Lean/CI in multi-site manufacturing.
  • 5+ years of experience in VSM, A3, 5S, Standard Work, RCA, PDCA.
  • Any lean related certification.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills.
  • Technical Mastery in applying lean tools.
  • Strategic Thinking & System-Level Understanding.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement.
  • Problem-Solving & Root-Cause Analysis.

Preferences:

  • Mechanical Engineering degree.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience in machining environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Ivyland, PA (Hybrid).

Job Overview: 

The Customer Service Representative serves as a vital connection between our customers and the company, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and care. In this role, you will prepare precise quotes and purchase orders, respond to inquiries with attention to detail, and provide solutions for questions related to accounts, billing, refunds, cancellations, and general service needs. 

You will also engage with existing customers to strengthen relationships, support sales of products and services, and communicate relevant offers and promotions. Customer Service Representatives assist customers with technical products both by email and phone. Success in this role requires the ability to multitask effectively, provide courteous and knowledgeable support, and confidently navigate technical terminology and specifications. 


Responsibilities: 

  • Respond to customer inquiries and resolve complaints through phone, email, and other communication channels. 
  • Prepare accurate quotes and process orders, exchanges, refunds, and cancellations. 
  • Verify, update, and maintain customer account information with attention to detail. 
  • Provide information on products, services, warranties, and terms of sale. 
  • Assist customers with technical products and troubleshooting, offering appropriate solutions. 
  • Communicate offers and promotions, and support sales of products and services. 
  • Handle account related requests, including changes, upgrades, and policy updates. 
  •  Collaborate with the Customer Service Supervisor to ensure effective and consistent service delivery. 

Requirements: 

  • High school diploma required 
  • Bilingual Spanish/English (REQUIRED and critical qualification)
  • 2+ years' experience in customer service.
 
Preferences: 

  • 2+ years B2B customer service experience
  • Experience in manufacturing, warehouse, or industrial environments
  • CRM experience (Salesforce or similar)
  • Microsoft Office / Teams proficiency
  • Some college education preferred
  • Familiarity with safety specification resources or regulated product environments

 Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Fully on-site, 8am-5pm Monday through Friday

Job Title: Marketing Manager (Commercial Excellence)
Location: Remote

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
The commercial excellence manager will own CRM roadmap within the Ingersoll Rands Process Flow Technologies business unit for the North America region, working with business and technical stakeholders to align on priorities. They will establish key performance indicators and targets while enabling commercial teams with visibility and dashboards to drive compliance and performance improvements. The role operates at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Experience, ensuring consistent adoption of commercial standards, pipeline accuracy, and operating excellence that drives a winning customer experience.  

Responsibilities:

Commercial Capability Building - 

Metrics Standards & Insight Engine: Define the KPI architecture (conversion, velocity, win rate, leakage, customer mix) and deliver insights that drive commercial action 
SFDC Accuracy, Governance & Adoption: Establish the global governance model, activity expectations, data quality rules, and compliance cadence that ensure forecasting accuracy and reliable revenue visibility 
Modular Learning Architecture: Develop scalable, role-specific enablement programs—live, recorded, and micro-learning, focused on commercial process mastery, applications, and customer pain points 
Distributor Performance Enablement: Build partner onboarding, funnel-management standards, and performance scorecards that strengthen distributor execution and accountability, business unit ownership of the distributor CRM portal and other tools
Leadership Dashboards & Review Cadence: Build executive dashboards and establish global performance review rhythms that reinforce accountability and pipeline accuracy 
Global Benchmarking & Best-Practice Sharing: Identify high-performing behaviors, codify them into global standards, and drive adoption across markets 

Pipeline Intelligence & Revenue Visibility - 

  • Strategic Revenue Visibility Models: Build forecasting frameworks and future-state pipeline views that illuminate revenue potential by region, segment, and product line 
  • Pipeline Trends, Win/Loss Analytics & Predictive Indicators: Create scalable reporting that surfaces leading indicators, compliance trends, risk signals, and growth drivers 
  • Renewal & Expansion System: Define renewal workflows and build retention, upsell, and cross-sell playbooks that strengthen recurring revenue performance 
  • Consumption & Program Tracking: Standardize tracking of main systems, aftermarket spare parts, recurring programs, renewals, and churn dynamics to improve visibility and execution 

Commercial CRM Roadmap - 

  • Align with business stakeholders on overall priority of CRM capabilities that support business growth and visibility to predictable revenue  
  • Work with technical teams to prioritize business inputs into roadmap of necessary capabilities (e.g. quoting, attribution, ERP integration, CPQ, automation of components, etc.)  
  • Gain stakeholder alignment with roadmap and partner with other technical system owners such as ERP, CPQ, engineering systems and ecommerce
  • Review budget, resource planning and implementation steps with business stakeholders to ensure project success.  

Systems, Tools & Data Governance -

  • Commercial Systems Ownership: Serve as the business owner or co-owner of key commercial tools (Salesforce, CPQ, analytics platforms), defining requirements, partnering with IT, and ensuring tools support global commercial workflows 
  • Data Quality & Segmentation Governance: Define rules for account hierarchy governance, segmentation models, customer classification, data quality, and routing logic 
  • Golden Record Foundation: Partner with IT and Data teams to evolve toward a unified customer “golden record” that improves targeting, visibility, and commercial alignment 
  • Customer Segmentation & Prioritization: Build frameworks that identify priority segments, ICP (ideal customer profile) definitions, and resource allocation strategies 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing.
  • 3+ years of project leadership experience.
  • Understanding of B2B sales processes, funnel management, and commercial execution.
  • 3+ years of experience in Salesforce (data governance, reporting, analytics, dashboards). No coding experience required.  
  • Technical experience with all types of reporting in Salesforce, dashboards and possibilities and limitation of Salesforce objects.  
  • Cross-functional leadership experience across Sales, Marketing, Product, Channel, IT.
  • 3+ years of training design, enablement content creation, and curriculum development.

Commercial Capability Building - 

Metrics Standards & Insight Engine: Define the KPI architecture (conversion, velocity, win rate, leakage, customer mix) and deliver insights that drive commercial action 
SFDC Accuracy, Governance & Adoption: Establish the global governance model, activity expectations, data quality rules, and compliance cadence that ensure forecasting accuracy and reliable revenue visibility 
Modular Learning Architecture: Develop scalable, role-specific enablement programs—live, recorded, and micro-learning, focused on commercial process mastery, applications, and customer pain points 
Distributor Performance Enablement: Build partner onboarding, funnel-management standards, and performance scorecards that strengthen distributor execution and accountability, business unit ownership of the distributor CRM portal and other tools
Leadership Dashboards & Review Cadence: Build executive dashboards and establish global performance review rhythms that reinforce accountability and pipeline accuracy 
Global Benchmarking & Best-Practice Sharing: Identify high-performing behaviors, codify them into global standards, and drive adoption across markets 

Pipeline Intelligence & Revenue Visibility - 

  • Strategic Revenue Visibility Models: Build forecasting frameworks and future-state pipeline views that illuminate revenue potential by region, segment, and product line 
  • Pipeline Trends, Win/Loss Analytics & Predictive Indicators: Create scalable reporting that surfaces leading indicators, compliance trends, risk signals, and growth drivers 
  • Renewal & Expansion System: Define renewal workflows and build retention, upsell, and cross-sell playbooks that strengthen recurring revenue performance 
  • Consumption & Program Tracking: Standardize tracking of main systems, aftermarket spare parts, recurring programs, renewals, and churn dynamics to improve visibility and execution 

Commercial CRM Roadmap - 

  • Align with business stakeholders on overall priority of CRM capabilities that support business growth and visibility to predictable revenue  
  • Work with technical teams to prioritize business inputs into roadmap of necessary capabilities (e.g. quoting, attribution, ERP integration, CPQ, automation of components, etc.)  
  • Gain stakeholder alignment with roadmap and partner with other technical system owners such as ERP, CPQ, engineering systems and ecommerce
  • Review budget, resource planning and implementation steps with business stakeholders to ensure project success.  

Systems, Tools & Data Governance -

  • Commercial Systems Ownership: Serve as the business owner or co-owner of key commercial tools (Salesforce, CPQ, analytics platforms), defining requirements, partnering with IT, and ensuring tools support global commercial workflows 
  • Data Quality & Segmentation Governance: Define rules for account hierarchy governance, segmentation models, customer classification, data quality, and routing logic 
  • Golden Record Foundation: Partner with IT and Data teams to evolve toward a unified customer “golden record” that improves targeting, visibility, and commercial alignment 
  • Customer Segmentation & Prioritization: Build frameworks that identify priority segments, ICP (ideal customer profile) definitions, and resource allocation strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related.

  • 3+ years of project leadership experience.
  • Understanding of B2B sales processes, funnel management, and commercial execution.
  • 3+ years of experience in Salesforce (data governance, reporting, analytics, dashboards). No coding experience required.  
  • Technical experience with all types of reporting in Salesforce, dashboards and possibilities and limitation of Salesforce objects.  
  • Cross-functional leadership experience across Sales, Marketing, Product, Channel, IT.
  • 3+ years of training design, enablement content creation, and curriculum development.

Job Title: Inventory Control Manager
Location: Alsip, IL (Onsite) 

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
Power the heartbeat of industrial innovation. At Ingersoll Rand – Industrial Technologies & Services (ITS), we deliver engineered solutions supporting critical operations across air, gas, fluid, and material handling systems.  We are seeking an Inventory Control Supervisor with proven experience leading direct reports in a discrete industrial manufacturing environment where engineered components, machined parts, and multi-level assemblies are produced and managed. This role owns inventory integrity across a complex materials landscape—far beyond high-volume consumables.

This is a hands-on leader role at the center of plant operations, responsible for driving inventory accuracy across raw materials, work-in-process, and finished assemblies. You will supervise daily inventory activities, enforce standard work, and ensure SAP transactional discipline, maintaining tight alignment between physical inventory and system data. Success in this role requires strong capability in part traceability, revision control, and material flow within an engineered product environment, along with the ability to lead, develop, and hold a team accountable to performance standards. As the steward of inventory accuracy, you will oversee cycle count programs, lead discrepancy investigations, and drive root cause and corrective actions to resolution. You will ensure audit readiness, reinforce internal controls, and deliver clear, consistent KPI reporting.

If you thrive in an environment where precision matters, complexity is the norm, and leadership drives results, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead inventory control activities across raw materials, WIP, finished goods, and MRO inventory.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Apply IR Excellence (IRX) and continuous improvement principles to improve material flow and efficiency.
  • Develop, enhance, and standardize inventory control processes to improve accuracy, and compliance across manufacturing operations.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Production, Scheduling, Purchasing, and Shipping.
  • Analyze inventory KPIs including turns, shortages, and variances.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and EHS standards.
  • Train, coach, and develop team members while fostering accountability and engagement.

Requirements:

  • Associate’s degree
  • 4+ years of experience in inventory control / materials management in an industrial manufacturing setting
  • 3+ years of experience with inventory control audits 
  • 2+ years of experience supervising and leading team members who are direct reports
  • 2+ years of demonstrated experience with SAP
  • 1+ years of experience leading a physical inventory

Core Competencies:

  • Supervisory leadership with a self-directed, team-focused approach
  • Inventory control, material management, and inventory accuracy governance
  • Process development, standardization, and continuous improvement
  • Data analysis, root cause investigation, and problem resolution
  • Strong command of inventory control methodologies, including cycle counting, ABC classification, and FIFO/LIFO principles
  • Proactive communicator skilled in cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Quality
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, operations, or related field
  • 3+ years of SAP experience in IM, MM, and WM

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite in Alsip, IL.

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $85,000 - $115,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Title: Sourcing Engineer
 

Locations: Sidney, OH; Campbellsville, KY; Mocksville, NC; Buffalo, NY
Can be located at one of our Compression Systems manufacturing locations in United States

 


About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.


Job Overview:

 

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Sourcing Engineer to support sourcing for our Norther American compressor products. This person will be a member of our Industrial Technologies & Services Americas Sourcing Organization, supporting the development, implementation, and management of standard and engineered to order products to provide Ingersoll Rand with optimal supply assurance, pricing, flexibility, quality, and delivery performance. The Sourcing Engineer builds and leverages strong working relationships with our engineering teams and key suppliers to ensure cost, quality, and delivery targets are met, as well as works towards good supplier relationships to achieve maximum advantage for Ingersoll Rand and our customers.


 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations and supplier selection
  • Continuously looks for new savings opportunities through analysis of data (spend, purchase price variance, etc.) and hands on review of materials in the production areas.
  • Leads Request for Proposal (RFP) process with all stakeholders.
  • Works with suppliers and internal team members to qualify new parts.
  • Negotiates key items with suppliers including pricing, payment terms, lead time, and inventory programs.
  • Records and tracks information as required for timely and accurate measure of performance regarding sourcing activities and savings.
  • Support the plants to help local teams efficiently resolve escalated issues.
  • Leads Procurement NPD activities through preferred supplier programs and RFQ's.
  • Identify gaps to goals and collaboratively develop and support countermeasures and activities to close the gap and exceed targets.
  • Work to align strategies between commodity and sector localization, plant rationalization and similar
  • Works with suppliers to address significant and/or systemic issues with performance (quality, delivery, warranty, etc.) as may be required in support of plant Manufacturing, Purchasing and Quality teams
  • Responsible for coordinating with commodity teams, materials, operations, engineering, finance, quality, and field operations to complete projects and achieve expected benefits within project timeline.
  • Creates continuous improvement ideation sessions for responsible plants. Generate and evaluate new ideas and opportunities aligned with plant priorities and strategies.
  • Participate in and represent Sourcing function during plant or product Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) or Major Model Review (MMR) events. Responsible for collecting and communicating commodity actions following event.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned and participates in special projects as required.
 

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering or equivalent

  • 5+ years' experience of progressively responsible job-related experience

  • 3+ years' experience using Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word, is required.

  • 5+ years' experience well-developed negotiation skills and assessing vendors.

  • Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data, confirming its accuracy and adequacy, and using it to drive decisions as well as present results and business cases to management

  • Ability to travel up to 10%

 

Core Competencies:

  • Complex Decision-Making

  • Impeccable time-management

  • Supply Chain Acumen

  • Project Management

  • Relationship Management

  • Strong bias for action and results orientation

  • Must be a self-starter; motivated with expert overall sourcing expertise.

  • Incumbent must have strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated effective leadership and influencing skills and practices

  • Experience coordinating, facilitating discussions, consultation and conflict resolution skills

  • Ability and willingness to understand and interact with diverse groups and cultures

  • Evidence of skills & attributes including effective listening, gathering complete information, ensuring accuracy, problem-solving, negotiating, researching discrepancies, and handling conflict are critical.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, meet compressed deadlines, and handle frequent interruptions is essential.

  • Ability and willingness to respond quickly and appropriately in a dynamic, fast paced work environment and the flexibility to withstand challenging situations

 

Preferences:
  • Background in engineering or technical sourcing.
  • Oracle & SAP experience in a global environment is beneficial.
  • Experience in manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated career progression.
  • Proficiency using Excel at an advanced level (use financial and logical functions; work with multiple worksheets and workbooks; edit and use macros/ import and export information) is strongly preferred.
  • Previous lean manufacturing or 6 Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt experience a plus.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Impeccable time-management

  • Ability and willingness to understand and interact with diverse groups and cultures

  • Evidence of skills & attributes including effective listening, gathering complete information, ensuring accuracy, problem-solving, negotiating, researching discrepancies, and handling conflict are critical.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, meet compressed deadlines, and handle frequent interruptions is essential.

job.description:
Job title: Material Handler Driver 
Shift: 5:00am-1:30pm (Monday - Friday)
Location: Charlotte, NC
Pay: Starting pay of $21.50/hr.   

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

 

Job Overview:

The Material Handler under general supervision, distributes either production or non - production items and materials to various locations throughout the warehouse. Materials may consist of purchased parts, in process parts, or finished goods. 

Responsibilities:

  • Move parts or finished product and delivers mail packages to various department locations and/or warehouse locations using an RF scanner. 
  • Maintain the required paperwork and documentation of all parts and materials moved in accordance with the specified procedures. 
  • Ensure safe operating process for all equipment within Charlotte DLC. 
  • Ensure work areas and other designated work areas are maintained in a safe and neat manner. 
  • Assist with the training and instruction of new employees who may be assigned to this area. 
  • Retrieve and count product to fulfill customer orders 
  • Participate in general housekeeping activity 
  • Stocking and arranging of product to ensure warehouse turns of inventory. 
  • Responsible for supporting the Distribution process by receiving and transporting components to the floor in accordance with predetermined safety, quality, method and sequence standards. 
  • Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed or assigned. 

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED 
  • 6+ months of experience in a manufacturing environment

Core Competencies: 

  • Previous experience in a distribution center is desired but not required. Willing to train. 
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills 
  • Hands –on ability to work in a fast-pace, team-oriented distribution center environment. Required to work independently and with limited supervision. Must have the ability to make decisions. Must be able to maintain regular and acceptable attendance, follow directions, interact well with co-workers, understand and follow posted work rules/procedures and to accept constructive criticism.

Preferences:

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Knowledge of inventory processes
  • Previous Material Handling experience (cherry/reach lift experience preferred) 
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills. 
  • Proven ability to follow through on commitments and details. 
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skill. 
  • Proven team player. 

Physical Requirements 

  • Standing and/or walking for entire shift and ability to multi-task and work in a fast paced environment

Location:  Sidney, OH
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
If you're looking for an opportunity to do more than support EHS — if you want to influence it, improve it, and leave your mark on a manufacturing site — this role offers exactly that. As the EHS Specialist, you’ll take ownership of key environmental, health, and safety activities for the plant, balancing hands-on floor presence with the coordination of training, reporting, compliance administration, occupational health support, visitor controls, purchasing, stock control, business continuity, and improvement projects. 

You’ll be a trusted partner to plant leadership and a visible resource to employees, helping drive solutions, support safe operations, and review safety considerations tied to projects, contractors, equipment changes, and other plant initiatives. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds credibility on the shop floor, and wants the visibility, influence, and growth opportunity to help elevate EHS performance across the site. 

Responsibilities:

  • Implement and enforce company EHS policies and standard work across assigned facilities by developing site-specific EHS policies, procedures, and programs, including lockout/tagout, machine guarding, PPE, and emergency response.
  • Ensure compliance with company EHS requirements, standard work, and applicable local laws and regulations through routine facility audits, inspections, and follow-up actions.
  • Manage activities that support compliance with critical EHS programs while helping build and sustain a strong EHS culture.
  • Identify and implement EHS best practices and lead continuous improvement initiatives across assigned sites.
  • Manage EHS data entry and reporting within GenSuite, while tracking, maintaining, and organizing all safety and compliance documentation.
  • Track site performance against EHS key performance indicators, using both leading and lagging indicators to monitor performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct incident investigations to identify contributing factors, determine root cause, and implement appropriate actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Monitor workplace safety performance and support ongoing safety and operational improvement initiatives.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of environmental, health, and safety experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, supporting site-level EHS activities in a fast-paced plant setting.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting EHS reporting, recordkeeping, and data tracking, including use of EHS systems or similar reporting tools.
  • 3+ years of working knowledge of OSHA regulations and practical EHS application.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated ability building relationships and credibility across all levels of an organization, ideally with shop floor employees.
  • 2+ years of experience handling corrective actions, safety improvements, and practical solutions in response to manufacturing environment issues.

Core Competencies:
  • Shop Floor Credibility & Influence
  • Ability to build trust, credibility, and influence with shop floor employees and plant leadership; strong floor presence is a key success factor.
  • Practical OSHA & EHS Expertise
  • Solid OSHA foundation and practical EHS knowledge, with the ability to serve as the site resource for OSHA, code, and day-to-day EHS matters.
  • Environmental Awareness
  • Basic to moderate environmental knowledge in SDSs, chemical management, and hazardous/non-hazardous waste exposure.
  • Manufacturing / Plant Safety Support
  • Experience supporting EHS in a manufacturing or plant environment where safety, production, and operational continuity must work together.
  • Site-Level EHS Ownership & Reporting
  • Comfort owning tactical site-level EHS responsibilities, including monthly reporting, recordkeeping, training support, data tracking, and use of EHS/reporting systems.
  • Bias for Action & Corrective Action Follow-Through
  • Ability to respond quickly to daily safety issues, drive corrective actions, solve problems, and move practical safety improvements forward.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Ability to work effectively with operations, maintenance, engineering, contractors, and site leadership on plant projects, equipment moves, contractor review, and broader site decisions.

Preferences:
  • Associates or Bachelors Degree concentration in EHS
  • Experience with Benchmark Gensuite
  • Certified ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or related EHS certification / quality systems
  • Experience in manufacturing environments with paint, or similar production processes.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • Position based onsite in Sidney, OH
  • Work Authorization: US Citizen or Perm Resident

Pay Range
The base pay range for this role is $65,000 - $80,000 annually. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
  • Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.
Requirements:
  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
Core Competencies:
  • Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting.
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner
Preferences:
  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
  • Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Starting Pay will range between $25.00 - $35.00 per hour depending on qualifications and experience. This is a full-time, hourly position.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a skilled Welder to join our dynamic team. The Welder will be responsible for performing welding tasks to assemble and fabricate metal structures and components according to specifications. This role requires proficiency in various welding techniques, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and quality.

Responsibilities:

  • Weld nickel 55/45 wire to cast iron as a filler, or to build back up or fill in part erosion/cavitation
  • Weld all types of metals and alloys of various sizes, shapes, and thicknesses, including dissimilar metals such as steel
  • Operate various hand-welding, flame-cutting, hand-soldering, or brazing equipment to weld or join metal components or to fill holes, indentations, or seams of fabricated metal products

  • Operate welding equipment (manual or semi-automatic) and metal shaping machines
  • Ensure all tasks are performed within the allotted time and in accordance with Health and Safety regulations and company policies and procedures
  • Perform basic maintenance of welding equipment
  • As required, operate metal working equipment including shear, press brake, roll forming machine, saws, etc.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years of welding experience, including GTAW, SMAW, and Sub-arc welding
  • 1+ years of fitting experience
  • 1+ years of experience reading and understanding blueprints
Core Competencies:
  • Experience and ability to read and understand fabrication prints
  • Manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination
  • Able to stand for extended periods of time and handle heavy loads (up to 40 lbs)
  • Ability to work both independently, with little supervision, and as part of a team
  • Ability to adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions

Job Overview: 

The Machine Operator will set up and operate a variety of machine tools to produce precision parts. Applies knowledge of mechanics, shop mathematics, metal properties, and machining procedures.  Construct, assemble, or rebuild machines, such as blowers, pumps, boosters, and similar equipment used in such industries as transportation, manufacturing or wastewater treatment.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Calculate dimensions and tolerances using mathematics and precision instruments like micrometers and calipers. 
  • Develop and improve Standard Work sheets for consistent machining and assembly processes, ensuring parts meet specifications. 
  • Set up, adjust, and operate machine tools (lathes, milling machines, etc.), selecting and securing appropriate tools, fixtures, and materials. 
  • Engage in the 5 Why Process for problem-solving and continuous improvement, and collaborate with engineering and supervisory personnel for technical support. 
  • Assemble and align components for various units using standard work and engineering documents, verifying clearances and ensuring proper lubrication and cooling. 
  • Maintain equipment efficiency by operating, reworking damaged parts, reading Bills of Material, cleaning, and lubricating machines. 
 

Requirements: 

  • High School Diploma or GED 
  • 1+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment 
 

Core Competencies:  

  • Mechanical - Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, and maintenance. 
  • Production and Processing - Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods. 
  • Mathematics - Knowledge of arithmetic and algebra. 
  • Operation Monitoring - Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly. 
  • Quality Control Analysis - Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance. 
  • Operation and Control - Controlling operations of equipment or systems. 
  • Troubleshooting - Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it. 
  • Equipment Maintenance - Performing routine maintenance on equipment 
 

Preferences: 

  • 2+ years’ assembly and or CNC machining 
  • Ability to read blueprints, including geometric dimensioning and tolerance. 
  • Ability to determine and complete offsets through basic mathematics. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk and stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear.  
  

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • Fully site based

As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers. For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities.

With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

Job Overview:
This is an Inside Sales & Service - Parts position based out of the Menomonee Falls Customer Center. The role includes sales support from the time of inquiry to delivery, which requires parts identification, quoting, order confirmation/purchase order receipt, pricing, order processing, expediting, and problem solving. As the ISS Representative becomes more experienced, he/she is able to continue to support the outside sales force with more depth in lead generation, market intelligence, and contact with current customers. For the most experienced, they may be assigned to Special Projects, which require hands-on supervision of highly complex orders or those that require significant coordination with external entities. 

Responsibilities:

  • Handling inbound customer requests to generate sales of compressed air products, services, and parts.
  • Assist customers with parts identification and generate quotes for customers to ensure quotes successfully transition to orders.
  • Manage these orders to ensure delivery schedule is achieved.
  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance, as well as operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.  
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma/GED required 
  • 2+ years of relevant experience required
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move 40+ lbs. 

Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely.
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills.
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task.  
  • Thinks and acts strategically.
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred and will be considered in lieu of experience 
  • Technical background highly preferred  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer applications required; ability to navigate internal software programs will be needed after hire  
  • SalesForce experience a plus  
  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based onsite in Menomonee Falls, WI and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).

Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.
